jobs.title: Medication Aide - Silver Springs
jobs.description:
In partnership with the Director of Assisted Living and Memory Care Director, Med Aides are responsible for assisting with resident medication delivery and management, providing activities of daily living, and observing, documenting, and reporting resident conditions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

• Preparing and assisting with medications as prescribed by Healthcare Providers to residents in Assisted Living.
• Documenting medications given and/or not given in eMAR.
• Communicate to the Resident, Healthcare Providers, Family/POA, and Director/Nurse regarding change in medication orders, refill challenges, or missed scheduled doses of medication.

• Responding to resident pendent calls as needed.
• Assisting residents with ADLs according to the resident’s personalized service plan.
• Working in collaboration with caregivers to provide quality resident care and recommend ways to improve quality of care.
• Following infection control procedures.

• Following SRG policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Senior HSEQQ Manager – EPC/EPCM Projects
jobs.description:
Remote option is available for this position.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Workplace Management team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

This role provides senior HSEQ leadership across Ramboll’s EPC/EPCM project portfolio in Ramboll Americas, supporting the safe delivery of complex engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and turnover activities. The role is responsible for establishing consistent HSEQ governance, aligning contractors and project teams, supporting high-risk work planning, and enabling effective execution across multiple concurrent projects. The successful candidate will bring significant hands-on experience from large-scale EPC/EPCM construction environments and will be able to operate confidently at both strategic and field execution levels.

The ideal candidate will be a credible HSEQ leader with significant field experience on large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects, strong contractor management capability, and the confidence to influence senior project, client, and contractor stakeholders. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects, balancing strategic governance with practical field-based support, and helping project teams create consistent, risk-based HSEQ execution.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Strategic HSEQ Leadership

• Lead the development of a portfolio-wide HSEQ approach that enables consistent standards, scalable processes, and project-specific execution across all EPC/EPCM projects.
• Serve as primary HSEQ advisor to Project Directors and EPC/EPCM leadership teams.
• Drive adoption of Ramboll’s HSEQ program and translate its expectations into practical project-level behaviours, controls, and leadership routines.
• Provide strategic HSEQ guidance during proposals and contract negotiations to align client expectations and establish the conditions needed for effective safety management.
• Provide HSEQ leadership within an EPC/EPCM delivery model, ensuring clear boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces between Ramboll, clients, construction contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
• Safety Program Organization & Implementation
• Define HSEQ organization structures that are scalable with the ability to support multi-project EPC/EPCM delivery on a nationwide basis.
• Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and governance models required for integrated EPC/EPCM/ safety programs.
• Establish standardized HSEQ execution plans across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
• Establish construction readiness expectations, including contractor mobilisation, competency assurance, risk review, and field execution controls.
• Contractor & Multi-Party Coordination
• Align HSEQ expectations, execution standards, and performance requirements across contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and third-party stakeholders.
• Lead contractor onboarding, alignment sessions, audits, and recurring performance reviews.
• Ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded into contracting strategies, procurement packages, bid documents, mobilisation plans, and contractor management processes.
• Support project teams in translating Ramboll and client HSEQ requirements into practical field execution requirements for contractors and subcontractors.
• Risk Management, Governance and Assurance
• Provide governance and assurance over EPC/EPCM risk management processes, including hazard identification, construction risk assessments, high-risk work reviews, and site controls.
• Support project HSEQ resources and project leadership in establishing consistent risk management expectations, while ensuring accountability remains clear within the project delivery structure.
• Review and challenge the effectiveness of controls for high-risk activities, including lifting, electrical work, confined space entry, work at height, ground disturbance, energisation, commissioning, and simultaneous operations.
• Provide oversight, escalation support, and subject matter input for high-potential or higher-severity incidents, ensuring investigations are completed and lessons learned are embedded across relevant projects.
• Conduct site visits, leadership engagements, and assurance reviews to verify that project HSEQ controls are effective, understood, and consistently applied by the relevant project teams and contractors.
• Safety Culture & Engagement
• Demonstrate visible HSEQ leadership that builds trust, accountability, and proactive safety behaviours across project teams and contractors.
• Coach project and contractor leadership teams to strengthen leading indicators, reinforce expectations, and promote consistent safety leadership.
• Promote open communication, psychological safety, learning, and continuous improvement across the EPC/EPCM project portfolio.
• Regulatory & Compliance Oversight
• Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSEQ standards across EPC/EPCM projects.
• Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSEQ requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
• Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPC/EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.
• Performance Management & Reporting
• Establish consistent HSEQ performance reporting across EPC/EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
• Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

About you

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
• 10+ years of progressive on-site HSEQ leadership experience with substantial large-scale EPC/EPCM project exposure.
• Strong background supporting multi-contractor, high-risk industrial construction environments.
• Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
• Proven experience supporting construction management delivery models where HSEQ performance is delivered through contractor execution and strong client/contractor interface management.
• Working knowledge of construction-phase HSEQ controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, and regulatory compliance.
• Ability to travel regularly to project locations and engage effectively with field teams, project leadership, clients, and contractors.
• Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

• Professional certifications (CSP, CMIOSH, NEBOSH, CRSP, or equivalent).
• Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
• Experience supporting owner’s EPC/EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
• International or remote project experience.

What we can offer you

• Investment in your development
• Being valued for the unique person you are
• Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,497 - $197,515 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Pricing Analyst to join our team in Fairlawn, United States. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing and executing pricing strategies that drive profitability and competitive advantage. You will leverage data analysis and financial modeling to support strategic pricing decisions across our organization. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with excellent organizational skills and the ability to communicate complex pricing insights to cross-functional stakeholders.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

• Develop, analyze, and maintain comprehensive pricing models and strategies aligned with organizational objectives
• Conduct detailed market analysis, competitor pricing research, and cost structure evaluations to inform pricing recommendations
• Prepare and present pricing reports, dashboards, and recommendations to senior management and business units
• Collaborate with sales, marketing, finance, and product teams to ensure pricing strategies support business goals
• Monitor pricing performance metrics, profitability margins, and key performance indicators to identify optimization opportunities
• Perform variance analysis and financial modeling to assess the impact of pricing changes on revenue and margins
• Maintain accurate pricing documentation, systems, and databases to ensure data integrity and accessibility
• Support the development of pricing policies and procedures that align with company standards and regulatory requirements
• Identify trends and opportunities for pricing optimization through continuous analysis and market monitoring

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

• Bachelor's degree in Business / Finance or a related field
• Internships in related fields of analysis or pricing
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and financial modeling
• Knowledge of pricing strategy, cost accounting, and profitability analysis
• Proficiency with SQL or similar database query languages for data extraction and manipulation
• Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in financial analysis and reporting
• Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Proficiency with data visualization and business intelligence tools
• Ability to work in with multinational cultures

Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job posting.

ADDITIONAL WAYS TO STAND OUT

• 2-4 years of professional experience in pricing analysis, financial analysis, business analysis, or related field
• Experience in pricing strategy, cost accounting, and profitability analysis
• Experience with pricing software or revenue management systems (preferred)
• Knowledge of Python, R, or other programming languages for data analysis (preferred)
• Familiarity with industry-specific pricing challenges and best practices (preferred)

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Traffic Monitoring Operator I - Part Time Overnight
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a productive, flexible, and highly talented Traffic Management Center Operator for immediate employment in Indianapolis, IN.  This is part-time variable  position, typically two eight hour shifts, Saturday and Sunday, overnight.  The applicant can  establish a career in operations and customer service, specific to a fast paced, technology driven work environment.

The TMC Operator assists INDOT operations.  The operator disseminates information verbally and electronically regarding active incidents, such as stranded motorist, crashes, etc., to INDOT’s Hoosier Helper Freeway Service Patrol.  Work within a Traffic Management Center also includes, but not limited to, monitoring CCTV traffic cameras, radio communications with INDOT personnel and other emergency responding agencies using 10 codes, incident  identification and response call-out, customer service representative, and implementing required traffic control and other associated warning devices to advise the public of incidents and events impacting traffic flow.

Operators are responsible for the quality, accuracy and timeliness of all information disseminated. Operators maintain contact with Indiana State Police (ISP) Dispatch and other emergency responders, communicate and coordinate incident and road blocking information with INDOT maintenance and district staff as needed,  provides other appropriate response agencies of scene details, provides information to motorists by displaying traveler information messages on Dynamic Message Boards (DMS), and provides overall information to verify and update  information regarding ongoing incidents, associated backup/traffic delays and estimated clearance times.

Operators assist the general public by correctly inputting data into INDOT’s Roadway Events Manager (REM) and CARS database for incidents, construction, and maintenance activities  impacting traffic flow to generate events in web applications.  Review all events, signs, and traveler information for accuracy. Operators assess large volumes of data (both static and real-time) from a wide variety of sources to detect possible roadway incidents. They monitor road sensor data and confirm the data using CCTV video. Effective communication is an important part of this process as operators maintain telephone and/or radio communications with incident responders, DOT field personnel and other public and private agencies. Once assessment is complete, operators determine the facts and severity of traffic incidents and prepares the information for dissemination to the motoring public.

Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or GED equivalent is required.
• Must pass a State and Federal criminal history/security background check.
• Must pass a pre-employment drug screen.
• Ability and Flexibility to work a variety of shifts.
• Constantly operate a computer and other monitoring equipment.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time monitoring Intelligent Transportation Systems such CCTV camera displays, meters, law enforcement radio broadcasts, answering/responding to calls and communicating to other staff or partner agencies.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous experience as a transportation Traffic Management Center Operator/Dispatcher a plus, but not a requirement
• Ability to synthesize information from multiple inputs, including automated road sensor data, 2-way radios, CCTV traffic cameras, and computer databases.
• Knowledge of personal computers and software.
• Knowledge of or ability to learn Indiana roadways.
• Ability to work calmly and accurately under intense pressure
• Able to multitask under intense pressure
• Able to communicate across various levels of management

• Sponsorship opportunities for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position.
• Relocation Benefits are not available for this position.

jobs.title: Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
As the Benefits Specialist, you are part of the Employee Benefits Team, which serves as the main point of contact for our U.S. employees. Together with your team members, you provide excellent customer service support for all employee benefit programs offered to Bertelsmann Printing Group, Penguin Random House, BMG, Fremantle, Arvato, Bertelsmann Corporate, and employees at our other operating companies. You also support the leave of absence and disability process. In this role, you will coordinate with benefit vendors, research, and resolve any escalated employee issues and questions that arise. You are also responsible for assisting former employees with retiree medical, retiree life insurance, and pension benefits. In addition, you will work closely with the entire HR-Benefits Team on organizational initiatives, such as annual enrollment.

The Benefits Specialist is part of the HR-Benefits Team, which has the responsibility of developing, negotiating, and customizing the health, welfare, and retirement programs for each of Bertelsmann's U.S. operating Companies. The Benefits Specialist is expected to possess a wealth of knowledge and understanding of employee benefits at an employee-facing and corporate level.

This role generally works standard business hours, with the exception that, on occasion, the schedule will be shifted to support employees in the evening shift. This role is expected to work in the office at least two days per week (subject to change based on business needs).

This role reports to the Director of Employee Benefits.

Role and Responsibilities

• Assist employees with benefit issues, including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, life insurance, flexible spending accounts, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, pension, 401(k) and other company-provided benefits and services
• Support the annual enrollment process, qualifying life event changes, implementation of new vendors and onboarding of employees for acquired companies
• Respond to high daily volume of phone, email, and face-to-face inquiries and assist current and former employees with resolving benefits-related issues
• Resolve administrative problems with the carrier representatives, investigate discrepancies, escalate issues and provide information in non-routine situations
• Partner and collaborate with HRIS, Corporate Benefits, HR Business partners, and external vendors to resolve issues related to enrollment, eligibility, claims and vendor performance
• Research, interpret, and provide employees guidance on established benefit policies and procedures
• Draft and coordinate the distribution of communications for ad hoc participant issues, present and facilitate benefits orientations for annual enrollment and new hire orientations
• Support the translation of benefit communications and plan documents between English and Spanish as needed
• Collaborate with vendors and HR partners to administer leave of absence and key entries as needed
• Support audit activities and the accuracy of data and benefit records
• Support and respond to employees, including support for evening shift as needed and during peak periods such as annual enrollment
• Ensure proper document retention in accordance with statutory and internal business practices
• Other duties as assigned to meet business needs

• 4 or more years of work experience in human resources required, including 2 or more years in a benefits role
• Bachelor’s degree or related experience required; CEBS certification preferred
• Bilingual fluency in both English and Spanish required; including the ability to translate technical benefits and health related plan information
• Knowledge of health & welfare plans, retirement plans, leave of absence, FMLA and workers compensation coordination
• Must be detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working on complex problems
• Solid interpersonal skills, judgment, and client service orientation with focus on high-quality service to internal and external stakeholders
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate information across a large organization and translate complex benefits information into clear, actionable guidance
• Ability to work independently or as a team player in a fast-paced and decentralized environment
• Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables, and other Office applications
• Must be proficient in researching information, data entry, and running reports in an HRIS, ideally UKG
• Must maintain strict confidentiality and employee privacy
• Must be willing and able to work a flexible schedule, including periodic shifts outside standard business hours to support employees on an evening shift.

jobs.title: CHAMP Roadside Motorist Patroller - District 5
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking highly motivated individuals for the CHAMP (Coordinated Highway Assistance & Maintenance Program) in District 5. Starting Pay is $20hr.

District 5 covers the following areas: Baxley, Waycross, Brunswick, Statesboro, & Savannah, serving 26 counties in Southeast Georgia. Georgia DOT's complimentary roadside assistance and maintenance service known as CHAMP (Coordinated Highway Assistance & Maintenance Program) is available to motorists traveling through the region.

CHAMP Operators play a key critical role in safeguarding motorists traveling the interstates by ensuring roadways are clear of debris, reporting highway maintenance issues and assisting stranded motorists, among other duties.

These dynamic roles are ideal for individuals with solid mechanical and/or automotive repair skills, a background in long- or short-term driving, public Safety, public Works and or ex-military.

Full-time CHAMP Operators will be provided with a company cell phone, radio, and a fully outfitted response vehicle while working on this program.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

• Patrol and monitor a segment of interstate roadways in an assigned region, looking for stranded motorists, roadway deficiencies, site distance problems and obstructions that may cause lane blockage.
• Requires strong communication skills for use with dispatch radio.
• Provide strong customer service (no tips or gratuity can be accepted).
• Professionally and courteously assist the public with circumstances that have left them stranded, such as dead batteries, running out of gas, or flat tires.
• Ensure compliance with all Federal, State, and Municipal laws, rules and ordinances.
• Monitor, report and document roadway deficiencies to Dispatch or District offices.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• High School Diploma and or equivalent certificate (GED) or 1 year of relevant work experience in lieu of education.
• Be a minimum of 18 years of age.
• Ability to drive, using an AECOM provided vehicle, patrolling and monitoring a segment of interstate roadway in an assigned region.
• Possess a valid Driver’s License and a clean driving record, including no suspension of license in the last 5 years.
• Must pass a State and Federal criminal history/security and motor vehicle background checks.
• Employees must also participate in monthly MVR monitoring program and maintain a satisfactory driving record as a condition of employment. Must pass a pre-employment drug screen and successfully participate in the program’s mandatory random drug screening process.
• Possess or be able and willing to obtain CPR and First Aid certifications.
• Working knowledge of basic automotive repair.
• Willingness to be on call 24/7 and respond to after-hours call outs.
• Position will include wearing associated personal protective equipment.

Work Environment/Physical requirements – essential functions:

Physically able, with or without an accommodation, to work in outdoor environments with uneven terrain, variable outdoor conditions including heat, cold, moisture, dust, dryness, noise, and automotive-related chemicals (e.g., fuels, coolants, lubricants, etc.); position requires frequent operation of vehicles. Work around heavy, moving, dangerous equipment; often standing/walking. The essential functions of this job include the:

• Ability to lift up to 95 pounds.
• Ability to push/drag and generate at least 66 ft./lbs. of vertical downward force pushing a force gauge set at a contact point of 21 inches off the ground.
• Ability to lift/carry vehicle wheels/tires.
• Ability to perform repetitive bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, and/or crouching, and occasionally work with arms above shoulder level.
• Ability to perform fine motor skills.
• Ability to perform hand gripping/squeezing for hand tools and equipment (levers, jack handles, air compressor, jumper cables, etc.)
• Ability to occasionally work at heights less than 4ft.
• Ability to climb stairs.
• Ability to descend/ascend vehicle truck steps comfortably.

Please note: This position is contingent upon successfully completing functional tests for each essential function identified for this position.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Five (5) years of driving experience.
• Experience in working in roadway traffic environment
• A positive customer service attitude - both to co-workers (internal customers) and external customers.
• Basic knowledge of operations of emergency services.
• Basic knowledge of highway maintenance activities.
• Basic knowledge in minor auto repairs and automotive preventive maintenance.
• Ability to work independently with little supervision and manage own time.
• Demonstrated ability to reason and make good sound decisions based on narrowly defined criteria or guidelines.
• Ability to guide or direct others at incident scenes.
• Ability to gather and disseminate information effectively.
• Working knowledge of the Manual of Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD)
• Demonstrated professional maturity.

• Sponsorship opportunities for US Employment Authorization is not available for this position.
• Relocation Benefits are not available for this position.
• Other benefits may include Tuition reimbursement and a take home vehicle to be used for company purposes.
• Opportunities for overtime hours and pay are also available.

jobs.title: Environmental Technician II
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Junior Environmental Technician (entry level to 2 years’ experience) to support environmental remediation for an industrial client. You will work alongside experienced technicians and field crews to execute field tasks safely and efficiently, maintain high-quality documentation, and support operations, maintenance, and sampling activities. The site is located in Niagara Falls, NY.

This role emphasizes hands-on fieldwork and adherence to safety and quality protocols, with growth opportunities into advanced field responsibilities. The successful candidate will ideally have some experience in general operations, environmental remediation/sampling, and hands-on mechanical experience.

Field Operations & Site Support

• Oversee pump-and-treat system operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance optimization.
• Sampling groundwater Influent and Effluent from groundwater treatment systems primarily for volatile organic compounds. Preparing chains-of-custody and sample cooler loading in preparation for transport to contracted analytical laboratories.
• Gathering and maintaining specified records of scientific data for the technical lead/supervisor, including environmental sampling, operations and maintenance, and inspections at client sites
• Assisting with calculations, setting up, and operating equipment (sampling devices and pumps), inspecting equipment and installations for compliance with specifications and maintaining proper project documentation.
• Driving AECOM-leased site vehicles.
• Mechanical aptitude to make basic repairs to treatment equipment.
• Overseeing and working in collaboration with client mechanical, electrical, and industrial contractors.

Health & Safety Participation

• Follow AECOM safety policies and Site-Specific Health and Safety Plans (SSHPs); participate in JHAs/tailgates and stop work if unsafe conditions arise.
• Use required PPE correctly, report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions immediately.
• Maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable state requirements during all phases of work.

Documentation & QA/QC

• Maintain complete and accurate field logs, daily reports, equipment logs, photo documentation, and chain-of-custody records.
• Perform basic data entry and QA/QC checks for measurements and sampling results.

Coordination & Communication

• Coordinate day-to-day needs with the site supervisor, project manager, subcontractors, and client representatives as directed.
• Communicate field status, issues, and material/equipment needs promptly and professionally.

Minimum Requirements

• High School Diploma or equivalent, plus at least 2 years experience
• U.S. citizenship (due to project requirements)
• Ability to travel to various client site locations to conduct fieldwork, including but not limited to environmental sampling, operations and maintenance and inspections.
• Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
• In order to receive a security badge at the client worksite for which you are being hired to perform services, you will be required to pass the client's background, medical and drug screening requirements, which will be done after you have commenced employment and is a condition of your continued employment.
• Ability to pass a client-mandated drug test.
• Position requires frequent (more than 50% of workday) standing/walking; often (25-50% of workday) performing power gripping/squeezing (hand tools, levers, etc.), operation of vehicles, performing repetitive or fine hand movements, and lifting of less than 25 pounds; occasionally (10-25% of workday) performing work with arms above shoulder level, repetitive bending & stooping, working at heights, climbing stairs, using portable ladders, work in an environment of heavy, moving, dangerous equipment, work in confined spaces, keyboard/mouse operations, work alone in isolated/remote areas, and lifting of 25-50 pounds; rarely (less than 10% of workday) wearing fall protection, and lifting of 50-75 pounds.
• Position will include wearing associated personal protective equipment, including but not limited to gloves, safety glasses/goggles, face shield, safety shoes/boots, hard hat, hearing, and respiratory protection.
• OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER (current) or ability to obtain within 60 days of hire (training provided).

Preferred Qualifications

• 3-5 years of environmental remediation, construction, utilities, or industrial fieldwork experience.
• Current OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER with recent refresher; OSHA 10 or 30 Construction and CPR/First Aid certifications.
• Experience with basic sampling, meter use (e.g., PID, multi-parameter), and remediation system O&M tasks.
• Some experience or aptitude with flow meters, pH meters, and level probes would be beneficial but not required.
• Proficiency with field documentation (daily reports, chain-of-custody, photo logs); basic Excel/Word skills.
• Previous knowledge or experience with process control systems
• Familiarity or previous experience with environmental regulatory compliance.
• Mechanical aptitude and hands-on skills to operate groundwater treatment equipment.

jobs.title: Lead Consultant, Geologist
jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our Syracuse office.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

We invite you to bring your environmental consulting experience into play as you support provide technical and project leadership for environmental investigation and remediation projects in the New York area. In this position, the selected candidate will lead and support multidisciplinary teams working closely with Professional Engineers (PEs), Professional Geologists (PGs), Licensed Site Remediation Professionals (LSRPs) and other technical specialists.

As a senior member of the team, you will apply your technical expertise and professional judgment to guide site investigation and remediation strategies, oversee field programs and data evaluation, prepare and review technical deliverables, and support regulatory and client communications. You will also provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level staff while helping ensure projects are completed efficiently, safely, and in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The position provides opportunities to work on a diverse range of projects involving, geologic and environmental investigations, conceptual site model development, remedial strategy and design, data evaluation and modelling, regulatory compliance and technical reporting.

Your key tasks and responsibilities for this role will be:

• Lead and oversee geologic and site investigations, including Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Remedial Designs, Remedial Actions, and post-remediation OM&M plan and oversee various drilling methodologies and investigation techniques, including monitoring well installations, packer testing, groundwater sampling, and vapor intrusion investigations.
• Oversee and review detailed and accurate field and project documentation; manage and successfully track field and project activities related to scope, schedule, and budget.
• Serve as a key technical point of contact for clients and project stakeholders, communicating investigation findings, technical recommendations, project status, and emerging issues; participate in client meetings and work collaboratively with LSRP and technical leads to develop practical solutions that meet project and client objectives.
• Coordinate the development and finalization through final submission of technical documents, including regulatory reports, work plans, and biennial remedial action protectiveness submittals, pursuant to regulatory requirements; independently develop scopes of work and budgetary cost estimates and support initial project setup, invoicing, and project closeout.
• Proactively communicate change management needs during project execution; provide technical guidance and mentorship to early-career and mid-level Geological Scientists and contribute to the development of team capabilities and technical best practices.

About you

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Science, Environmental Science, or related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Possession, eligibility, or demonstrated progress toward obtaining, a PG license and/or LSRP.
• At a minimum, 40-Hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification and up-to-date 8-hour refresher; additional OSHA health and safety training and certifications are a plus.
• Strong working knowledge of federal New York environmental and site remediation regulations, with demonstrated experience applying regulatory requirements to investigation and remediation projects.
• Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary project teams, managing technical tasks, and communicating technical findings and recommendations to clients, regulators, and other project stakeholders; strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $81,515 – $101,891 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Automated Assembly
jobs.description:
The Line Planner is responsible for the daily technical performance of the assigned production line. This role serves as the primary engineering partner to Operations, ensuring equipment, processes, and cross-functional resources work together to maintain safe, stable, and efficient production.

The Line Planner provides real-time visibility into line performance, coordinates issue resolution, leads structured escalation of production risks, and drives rapid recovery to standard operating conditions. While focused on daily execution, the Line Planner also identifies recurring issues and partners with the Process Group to implement long-term improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Daily Production Performance

• Own the daily technical performance of assigned production lines.
• Monitor machine status, production flow, and key performance metrics.
• Identify production risks and proactively communicate impacts to Operations.

Issue Management & Escalation

• Lead structured escalation of safety, quality, delivery, and equipment issues.
• Coordinate cross-functional resources including Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and the Process Group.
• Ensure production issues are documented and communicated effectively.

Production Recovery

• Drive rapid problem solving to restore production to standard conditions.
• Verify that corrective actions achieve expected performance.
• Escalate recurring or systemic issues for long-term investigation.

Standardization

• Maintain manufacturing documentation including work instructions and engineering standards.
• Support adherence to standardized work across the production line.
• Identify opportunities to improve standard work based on daily observations.

Performance & Capacity Support

• Monitor production performance trends and identify emerging risks.
• Support production planning through cycle time, capacity, and equipment performance analysis.
• Assist with launch activities and production readiness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Line OEE
• Downtime reduction
• Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR)
• Schedule attainment
• First Pass Yield / Scrap performance
• On-time issue escalation
• Completion of corrective actions
• Accuracy of production reporting

The Line Planner is the engineering owner of daily production performance, ensuring manufacturing operates safely, efficiently, and consistently by coordinating rapid problem resolution, maintaining production standards, and enabling Operations to achieve stable performance every day.

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline.

Experience

• 3–7 years of manufacturing engineering or production engineering experience.
• Experience supporting automated high-volume manufacturing operations.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex production data
• Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments, extreme willingness to share know-how.
• Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to quality and operational excellence

Technical Skills

• Root cause analysis (8D, A3, 5 Why, Fishbone)
• Lean Manufacturing principles
• Statistical process understanding
• TRC & MRC
• Manufacturing KPIs (OEE, FPY, Scrap, Tech/Org Downtime, Cycle Time)
• Microsoft Excel and data analysis
• MES, ERP, or production monitoring systems preferred
• Databricks & Query language experience preferred

Success Profile

A successful Line Planner is someone who:

• Thinks with urgency while remaining organized.
• Can quickly prioritize competing production issues.
• Communicates effectively across Operations, Maintenance, and Quality.
• Uses data to drive decisions rather than assumptions.
• Builds strong relationships across functions.
• Escalates issues early and follows through until resolution.
• Balances immediate production needs with continuous improvement opportunities.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIP

This position reports to Wil Richardson (ChP/MFE4)

INTERACTION

This position interacts with Operators, Operational Technicians, Special Technicians, Manufacturing Engineers and Leadership

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match
• Profit Sharing Bonus (CPrP) up to 10%
• Medical, dental, and vision coverage
• Onsite Cafeteria with multiple menu options

Student Recruitment Activities

• Collaborate with Regional and School Ops leaders to prepare and implement outreach activities to recruit new families and students to KIPP, including flyering, canvassing and tabling in the school community.
• Participate in and help lead recruitment activities, including community events, tabling, flyering, canvassing, school tours, information sessions, and other outreach efforts.

Experience:

Knowledge/skills required:

jobs.title: BIM Manager - Construction Management
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about defining the digital foundation for physical spaces at a global scale? We are looking for a BIM Manager to serve as the principal architect of our virtual workspace—building the core Revit templates, global parameter frameworks, and master asset libraries that power our entire design studio.

We are building a highly scaled, forward-looking Design Standards Studio. In this role, you will sit at the center of our digital ecosystem, combining systems-level governance, workflow automation, and hands-on content creation. Partnering closely with our Standards Governance and Documentation teams, you will bridge physical architectural models with digital database schemas and lead a multi-region governance network supporting project delivery teams across the studio.

Responsibilities:

• Global Modeling Governance: Develop, implement, and maintain global Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD modeling standards, master templates, and shared parameter files across the Design Studio.
• Master Asset Library Management: Build and maintain the master BIM Family Library (including programmatic equipment blocks, architectural details, and fixtures) to ensure all 3D models reflect current design standards.
• ACC Tenant Administration: Serve as the primary Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) Hub Administrator for studio ACC and Revit users, managing permissions, licensing, and cloud worksharing environments.
• Production & Workflow Automation: Research, develop, and deploy automation tools (using Dynamo, Python, or Revit API) to streamline routine modeling checks, parametric verification, and QA/QC workflows.
• Regional Coordination Network: Mentor and manage regional BIM Coordinators across EMEA and APAC to handle localized model troubleshooting, coordinate technical training, and maintain global alignment.
• Model Health & Quality Control: Conduct regular model health audits on active local models and external Architect of Record submittals to ensure clean file handoffs.
• Quarterly CMS Catalog Alignment: Collaborate directly with Standards Governance and Documentation leads to align Revit model metadata and database schemas. Deliver master template and family catalog updates quarterly for web-based CMS publishing.

• 5+ years of experience in BIM Administration, Model Coordination, and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) management.
• Advanced Revit & AutoCAD Customization: Proven track record of developing, deploying, and enforcing master templates and shared parameter files for multi-site corporate programs.
• Cloud Worksharing & Coordination: Deep proficiency within the Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and BIM 360 ecosystems.
• Revit Family Creation: Hands-on mastery of parametric families, nested families, type catalogs, and central parameter database management.
• Technical Documentation: Experience authoring clear BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), modeling guides, and technical standards.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong collaboration skills with experience managing external A/E consultants, vendor model handoffs, and multidisciplinary design reviews.
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent practical/technical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Automation & Scripting: Hands-on experience writing scripts in Dynamo, Python, or the Revit API to automate repetitive workflows.

CMS & Catalog Management: Experience organizing data-rich BIM catalogs for web-based Content Management Systems.

Program Experience: Exposure to large-scale retail, hospitality, industrial rollout programs, or technical infrastructure projects (R&D labs, data centers, cleanrooms).

Certifications:

• Autodesk Certified Professional (ACP): Revit Architecture
• Autodesk Certified Lead or BIM Manager credentials
• buildingSMART Professional Certification or CanBIM Professional / Specialist Certification

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $130K-$150K. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package

jobs.title: Configuration and Data Administrator
jobs.description:
The Configuration and Data Administrator is responsible for implementing SEAKR configuration and data management procedures.  This is a full-time non-exempt position in which the work is performed under limited supervision. This is a hybrid position, where 1-2 days a week are required on-site, and the remainder can be performed remotely from home.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

·       Support program configuration and data administration needs.

·       Maintain and report on Configuration Management activities including configuration status accounting.

·       Release SEAKR engineering documents, drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOMs) when approved.

·       Provide change control of released drawings and BOMs via Engineering Change Orders (COs).

·       Track Program and SEAKR internal documentation releases.

·       Create and maintain configuration data in SEAKR’s ERP database, such as product structures and engineering part revisions.

·       Edit and format documents to conform to standard company styles

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

·       Follow SEAKR rules and regulations as documented in the SEAKR Employee Handbook.

·       Follow SEAKR’s CM processes, as defined in our quality system operating procedures.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Knowledge of company operations as they relate to ensuring customer configuration management expectations and requirements.
• Knowledge of business English, spelling, punctuation and grammar.
• Knowledge of Personal Computer operations including Microsoft Office tools.
• Ability to exercise independent judgment.
• Ability to successfully operate as part of a multi-functional team, including engineering, program management and manufacturing.
• Ability to understand product structures and workflows.
• Ability to accept direction from immediate supervisor as well as program managers.
• Ability to prioritize and work multiple tasks.
• Ability to train organization and company employees on configuration management functions.
• Knowledge of word processing (particularly in Microsoft Word), spreadsheet and database software.
• Ability to prepare and maintain records and reports.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
• Ability to establish good rapport with members of management and other employees.
• Ability to understand and follow written and oral instructions.
• Ability to work on more than one task at a time.
• Ability to work in an office environment.
• Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
• Ability to proofread a variety of documents and to pay attention to detail.

Education or Formal Training

·       Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent combination of training and experience.

Experience  (minimum level of experience)

·       Minimum of 5 years work experience in configuration management systems or data administration roles. Preference is given to candidates with experience in an aerospace or manufacturing environment with strict command media and/or documented process controls.

Compensation: Base pay range is $38-$45/hour, depending on qualifications. SEAKR has very rich medical, dental and vision insurance plans, along with a generous 401(k) retirement plan. In addition to base salary, employees are eligible for a year-end bonus. SEAKR offers a variety of paid leave, such as vacation, sick, bereavement, and FMLA. There is potential for a remote hybrid work schedule once training is complete.

jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant – Pre Op Clinic, Full-time, Days
jobs.description:
Northwestern Medicine has an exciting opportunity for either a Nurse Practitioner or a Physician Assistant to work in our Pre Op Clinic. The Pre op clinic focuses on optimizing patients to safely undergo anesthesia for surgery. The APP will assess patients, complete a history and physical and order any necessary follow up to ensure the patient is ready for anesthesia. APPs are responsible for following up on any tests that have been ordered and following patient care through until surgery is completed

Schedule: M-F, days

• Orientation is 5 days/wk at Northwestern Memorial Hospital.
• Once orientation ends (approximately 90days), move to 4x10s at Northwestern Medicine Palos Hospital and remote telehealth visits
• No nights/weekends/holidays/on-call

Essential Functions:

• Demonstrates clinical expertise and expanded knowledge through patient care activities which may include diagnosis and management of a wide range of health problems.
• Responsible for health outcome of an assigned patient population.
• Confers with collaborating physician and other health professionals in area of clinical expertise.
• Develops appropriate educational systems for patients, families and staff in areas of expertise.
• Actively participates in quality improvement and/or research pertinent to area of expertise.

Responsibilities:

• Conducts comprehensive appraisals of patients' health status by taking health histories and performing physical examinations in clinical area.
• Provides direct clinical care to patients both in person and telehealth
• Prescribes/orders medications, therapies; orders/interprets laboratory tests, imaging and procedures according to clinical privileges.
• Follows up on necessary testing ordered to ensure the patient is ready for surgery
• Evaluates patients to determine their need for further health care.
• Provides comprehensive teaching to patients and families.
• Documents in the medical record all care and education provided and/or procedures performed for which the Licensed Advanced Practice Provider is responsible.
• Refers to other disciplines as appropriate.
• Consultant to other disciplines in areas of expertise.
• Integrates research-based knowledge and clinical expertise in decision making.
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance, manner and presentation.
• Advocate for patients, families, coworkers, and the community.
• Maintains certifications and continuing education as required for licensure and privileges.
• Serves as a patient advocate and role model for "Patients First".
• Participates in unit/departmental/divisional or hospital committees/task forces as appropriate.
• Provides comprehensive teaching strategies for patients and their families.
• Develops and participates in programs to meet continuing education needs of staff.
• Serves as a role model and preceptor to students.
• Participates in quality improvement and/or research initiatives for specific patient population as appropriate.

Required:

• Master’s degree from an accredited school/college of nursing OR master's degree from an accredited Physician Assistant Program
• Current license as a Registered Nurse in the State of Illinois. Current license as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in the State of Illinois. Certification as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse by a national certifying body as approved by the Illinois Department of Regulation APRN Board. Once licensed may apply for a controlled substance license and DEA number OR Master’s degree from an accredited Physician Assistant Program/Current license as a Physician Assistant in the State of Illinois. Once licensed may apply for a controlled substance license and DEA number

jobs.description:

Machinist II is responsible for setting up, editing programs, operating, and maintaining CNC machines to produce high-precision components used in hydro turbines and complete turbine assemblies. jobs.title: Fleet Technician
jobs.description:
Ready to keep our fleet in top shape and on the road? At SIXT, we’re searching for a Fleet Technician to handle essential maintenance and repairs across our vehicle lineup!  From oil changes to tire replacements and vehicle inspections, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our cars are ready for our customers. Your work is vital to maintaining smooth rental operations and maximizing vehicle availability. Join us and enjoy incredible growth opportunities – with a starting hourly rate of $22.00

YOUR ROLE AT SIXT

• You perform basic mechanical repairs to include oil changes, mounting and balancing tires, Tire repair, brake and part replacements
• You complete Pre delivery inspections on fleet vehicles as required by management
• You achieve daily output goals and maintain the minimum efficiency of 100%
• You use PPE every time repairs are performed always including usage of Safety Glasses while in the automotive shops
• You Conduct daily clean-up of work area and maintains a clean work environment

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

• Education & Experience You have at least 2 years' experience as an automotive technician or have graduated from a trade school
• Certifications You hold ASE Certifications in Suspension & Steering (A4) and Brakes (A5), or you’re ready to earn them within your first year of employment
• Licenses & Authorization You are at least 18 years old, hold a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record, and are authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship
• Work Hours & Travel You can work 40 hours per week, including day or evening shifts, and are open to travel (5-10%)

WHAT WE OFFER

• Comprehensive Benefits Package Enjoy healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and pet insurance, along with a 401k plan to secure your future
• Paid Time Off & Holidays Benefit from PTO, sick leave, and receive time and a half for working on public holidays
• Employee Assistance Program Access support whenever needed through our Employee Assistance Program
• Exclusive Employee Rentals Benefit From employee-only rental rates, with family rental options and exclusive discounts for employees
• Uniform & Perks Receive a uniform with weekly dry cleaning, always ensuring a professional appearance

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

jobs.title: Clinical Shift Coordinator RN - Labor & Delivery Part Time Days
jobs.description:
The  Clinical Shift Coordinator reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the hospitalized patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation. Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice. This nurse functions in a leadership, overseeing daily unit operations, staff, and care delivery, utilizing a staff focused leadership model.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates proficiency as a staff nurse and serves as a role model and resource to staff.
• Maintains awareness of unstable, complex or high-risk patient conditions throughout the shift.
• Ensures appropriate assignment of care based on staff competency and patient acuity.
• Coordinates and monitors patient care to ensure patient safety.
• Collects, analyzes and organizes patient care data for the unit.
• Oversees that staff are in compliance with regulatory standards.
• Ensures adaptation of services as needed to reflect age, culture, gender, race, nationality, religion, etc.
• Oversees documentation of key critical elements for patient care and national patient safety goals (restraints, verbal orders, abbreviations, etc.)
• Ensures initial admit orders are received by end of shift.
• Demonstrates knowledge of staffing requirements for unit and ensures compliance with staffing matrix each shift. Consults with manager when
• variances are anticipated.
• Oversees accurate completion of daily charges to ensure unit receives all appropriate revenue.
• Contributes to cost reduction and supports interventions that promote unit cost effectiveness (LOS, HPPD, OT, flexible staffing, and use of alternative skill mixes.)
• Oversees staff scheduling per unit and PCS guidelines.
• Documents appropriate staffing information and justifications in Optilink each shift.
• Checks staff timekeeping on shifts worked and oversees compliance with time and attendance policies.
• Oversees documentation of occurrences on shift and reports to Nursing leadership and risk management as appropriate.
• Ensures compliance with patient life safety standards including fire safety, handwashing, crash cart checks, etc.
• Oversees accurate accounting of unit equipment.
• Demonstrates effective oral, written, and listening skills with staff, physicians, patients and families.
• Keeps all appropriate parties informed a timely manner and understands "chain of command" accountability.
• Completes leader rounding on assigned staff routinely and consistently.
• Provides input to and may assist with organization of staff meetings. Conducts staff huddles on shift.
• Collaborates with educator and manager to ensure appropriate and complete orientation of new staff. Identifies appropriate preceptor and assigns schedule to new staff.
• Participates in unit and PCS based teams, work groups and/or committees or shared governance councils. Demonstrates willingness to give 100% and voluntarily assists others.
• Keeps staff on shift informed of unit initiatives and incorporates outcomes of the team/committees work into practice.
• Ensures all RN's, PC's perform as a team in order to complete work on time and take uninterrupted meal breaks.
• Coordinates patient placement with Clinical Placement Nurse in a timely manner and with a positive and flexible attitude.
• Displays and is responsible for "welcoming spirit" for unit by integrating students and resource team.
• Develops open, functional working relationships with other units/physicians by understanding complexities of different stakeholders; has a house wide perspective.
• Promotes an atmosphere of collective accountability for the Unit/Department.
• Performs weekend leadership rounding on all patients and assists Clinical Manager during week as needed.
• Contributes to annual employee performance evaluation and is present when evaluation is given.
• Conducts formal staff rounding with assigned group of staff on a consistent basis at frequency identified by Manager. Follow up with all new employees on shift as identified by Manager.
• Contributes to completion of minor disciplinary action; may cover this independently with staff member under the approval of Clinical Manager. Provides feedback to Manager for development plans that are needed for staff they lead.
• Demonstrates ability to coach staff effectively using leadership skills.
• Participates in interview process for candidates seeking position on his/her shift.
• Uses retention strategies to recognize and reward staff on shift.
• Serves as Qualified Observer to ensure completion of annual competencies of staff on his/her shift.
• Participates in quality improvement initiatives for unit and as appropriate for PCS. Displays knowledge of PI process.
• Supports staff to incorporate EBP/research findings into practice at the bedside.
• Oversees environment of care and regulatory readiness with all regulatory bodies.
• Is a shift leader and is accountable for hardwiring evidence based and unit specific tactics for patient satisfaction (Hourly Rounding, bedside shift report, discharge calls, and AIDET.)
• Monitors for improvement of chart audit findings at employee level and provides follow-up.
• Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Required

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• 3 Years RN experience
• Licensed RN in the State of Illinois
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Telemetry competency
• Basic computer knowledge.
• Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
• Excellent customer service skills.
• Consistently works within the framework of the Illinois Practice Act for Nursing and ANA Standards of Professional Nursing Practice.
• Ability to assess and determine situations requiring an interpreter and to use interpreter services effectively.

jobs.title: Environmental Technician I
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Environmental Technician to support environmental remediation for an industrial client. You will work alongside experienced technicians and field crews to execute field tasks safely and efficiently, maintain high-quality documentation, and support operations, maintenance, and sampling activities. The site is located in Niagara Falls, NY.

This role emphasizes hands-on fieldwork and adherence to safety and quality protocols, with growth opportunities into advanced field responsibilities. The successful candidate will ideally have some experience in general operations, environmental remediation/sampling, and hands-on mechanical experience.

Field Operations & Site Support

• Oversee pump-and-treat system operations, including monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance optimization.
• Sampling groundwater Influent and Effluent from groundwater treatment systems primarily for volatile organic compounds. Preparing chains-of-custody and sample cooler loading in preparation for transport to contracted analytical laboratories.
• Gathering and maintaining specified records of scientific data for the technical lead/supervisor, including environmental sampling, operations and maintenance, and inspections at client sites
• Assisting with calculations, setting up, and operating equipment (sampling devices and pumps), inspecting equipment and installations for compliance with specifications and maintaining proper project documentation.
• Driving AECOM-leased site vehicles.
• Mechanical aptitude to make basic repairs to treatment equipment.
• Overseeing and working in collaboration with client mechanical, electrical, and industrial contractors.

Health & Safety Participation

• Follow AECOM safety policies and Site-Specific Health and Safety Plans (SSHPs); participate in JHAs/tailgates and stop work if unsafe conditions arise.
• Use required PPE correctly, report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions immediately.
• Maintain compliance with OSHA and applicable state requirements during all phases of work.

Documentation & QA/QC

• Maintain complete and accurate field logs, daily reports, equipment logs, photo documentation, and chain-of-custody records.
• Perform basic data entry and QA/QC checks for measurements and sampling results.

Coordination & Communication

• Coordinate day-to-day needs with the site supervisor, project manager, subcontractors, and client representatives as directed.
• Communicate field status, issues, and material/equipment needs promptly and professionally.

Minimum Requirements

• Must possess a High School Diploma (or GED).
• U.S. citizenship (due to project requirements)
• In order to receive a security badge at the client worksite for which you are being hired to perform services, you will be required to pass the client's background, medical and drug screening requirements, which will be done after you have commenced employment and is a condition of your continued employment.
• Ability to travel to various client sites locations using a AECOM provided Vehicle to conduct fieldwork, including but not limited to environmental sampling, operations and maintenance and inspections.
• Must possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
• Position requires frequent (more than 50% of workday) standing/walking; often (25-50% of workday) performing power gripping/squeezing (hand tools, levers, etc.), operation of vehicles, performing repetitive or fine hand movements, and lifting of less than 25 pounds; occasionally (10-25% of workday) performing work with arms above shoulder level, repetitive bending & stooping, working at heights, climbing stairs, using portable ladders, work in an environment of heavy, moving, dangerous equipment, work in confined spaces, keyboard/mouse operations, work alone in isolated/remote areas, and lifting of 25-50 pounds; rarely (less than 10% of workday) wearing fall protection, and lifting of 50-75 pounds.
• Position will include wearing associated personal protective equipment, including but not limited to gloves, safety glasses/goggles, face shield, safety shoes/boots, hard hat, hearing, and respiratory protection.
• OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER (current) or ability to obtain within 60 days of hire (training provided).

Preferred Qualifications

• 1+ years of environmental remediation, construction, utilities, or industrial fieldwork experience.
• Current OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER with recent refresher; OSHA 10 or 30 Construction and CPR/First Aid certifications.
• Experience with basic sampling, meter use (e.g., PID, multi-parameter), and remediation system O&M tasks.
• Some experience or aptitude with flow meters, pH meters, and level probes would be beneficial but not required.
• Proficiency with field documentation (daily reports, chain-of-custody, photo logs); basic Excel/Word skills.
• Previous knowledge or experience with process control systems
• Familiarity or previous experience with environmental regulatory compliance.
• Mechanical aptitude and hands-on skills to operate groundwater treatment equipment.
• Associate degree or college course education in engineering, chemistry, or other sciences.

• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
• In order to receive a security badge at the client worksite for which you are being hired to perform services, you will be required to pass the client's background, medical and drug screening requirements, which will be done after you have commenced employment and is a condition of your continued employment.
• This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization.
• This position does not include relocation benefits.

Director of Spa

At Fairmont, our passion is to connect our guests to the very best of our destinations. Our hotels and resorts are extraordinary places, and our spas are where guests come to slow down, restore and leave feeling better than when they arrived.

We're looking for a visionary Director of Spa to own that experience from end to end. You'll shape the treatment menu, build and inspire a team of skilled therapists and professionals, and grow the spa into a destination in its own right. If you're a seasoned luxury spa leader who loves both the art of wellness and the business behind it, this is your stage.

What you will be doing:

Reporting to the Hotel Manager, responsibilities and essential job functions include but are not limited to the following:

Lead the team

• Lead all spa, fitness and wellness operations, including office and programming staff, therapists, and independent contractors.
• Recruit, hire, train and develop managers and colleagues. Build a team that understands the expertise each role demands and delivers it with genuine care.
• Coach and motivate your team to perform at their very best, creating a culture of recognition, accountability and growth.
• Design and deliver ongoing training, workshops and seminars so colleagues stay current on technique, product knowledge and Fairmont service standards.

Curate the guest experience

• Develop signature treatments, à la carte services and fitness concepts, including massage, skin care, makeup, hydrotherapy and thalassotherapy, aromatherapy, salon and personal training.
• Balance every program so it is safe, effective and genuinely restorative for spa and resort guests.
• Explore locally inspired, regionally sourced ingredients and products to give treatments a true sense of place.
• Partner with product houses whose treatment concepts translate into great guest results and strong retail sales.
• Uphold service excellence and program integrity across every touchpoint, in line with Fairmont brand and [Forbes/LQA] standards.

Drive the business

• Own the spa budget, revenue forecasts, payroll and labor planning.
• Build efficient schedules for colleagues and contractors that match guest demand in both peak and low occupancy.
• Implement inventory systems, controls and purchasing procedures that protect margins and meet hotel standards.
• Develop administrative and programming procedures, presentation standards and operating guidelines that integrate seamlessly with the wider hotel.

Be the face of the spa

• Partner with Marketing and PR on special events, launches, media visits and brand partner activations.
• Serve as a confident spokesperson with press, high-profile guests and industry partners.

Your experience and skills include:

• A minimum of 4 years managing a full-service luxury resort spa, or 1+ year as a senior leader in luxury spa plus 7 years of hospitality and wellness experience
• Expertise in developing spa treatment and fitness concepts across massage, skin care, makeup, hydrotherapy and thalassotherapy, aromatherapy, salon and fitness

• Polished, confident presence with high-end clientele and the media
• An inspiring leader who brings out the best in people
• Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends and holidays.

What is in it for you:

Visa Requirements: Must provide proof of eligibility to be employed in the United States of America. Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We commit to a future where diverse identities are celebrated, and equitable and inclusive practices are woven into the fabric of everything we do as an organization.

Fairmont Century Plaza is an Equal Opportunity Employer EEO M/F/V/D Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader.
