We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/

jobs.title: Senior Agency Development Lead – LinkedIn Marketing Solutions
jobs.description:
This role will be based in New York.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The Senior Agency Development Lead is accountable for delivering sustainable growth across a defined portfolio of agency customers. The role combines commercial insight and strategic planning with disciplined execution and a strong bias to action, turning opportunities into focused growth plans, mobilizing agency and internal stakeholders, and driving those plans through to measurable customer and business outcomes. Success requires building trusted, multi-threaded relationships across the agency ecosystem, including executive advocacy that creates alignment, commitment and momentum behind shared growth priorities.

This is a role for an individual contributor who is equally comfortable setting strategic direction and executing on the plan. The successful candidate will bring strong judgement, commercial acumen and disciplined execution: simplifying complexity, establishing ownership and milestones, and adapting quickly when required. They will work closely with Field Sales and cross-functional partners, building relationships and advocacy across the agency ecosystem to align stakeholders and accelerate growth where the interests of LinkedIn, our agency partners and our shared clients meet.

Key Responsibilities

• Own sustainable growth across a defined agency portfolio, with accountability for commercial outcomes, product adoption, and customer value.
• Diagnose the largest growth opportunities and translate LinkedIn Marketing Solutions priorities into focused agency and account plans.
• Convert strategy into execution through clear priorities, owners, milestones, measures, and follow-through.
• Build trusted, multi-threaded agency relationships and executive advocacy that drive alignment and commitment to shared growth priorities.
• Partner with Field Sales and cross-functional teams to activate agency influence, accelerate priority accounts, and remove barriers to growth.
• Build agency capabilities, programs, and repeatable motions that scale impact beyond individual engagements.

Growth Strategy and Execution

• Build strategic growth plans that align agency insight, customer priorities, commercial opportunity, and LinkedIn’s strategic priorities into clear outcomes and choices.
• Build executive sponsorship and multi-threaded relationships to secure commitments, navigate complexity, resolve trade-offs, and accelerate growth priorities.
• Lead plans from opportunity identification through activation and measurement, driving sustainable growth.
• Establish an effective operating rhythm across the customer portfolio.
• Move quickly from discussion to action, testing practical interventions and adapting plans based on evidence.
• Maintain high standards of execution and follow-through, ensuring commitments translate into measurable outcomes.
• Develop and activate Joint Partnership Plans that unlock shared growth priorities.
• Mobilize Product, Marketing, Insights & Measurement, Video, Field Sales, Agency Development, and other partners in support of shared outcomes.

Field Sales Partnership and Account Acceleration

• Partner with Field Sales to identify priority agency-influenced growth opportunities and determine where Agency Development can have the greatest impact.
• Co-create account-level agency strategies that broaden stakeholder coverage, move engagement upstream, and connect agency influence to customer decisions.
• Activate the right agency stakeholders across planning, investment, strategy, measurement, analytics, creative, and leadership functions.
• Support full-funnel growth, video adoption, measurement activation, transformational programs, and commercial partnerships aligned to customer opportunity.
• Represent agency insight internally while maintaining accountability for turning insight into action and commercial progress.

Agency Capability and Education

• Diagnose capability gaps that limit adoption or customer value and design focused interventions to address them.
• Develop and implement education, business reviews, product updates, strategic workshops, and other programs tied to specific growth outcomes.
• Adapt narratives and solutions to agency business models, workflows, and decision-making processes.
• Identify successful practices, codify them into reusable playbooks, and drive adoption across agencies and internal teams.
• Use AI to synthesize insights, strengthen customer narratives, improve planning, and increase execution speed and quality.

Industry Leadership and LinkedIn Product Expertise

• Maintain strong knowledge of agency economics, operating models, industry trends, and LinkedIn solutions.
• Translate market and agency intelligence into practical recommendations, growth plays, and go-to-market improvements.
• Bring a credible point of view to senior agency conversations, connecting LinkedIn capabilities to agency strategic and commercial priorities.
• Identify emerging use cases and growth opportunities, testing and scaling those with the strongest potential impact.
• Contribute an agency perspective to internal strategy, product, and commercial discussions.

Success Measures

• Sustainable revenue growth and increased adoption of priority LinkedIn Marketing Solutions across the assigned HoldCo.
• Progress against Joint Business Plans, Agency Level Agreements, commercial frameworks, and priority growth programs.
• Demonstrable contribution to Field Sales opportunities, including agency-influenced pipeline, deal acceleration, and customer outcomes.
• Strong multi-threaded relationships and executive advocacy that drive alignment and execution.
• Operational excellence across account planning, pipeline management, measurement, stakeholder mobilization, and reporting.

Basic qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in marketing, agency, advertising, ad sales, business development, partnerships or a related commercial discipline.
• 5+ years of experience building and executing strategic customer, agency or commercial growth plans.

Preferred qualifications

• Proven track record of owning and delivering commercial growth across a complex matrix of customers
• Strong digital advertising, video, social media, B2B marketing and agency ecosystem expertise.
• Experience building and implementing Joint Business Plans, Agency Level Partnerships, Commercial Agreements or comparable growth frameworks.
• Demonstrated ability to prioritise opportunities, construct executable plans, mobilise stakeholders and maintain momentum through delivery.
• Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Experience building executive advocacy and using it effectively to align stakeholders and advance shared growth priorities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including business case development, concise decision documents and senior stakeholder presentations.
• High degree of judgement, accountability, customer focus, collaboration and operational discipline.

Suggested Skills

• Commercial growth leadership
• Strategic Planning
• Disciplined execution
• Collaboration and Influence
• Executive Relationship building

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Data Product Manager, Identity & Audiences
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
We are seeking an accomplished and visionary Senior Director, Data Product Manager, Identity and Audiences to serve as the connective tissue between our business strategy and the identity data assets that power analytics, data science, and precision marketing across the enterprise. This leadership role is central to our transformation from a reactive, request-driven support function to a strategic, product-driven organization.

You will own the holistic lifecycle of identity-resolved and AI-ready audience data products. Operating either on Databricks/Snowflake, you will translate enterprise growth priorities into actionable data products, orchestrate identity resolution frameworks via premium partners, and manage enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. This role ensures high-value, privacy-safe audience segments are continuously optimized and available for the demand teams at Peacock and our global cross-business units.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Intake & Roadmap Execution

• Strategic Roadmap & Governance: Partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional strategy teams to translate high-level business objectives into a prioritized, enterprise-wide audience roadmap. Act as a core strategic layer ensuring data product development directly aligns with overarching corporate growth goals.

• Intake Management & Prioritization: Establish and enforce a rigorous governance framework for all incoming data partnership and audience requests. Implement a structured intake process to successfully balance urgent business needs while protecting the core product roadmap and driving scalable, long-term outcomes.

Product Unit Leadership & Sprint Delivery

• Team Leadership: Lead cross-functional agile teams of engineers, analysts, and quality specialists to ensure structured, scalable product delivery.

• Sprint Management: Oversee continuous sprint cycles to efficiently build, iterate, and maintain core identity schemas and audience data products.

Codifying the Data Product Standard

• Enforce Product Discipline: Apply the enterprise Data Product Standard to all audience assets, ensuring every segment and graph has a named owner, formal documentation, a clear consumer registry, and defined success metrics.

• Manage Product Lifecycle: Explicitly track and manage the lifecycle stages of audience data products—from active development and stable maintenance to strategic sunsetting.

Identity & Ecosystem Partnerships

• Existing Framework Management: Partner across teams to optimize and maximize our existing enterprise identity framework, bringing deep expertise to ensure a data-driven strategy rooted in a robust deterministic graph.

• Partner Data Ingestion: Design ingestion and mapping strategies to transform data from premium distribution, CTV, and content platforms into compliant, productized tables within Databricks/Snowflake.

• Commercialization & Value Strategy: Leverage the unified identity framework to determine which proprietary audience data products to build, maximizing media trading opportunities and commercial yield for internal demand teams.

Proactive Data Quality & Governance

• Data Contracts: Define and enforce clear data contracts covering freshness, completeness, accuracy, and schema stability as a core product responsibility.

• Proactive Monitoring: Implement automated monitoring and alerting to isolate and resolve data quality incidents before they impact downstream stakeholders.

• Privacy & Compliance: Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure all identity resolution and data clean room operations strictly adhere to global privacy regulations.

• Professional Experience: 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in data product management, ad tech/martech strategy, or data architecture.

• Product Management Discipline: Proven track record of successfully evolving data organizations from reactive request models into structured, agile product delivery frameworks.

• Identity Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of identity resolution ecosystems and data clean rooms, with specific experience optimizing deterministic graph models.

• Data Platforms & CDPs: Strategic and hands-on experience utilizing Databricks/Snowflake for data sharing and data product creation, alongside strong command of enterprise Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).

• Media Ecosystem Knowledge: Robust understanding of streaming, digital, and linear media landscapes, with experience integrating complex external data partner and platform datasets.

• Technical & Commercial Acumen: High data literacy, including proficiency in data modeling concepts to effectively guide engineering teams, combined with the business acumen to turn complex data into commercial media products.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a business or technical field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Additional Requirements

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Beginning January 5, 2026, hybrid employees will be required to work from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process.
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care.
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals.
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care.
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels.
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient.
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment.

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible.
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care.
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ.
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measurable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner.
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods.
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings.
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed.
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals.
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care.
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off.
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice.

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own.

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge.
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care.
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients.

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on a Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level.
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments.
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice.
• Serves as a community mentor for team members.
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members.
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance.
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence.
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e., Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements.
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit-based quality committees.
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals.
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications.
• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources.
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations.

Preferred:

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - Willow Grove, PA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute as a team member to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Assist in setting-up, performing, monitoring sedation and surgical anesthesia with LVT or DVM supervision.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and maintaining urinary catheters and nasal oxygen tubes, and

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

• Work alongside licensed veterinary technicians as a vital member of the nursing care team.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as veterinary technician credentialing, trainer role, community outreach, and leadership.

Veterinary Assistants can additionally (where permitted by law):

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Insurance Product Filings (Remote, USA)
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Insurance Product Filings

Open to: Remote, USA

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

Getting an AI-driven risk model into the market means getting it approved across 51 jurisdictions. As Senior Manager, Insurance Product Filings, you will own that work end to end: preparing and submitting multistate filings, writing the model documentation regulators expect from an AI-driven modeling company, resolving objections and interrogatories, and maintaining the licenses and reporting obligations that come with operating as a rating and advisory organization. You will also partner directly with carrier clients, supporting them through their own filings and translating state requirements into practical guidance.

The target start date is Q1 2027. The role is posted at the Senior Manager level; final title and level will be determined by the experience of the selected candidate.

The Opportunity:

• Draft, file, and defend AI and predictive model filings in SERFF from drafting through approval, including model checklists, methodology narratives, validation summaries, and variable justifications that show how ZestyAI models differ from legacy approaches

• Lead objection and interrogatory responses, coordinating with data science, actuarial, product, and outside counsel to close out state inquiries on schedule

• Help scale the regulatory function as ZestyAI's models and state footprint grow, building the processes, tools, and standards that keep multistate filing repeatable as volume expands

• Support carrier clients on rate and underwriting filings that use ZestyAI models, including department questions, and represent ZestyAI in client meetings and working sessions

• Monitor state requirements, bulletins, and department posture, and turn them into internal guidance and client updates

• Iterate rapidly in a fast-paced, business-driven environment

What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:

• 6+ years of U.S. P&C insurance industry experience in regulatory affairs, compliance, product management, actuarial, or a related discipline, gained at a carrier, rating or advisory organization, department of insurance, or filing consultancy

• Hands-on ownership of multistate P&C rate, rule, and form filings in SERFF from drafting through approval, including writing objection responses and resolving them directly with department analysts and actuaries

• Fluency with AI tools such as Claude as a core part of your daily workflow, including building the prompts, templates, and tooling that let a small team operate across 51 jurisdictions

• Working fluency with rating plans, rate and rule manuals, class plans, and the actuarial support that accompanies them

• Strong persuasive technical writing under deadline, including turning technical and statistical documentation into a filing narrative a regulator will accept

• Polish and composure with external audiences, including carrier clients, department staff, and industry groups

• Judgment to own a workstream independently and to know what to escalate and when

• Bachelor's degree; must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to Have:

• Actuarial designation strongly preferred (ACAS or FCAS, or substantial exam progress); CPCU, ARM, AINS, or actuarial coursework also valued

• Experience filing predictive, machine learning, or catastrophe models and responding to model governance or third-party model review requirements

• Familiarity with NAIC model laws, bulletins, and workstreams related to AI and third-party data and models

• Experience building AI-assisted workflows, prompts, or agents that others have adopted

• Prior experience at a rating, advisory, or statistical organization, or managing outside filing consultants, actuarial consultants, or regulatory counsel

• Personal or commercial property insurance background

Why ZestyAI:

• Be part of a well-funded growth-stage company

• Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future

• Comprehensive health care plan and Flexible Time Off

• An upbeat, collaborative culture with company-sponsored outings and offsites

jobs.title: Principal Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.



At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.



The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.



We’re looking for a Principal Technical Account Manager to join our Support team in Client Engagement.

In this role, you’ll turn inbound customer activity into clear action, stronger operations, and better customer outcomes. You’ll sit at the intersection of Client Engagement, Product, and Engineering, helping triage complex issues, identify patterns and opportunities, and connect support activity to broader projects and strategic initiatives already in motion. You’ll also serve as a key voice of the customer, helping the business understand what customers are experiencing and where we can improve.

This is a role for someone who sees support tickets and customer feedback as signals, not just tasks. You’re curious, organized, operationally sharp, and a natural problem solver who knows how to separate what matters from the noise, when to escalate, and which teams need to be involved. You’re comfortable using AI to move faster and improve your output, but you bring the critical thinking, emotional intelligence, situational judgment, and follow-through that AI cannot replace.

Candidates should be strong communicators who are comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities and context shift quickly and clear ownership matters.




SOME OF THE WORK YOU’LL OWN:

🧭 Distill and triage complex issues with strong judgment.
Understand what is being reported, clarify the actual problem, gather the right context, and determine whether it needs deeper investigation, escalation, or connection to an existing project or workstream.

🚦 Act as an air traffic controller across the organization.
Route issues with clear context, urgency, and recommended next steps while balancing multiple priorities. Know when to escalate, when to dig deeper, when to ask for help, and when to keep things moving.

🔎 Turn inbound activity into useful signals and value-driving opportunities.
Look across tickets, customer questions, escalations, and support trends to identify recurring themes, emerging issues, client friction, process gaps, product opportunities, and operational patterns.

🔗 Connect activity to broader projects and priorities.
Stay aware of active launches, client initiatives, product changes, known issues, and operational workstreams so support activity does not live in a vacuum.

🤝 Support Program Managers and project teams.
Help Program Managers and cross-functional teams stay connected to support activity that may impact active projects, launches, or strategic initiatives. Provide support on strategic projects as needed.

📋 Strengthen the support operating model.
Help build and maintain the processes, documentation, dashboards, workflows, and feedback loops that make support operations more consistent, reliable, and scalable.




HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:

🔍 Help the organization understand what support is telling us.
Surface trends, risks, and recurring friction early so teams can make better product, process, and client decisions.

🤝 Create trust across teams.
Client Engagement, Product, and Engineering need to trust your read on what matters. You’ll earn that trust by being clear, organized, thoughtful, and precise.

📈 Move support beyond reactive ticket resolution.
Help turn support into an operational feedback loop that improves product quality, client experience, internal process, and team focus.

🧠 Improve the quality of handoffs and escalations.
Make sure teams receive the background, examples, impact, urgency, and recommended next step they need to act quickly and confidently.

🛠️ Build systems that make the team smarter.
Create and maintain internal knowledge, support playbooks, routing logic, issue summaries, and process documentation that help the team improve over time.

⚖️ Bring clarity when everything feels urgent.
Help the team distinguish what needs immediate action, what needs monitoring, and what should be grouped into broader improvement work.




YOU’LL PROBABLY THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

🔎 Are naturally curious and investigative.
You like digging into messy problems, asking better questions, and figuring out what is actually happening beneath the surface.

🧠 Can solve problems without a script.
You’re comfortable working through ambiguous, unfamiliar, or messy issues where the next step is not obvious. You can form a hypothesis, test it, pull in the right context, and keep moving without waiting for a playbook.

🧭 Have strong operational judgment.
You understand how work moves through a fast-moving company. You know when to escalate, when to gather more context, when to involve another team, and when to keep something contained.

💬 Communicate clearly and practically.
You can write concise ticket summaries, escalation notes, internal updates, and follow-ups that help people act quickly.

🛠️ Are comfortable being technical-adjacent.
You do not need to be an engineer, but you should understand product behavior, technical constraints, logs or screenshots, user workflows, and enough system context to ask smart questions.

🔄 Can context switch without losing the plot.
You can move between customers, issues, teams, and priorities while staying clear on what matters, who owns what, and what needs to happen next.

🤖 Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.
You are excited to use AI tools to improve speed, synthesis, and quality, but you know that strong judgment, accountability, and context still need to come from you.

🧩 Look for better ways to solve the underlying problem.
You are not limited to “close the ticket and move on.” You look for ways to reduce repeat work, improve the process, and make the system around the issue better.



Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

jobs.title: Vice President, Product, Entertainment Experience
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
The Vice President of Product, Entertainment Experience is tasked with driving the vision and success of four key areas, to help reimagine streaming for the next generation of fans:

• Discovery: Rethinking the end-to-end discovery experience of how users find and decide what to watch or play next, leveraging Gen AI’s deep understanding of our content and our key customer cohorts
• Playback: Innovating within playback and in the experience of live sports, movies and TV shows, to deepen engagement and create the best possible fan experience
• Mobile Entertainment: Creating differentiated mobile experiences that offer users compelling new forms of engagement beyond streaming - from games to podcasts - including by partnering with startups and third parties
• Devices: Optimizing the user experience across platforms, and leaning into capabilities and user expectations for discovery, interaction and playback on different devices, including the next generation of AR/VR devices

We are looking for an experienced and versatile product leader who can be strategic while also developing a growing product team in a competitive consumer landscape. A successful candidate will be creative to look at problems in new ways, disciplined in using experiments and proof of concepts to validate hypotheses, collaborative to get things done across a matrixed organization, including wider Comcast and Sky businesses, and an excellent communicator.

This role will lead a team of ~20 product managers, report to the SVP of Product and UX, and partner closely with teams across the organization to increase engagement (e.g. watch time per user, frequency, viewing diversity) across our customer base.

In this role, you will:

• Set a vision and strategy for how users engage with Peacock across all devices (TV, mobile, web, next generation devices), through a mix of new features, enhancements, and innovations.
• Manage, mentor, and motivate a growing team of product managers focused on the above areas, and align them around a shared vision and goals.
• Have a keen sense for good UX/design and the ability to make evidenced-based decisions using consumer insights, product analytics, competitive and market analysis.
• Collaborate with product design, merchandizing, data, marketing, content, and strategy teams to develop holistic points of view, and confidently make product decisions.
• Partner with project management and technology teams in the US and Europe to set roadmaps and deliver high quality products.
• Ability to translate the complex into simple and make compelling executive presentations and demos that explain product vision and strategy.
• Make business cases for incremental product investment that drives innovation.
• Build product features that can scale and adapt to global market needs and territory specific requirements.
• Partner with Personalization teams to drive maximum engagement and Ad Innovation teams to ensure we best monetize viewing feature opportunities.
• Help build a product culture at Peacock and inspire the next generation of product leaders.

• Minimum of 15 years of product strategy/management experience within the media or consumer technology space
• Minimum of 8 years successfully leading a team of customer centric product managers
• Experience in content streaming strongly preferred
• Consumer-centric view with a proven track-record of developing and acting on customer insights
• Significant experience with A/B testing, hypothesis validation, user testing, and analytics
• Track record of successfully operating within a highly matrixed work environment, managing multiple stakeholders
• Experience building products across multiple platforms (iOS, tvOS, Android, Roku, Amazon)
• Ability and self-motivation to work effectively offsite and onsite and with global, multi-lingual teams
• Ability to lead and inspire alignment to a shared vision and outcome through collaboration
• Strong analytics skills and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving
• Proven ability to be flexible and quickly adapt to changing priorities, with tight deadlines, balancing short term progress with long term thinking
• Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
• BA/BS degree in relevant field is highly desired

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $220,000 - $325,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

jobs.title: Product Security & Business Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

At Mariner, we’re building the next generation of secure, AI-enabled business platforms—and we’re looking for an experienced Product Security & Business Enablement Lead to join us. In this role, you’ll be the key technical security partner to our business, product, data, and engineering teams, working at the intersection of innovation, technology, and risk management. You’ll help deliver new capabilities safely by embedding security early into product roadmaps and designs, ensuring security not only protects—but also empowers—the business.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work side-by-side with product, engineering, architecture, and data leaders to shape secure solutions from the outset, reducing friction and enabling timely business outcomes.

 - Assess the security of Mariner’s composite business platforms—including SaaS applications, custom-built tools, API integrations, data flows, and AI features—by identifying trust boundaries, sensitive data, and key risks.

 - Facilitate architecture and threat reviews with delivery teams; help them make informed security decisions and document outcomes.

 - Build and maintain a library of practical, reusable secure-by-design patterns for SaaS, APIs, integrations, data movement, credentials, authorization, and AI-enabled workflows.

 - Translate complex security requirements into clear, actionable designs that don’t stall progress or rely on late-stage review.

 - Advocate for security in vendor evaluation and SaaS selection, assessing posture, identity, integrations, and data residency alongside our enterprise and procurement teams.

 - Collaborate with Security Platform Engineering to deliver self-service security capabilities, automated guardrails, and workflows that support the business at scale.

 - Partner with Identity & Access and Infrastructure to ensure robust authentication, authorization, and posture management across all user and agent touchpoints.

 - Support AI-enabled products and workflows, establishing security for data boundaries, tool access, prompt risks, and audit controls in line with enterprise AI governance.

 - Provide security expertise for enterprise data strategy, product onboarding, M&A activity, and technology adoption by defining practical patterns for secure data flows and integrations.

 - Be a visible, trusted advisor through regular office hours and embedded team engagement, mentoring teams so they can make sound, informed decisions without waiting on approvals.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent experience.

 - 8+ years of experience across security architecture, cloud/SaaS security, solutions architecture, engineering, or SRE/DevOps, with at least 4 years in a dedicated security role.

 - Deep experience designing or securing distributed systems comprised of SaaS, APIs, custom applications, data integrations, and third-party services.

 - Proven ability to analyze unfamiliar architectures quickly, identify security gaps, and guide practical solutions.

 - Strong partnership skills—able to work directly with business, engineering, data, and architecture leaders.

 - Evidence of adapting security requirements in light of business needs, with clear articulation of tradeoffs made.

Bonus Points For

 - Hands-on engineering or architecture background plus business-facing experience (e.g., solutions architect, technical product leader, or engineer who shifted focus to security).

 - Success changing perceptions of security from a business obstacle to an enabler.

 - Experience with SaaS- and integration-heavy environments or AI-enabled workflows.

 - Familiarity with data security concepts (classification, DLP, encryption, data lineage, governance, etc.).

 - Background in financial services, wealth management, regulated environments, or supporting M&A-driven technology integration.

 - Security certifications (CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, cloud security) are valued but not required—demonstrated design and influence matter most.

 


WHAT SETS YOU APART

 - Systems-thinking and technical depth across SaaS, APIs, cloud, integrations, data, and AI workflows.

 - Ability to connect business objectives to technical risk, controls, and pragmatic solutions—fast.

 - Strong communication, facilitation, and documentation skills; credible with both engineers and executives.

 - A practical, enablement-focused security mindset—comfortable prioritizing material risks and enabling the business instead of defaulting to red tape.

 - Adaptability and curiosity to navigate evolving technology landscapes with incomplete information.

 


LEADERSHIP & GROWTH

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence and the chance to provide mentorship and technical leadership. As Mariner and the team grow, direct leadership opportunities may arise.

 


WHY MARINER?

Join a fast-moving company where security is a business partner, not an obstacle. You’ll work on diverse platforms shaping the secure future of financial innovation—supported by collaborative, forward-thinking teams.

 

Ready to make a real impact? Apply now to help us securely enable Mariner’s future business capabilities.

We welcome your interest in being a part of our firm. We believe in giving associates progressive opportunities, actively nurturing professional growth and giving back to the community. We are dedicated to building a diverse culture where everyone has the support they need to achieve their career goals. We offer an innovative workplace and a culture that fosters camaraderie, teamwork and work-life balance.


By submitting your application, you agree to the collection and use of your personal information as described in our Employee and Applicant Privacy Notice https://www.marinerwealthadvisors.com/mariner-employee-applicant-privacy-notice/.

EOE M/F/D/V

jobs.title: Group Sales Director
jobs.description:
The Group Sales Director leads group sales strategy, business development, and team performance for Westgate River Ranch Resort & Rodeo. This role is accountable for achieving room night, event, food and beverage, and total group revenue goals by developing corporate, association, government, incentive, SMERF, wedding, and experiential group markets. The Director manages key accounts, pipeline activity, forecasting, contract negotiations, and market strategy while partnering with Revenue Management, Resort Operations, Food & Beverage, Activities, and Event Services to deliver distinctive programs that showcase the resort’s Western hospitality, outdoor recreation, glamping accommodations, rodeo experiences, and event venues.

What You'll Do:

Sales Strategy and Revenue Performance

• Develop and execute annual and quarterly group sales strategies aligned with resort revenue, room night production, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and profitability objectives.
• Identify, prospect, negotiate, and close new group business opportunities across corporate meetings, incentive travel programs, association conferences, government groups, destination weddings, sports teams, reunions, social groups, and special events.
• Drive group sales production, conversion rates, pipeline development, lead generation, booking pace, and revenue forecasting accuracy.
• Collaborate with Revenue Management and Resort Leadership regarding group pricing strategies, inventory management, need dates, concessions, displacement analysis, and yield management initiatives.
• Analyze hospitality market trends, competitor activity, booking patterns, demand forecasts, and account performance to identify revenue growth opportunities.
• Implement targeted business development plans, account growth strategies, and sales campaigns designed to increase new business acquisition, repeat bookings, and total resort spend.

Business Development and Client Relationships

• Develop and maintain relationships with meeting planners, event organizers, corporate decision-makers, third-party planners, destination marketing organizations, convention and visitors bureaus, travel partners, and industry associations.
• Manage strategic accounts through account planning, contract renewals, client retention programs, revenue reviews, and long-term partnership development.
• Respond promptly to hotel and resort RFPs from national sales organizations, corporate clients, association planners, destination partners, referrals, and digital lead channels.
• Conduct site tours, resort presentations, familiarization trips, planning visits, and client events that effectively showcase resort amenities, meeting space, guest accommodations, and event capabilities.
• Represent the resort at trade shows, hospitality conferences, networking events, industry associations, and sales missions.
• Build collaborative relationships with local hotels, resorts, lodging providers, and destination partners to support overflow opportunities and destination-wide events.

Contracting and Program Partnership

jobs.title: Director, UCC & Tax Lien Compliance
jobs.description:
At Toast, we are passionate about creating raving fans and delivering an unparalleled customer experience — and that includes assisting our restaurant customers when their business becomes entangled in a creditor dispute. When a lien, levy, or garnishment is filed against a merchant, our customers need a partner who moves quickly, communicates clearly, and gets it right the first time. As Toast brings the end-to-end management of liens and levies in-house, we need an experienced subject matter expert to build and lead this function from the ground up.

As the Director, UCC & Tax Lien Compliance, you will own the day-to-day operational management of Toast's merchant liens and levies and bankruptcy compliance programs, build the specialized team and processes required to run it well, and lead the insourcing of this function in close partnership with Compliance, Care, Product and Engineering and Legal. This is a hands-on, build-it role: you'll inherit an active, high-visibility function with real customer and compliance stakes, and you'll be the person who turns it into a well-governed, scalable operation.

About this role

Strategic Ownership

• Build and maintain a state-by-state policy framework.

• Build the governance backbone for the function: SOPs, decision frameworks, case tracking, and closed-loop quality review, so that policy is applied consistently across the team and holds up to audit and legal scrutiny.

• Determine the right tools and systems required to manage an effective Liens & Levies compliance process, work with product and impacted stakeholders to minimize losses to Toast.

• Own the phased liens and levies compliance transition plan with Toast's third-party partner, including data-sharing, visibility, and handoff of withholding and remittance responsibilities.

• Establish and own the escalation path for complex or high-risk cases (e.g., competing creditor claims, disputed releases, bankruptcy proceedings, fraudulent or ambiguous documentation), partnering with Risk, Legal, and third-party fintech partners (e.g., payment processors) to reach sound, consistent decisions.

• Define and track operational KPIs (e.g., resolution time, case volume, escalation rates) and report progress and risk to cross-functional and executive stakeholders.

Operational Ownership

• Own the day-to-day management and execution of Toast's merchant liens and levies compliance program, including customer communications, intake, validation, withholding, escalations, complex/unique scenario handling, remittance, and release, serving as the subject matter expert to bring and operate this function in-house.

• Drive the operational process work required to insource the liens and levies compliance functions currently managed by a third-party partner, including business requirements, workflow design, and transition sequencing, in partnership with Fintech Product, Engineering, Legal and other cross-functional stakeholders.

• Build and lead a dedicated liens & levies oversight team within Fintech Risk, defining roles, workflows, staffing needs, and training as case volume scales.

• Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on handling liens, levies, garnishments, and similar legal orders — including UCC filings, judgment liens, tax levies, bankruptcy implications, lien priority, and change-of-ownership/change-of-legal-entity scenarios — and translate that expertise into developing, owning, and maintaining clear, defensible policies, procedures and processes.

• Represent the team in cross-functional planning with Legal, Fintech, and Engineering as the technical build (case management, funds management, and reporting systems) is scoped and delivered.

Do you have the right ingredients?

• 7+ years of experience working with UCC and tax liens, levies, bankruptcies, and garnishments and the associated compliance requirements, as well as change and people leadership experience.

• Experience developing compliance management programs for regulated functions.

• Experience managing complex, sensitive escalations directly with customers, creditors, and their attorneys, exercising sound judgment on matters with real legal and financial consequences.

• Deep subject matter expertise in the mechanics, legal/regulatory distinctions, and compliance requirements applicable to different types of liens, levies, and garnishments — including UCC-1 filings, judgment liens, tax levies, and lien priority–and how each is impacted by different events impacting merchants, such as bankruptcy, business organizational changes (e.g., change of ownership and mergers/acquisitions), and know your customers (KYC)/know your business (KYB) requirements and events.

• Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape surrounding merchant funds handling, such as state-by-state garnishment and levy requirements, and money transmission/payment facilitator obligations, and strong knowledge of UCC Article 9 concepts as they apply to secured creditor claims.

• Demonstrated ability to build an operating model, team, and governance structure where none previously existed, with comfort operating in ambiguity while a function transitions between partners and systems.

• Proven cross-functional leadership skills — able to align Legal, Risk & Compliance, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Care around a shared process and drive decisions to closure without direct authority over every stakeholder.

• Experience managing a vendor or partner transition (e.g., insourcing a previously outsourced function), including defining business requirements and partnering with technical teams on system design.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal/operational nuance into clear guidance for frontline teams and concise updates for executive stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; a background in banking operations, legal/paralegal work, or compliance is a plus but not required.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A

$190,000—$304,000 USD

Zone B

$165,000—$264,000 USD

Zone C

$149,000—$238,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

jobs.title: Lead Maintenance Technician - 3300 Tamarac
jobs.description:
With over 30 years of experience in the acquisition, development, rehabilitation, and management of apartment communities across the Western United States, we are a trusted partner in the real estate investment and property management industry. At MG Properties, we focus on enriching lives – physically in our community buildings, philanthropically through giving back to our local communities, and through development and growth of our employees.

Are you looking for a new and exciting opportunity with a growing company?

We are a large regional property management firm looking for an experienced Lead Maintenance Technician to join our team at our 3300 Tamarac Apartments in Denver, CO!

The ideal candidate will have experience in all trades and be very customer service focused. Some duties will include cleaning grounds, offices, common areas, completing maintenance service requests, appliance repairs, painting, apartment turnovers, taking emergency calls and more!

General Functions:

Responsible for maintaining the physical integrity of the community at all times.  This involves insuring a safe and secure living environment for residents, visitors and staff.  It is the Maintenance Lead’s duty to anticipate, identify and correct any and all problems involving the property and to implement procedures that will prevent such problems.  An effective program of maintenance is essential in order to:

• Maintain a safe environment.

• Cultivate resident satisfaction.

• Protect the investment of the apartment property owner.

RESIDENT SERVICE

• Performs maintenance tasks personally or delegates to Maintenance Technicians.

• Oversees and occasionally inspects work performed by Maintenance Technicians.

• Institutes and manages system for handling resident service requests. Corrects situations within 24 hours when possible.

• Assists the Maintenance Supervisor in coordinating and directing the maintenance staff and schedules maintenance personnel in conjunction with manager so that maintenance is available for emergency purposes, 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE/SAFETY

• Conducts regularly scheduled safety meetings with entire staff; maintains and communicates HAZCOM standards. Keeps SDS sheets current and readily accessible. Maintains thorough knowledge of pertinent laws and EPA and OSHA regulations governing property storage and management of hazardous materials, including solvents, flammables, caustics and refrigerants.

• Must be aware of the condition of physical property throughout the community and immediately correct unsafe conditions; e.g., broken gates leading to the pool, broken steps, open holes, broken/burned out exterior lights.

• Maintains accurate records regarding preventive maintenance, service requests (received and completed), expenditures, apartment make-ready status, work-in-progress, etc.

• Schedules and performs minor and routine maintenance on all appropriate equipment on a regular basis. Inspects and maintains all tools in excellent condition.

• Indoctrinates and assists in development of all subordinate maintenance staff. Instills a "safety first" attitude not only with maintenance technicians but with all staff.

• Instructs staff on proper use and guidelines for wearing safety items.

GENERAL

• Diagnoses and performs minor and routine maintenance and repair in assigned areas.

• Ensures that all make-ready repairs and services are completed correctly and on schedule.

• Reports all major repairs and requisitions to manager prior to any expenditure of funds.

• Changes locks and makes keys.

• Removes and transfers heavy appliances and equipment from storage area to apartment (or vice versa) as circumstances warrant. Assists in moving abandoned furniture, appliances, etc., to dumpster when necessary.

• Maintains adequate inventory of spare parts and maintenance materials to handle most common repairs and situations.

• Identifies all utility meter cut-offs, apartment and fixture cut-offs, sewer cleanouts and prepares maps indicating same.

• Performs work area clean-up and safety related duties.

• Ensures that storage areas remain locked when not in use.

• Assists in keeping grounds neat and free of litter. Rakes, sweeps, shovels as circumstances warrant.

• Assists with disturbances and other property emergencies during business hours.

• Performs any additional duties assigned by manager or property supervisor.

Knowledge, Experience, Educational Requirements:

• Position requires at least two years’ experience in property maintenance or equivalent field.

• Able to maintain adequate inventory to minimize any disruption of operating the business.

• Able to schedule effectively to maximize team member’s strengths and contractor efficiency.

• High School Graduate or Equivalent Training (If not, must have 5 years maintenance experience.)

• Valid Driver’s License with proof of current liability insurance.

• Knowledge of Basic Mechanical Concepts

• Heating and Air Conditioning and other State Regulated Certifications where required.

• CPO Certified – HVAC Certification Universal preferred.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to lift 50 pounds without difficulty.

• Work performed both outdoors and indoors.

• Significant amount of bending and reaching daily.

• Must wear necessary safety attire and/or use appropriate equipment/tools.

Qualifications

* Prefer at least 2 years experience in apartment maintenance on 200 unit property!

* Experience in all trades (plumbing, electrical, a/c, etc.) a must!

* Customer service attitude, flexibility and the ability to work in a team environment are key to making this position a success!

* Reliable transportation is a MUST!

* Availability to work on-call rotation.

Compensation and Benefits

• $28-$30/hour DOE

• Monthly bonuses

• Company profit sharing

• Accrues 10 days Paid time off per year

• 9 Paid Holidays and 2 Paid Personal Days per year

• 48 Hours of Paid Sick Time

• 401K with employer match

• Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program

• Life Insurance

• Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Spending Account

• Rental Discounts

Position anticipated to be filled November 2026

jobs.description:

You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
