jobs.title: Tax Manager – Office Lead (Principal in Charge)
jobs.description:
We are toogeza, a Ukrainian recruiting company focused on hiring talent and building teams for tech startups worldwide. People make a difference in the big game, and we may help find the right ones. Currently, we are looking for a Tax Manager – Office Lead (Principal in Charge) for Numica.


Numica is a venture-backed accounting technology company building a modern alternative to the traditional accounting firm model. The company acquires established local CPA practices from retiring owners and helps them grow through better technology, AI-assisted workflows, operational support, and access to the resources of a larger organization.

Rather than rebuilding these firms from scratch, Numica keeps the client relationships, teams, and local expertise that made each practice successful, while introducing modern tools and processes that reduce repetitive work and allow accountants to spend more time on judgment, advisory, and client relationships.


The company is growing quickly through acquisitions across the U.S. and already serves thousands of clients across New York, New Jersey, Florida, and other markets.

This position is Sacramento-based. The role requires primarily onsite presence during the initial transition period, with the possibility of a more flexible or hybrid setup once the practice is established.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Step in as the principal in charge of an established accounting practice with an existing book of loyal clients and an experienced team already in place — backed by the capital, technology, and operational support of a growing platform.

You are not building a practice from a cold start. You are taking the helm of a real business, preserving what already works, strengthening client relationships, developing the team, and helping the practice transition to a more modern and efficient operating model.

This is a true player-coach role. You will own the practice’s clients, quality, delivery, and people day to day, while remaining hands-on with tax work where senior judgment and expertise are needed.

Depending on your experience, the scope may start with one practice and expand to multiple offices over time.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the practice as Principal in Charge — own its clients, quality, delivery, people, and overall performance.

 - Manage and develop the team — supervise day-to-day work, review deliverables, coach staff, provide feedback, and support their professional growth.

 - Own client relationships — become the trusted advisor clients rely on through the ownership transition and beyond.

 - Review and sign off on tax work as the senior technical authority across business and individual clients.

 - Stay hands-on where your expertise matters most — including tax review, planning, advisory, and complex client situations.

 - Protect and grow the client base — maintain strong retention and client satisfaction while ensuring continuity through the transition.

 - Improve operational efficiency — help implement better workflows, processes, and technology across the practice.

 - Drive technology adoption — work with Numica’s internal team to introduce modern, AI-assisted tools that reduce repetitive work and allow accountants to spend more time on judgment and client advisory.

 - Take ownership of the team structure — identify where additional resources are needed, participate in hiring, and make changes as the practice evolves.

 - Partner on future growth — over time, contribute to business development, referrals, upselling, and broader growth initiatives with support from the wider Numica organization.

For more senior candidates, there is an opportunity to take responsibility for multiple nearby practices and grow into a broader regional leadership role.



WHAT YOU BRING

 - Active CPA strongly preferred; experienced EAs will also be considered.

 - Several years of public accounting and tax experience, ideally working directly with small and mid-sized businesses, closely held companies, business owners, and individual clients.

 - Strong tax expertise across areas such as:
   
   - Individual tax
   
   - Partnerships
   
   - S Corporations
   
   - C Corporations
   
   - Tax planning and advisory

 - Familiarity with common U.S. tax returns such as 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120S.

 - Experience owning client relationships, onboarding clients, advising business owners, and handling complex client conversations.

 - Experience leading, supervising, or mentoring accountants, bookkeepers, or tax staff. Formal people-management responsibility is preferred but not mandatory for exceptional step-up candidates.

 - Comfort remaining hands-on through busy season — this is not a purely managerial role.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with both clients and team members.

 - A high level of ownership, independence, and agency — you are comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

 - A tech-forward mindset and openness to learning new systems and working in an increasingly AI-assisted accounting environment.

Experience with tax software such as UltraTax, ProSeries, Drake, or Lacerte is helpful, but not required. Strong accounting fundamentals and adaptability are more important than experience with a particular platform.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is flexible and depends on experience, location, and scope of responsibility.

 - Base compensation can range approximately from $100,000 to $200,000+ annually.

 - For an exceptional senior candidate capable of overseeing multiple the Sacramento area or broader California region, compensation above this range may be considered.

 - Performance-based bonuses may be tied to client retention, client satisfaction, operational performance, and future growth.

 - Continuing education and CPA/EA license support.

 - Paid training and professional development.

 - Paid time off.

 - Flexible schedule as the practice becomes established.

 - Potential hybrid / work-from-home flexibility after the initial transition period.

 - 401(k) and health insurance may be available depending on the individual employment arrangement.
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

During the first 6–12 months, success will primarily be measured across three areas:

 - Client retention — maintaining the existing client base through the ownership transition.

 - Client satisfaction — ensuring clients continue to receive high-quality, trusted service.

 - Technology adoption and operational efficiency — successfully implementing new workflows and tools while improving how the practice operates.
   


GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

Numica continues to acquire accounting practices across the U.S., creating a much faster leadership path than the traditional accounting-firm model.

A strong Office Lead can grow from managing one practice to several offices, and potentially to responsibility for a much larger regional portfolio.

The growth path is driven by performance, leadership capability, and ambition rather than tenure alone.

If this role sounds like a fit — we’d love to hear from you! Just send over your CV and anything else you’d like us to consider.

We’ll review everything within five working days, and if your background matches what we’re looking for, we’ll get in touch to set up a call and get to know each other better.

Mercury is building radically different banking and offering a complete finance stack for startups and business owners. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs’ and business owners’ financial lives. At Mercury, compliance is a strategic function. We have a modern approach where teams move fast and compliance provides the frameworks, systems, and regulatory expertise that make that speed sustainable while protecting our customers and earning their trust.

We're hiring a Senior Manager, Compliance Governance to lead the core programs of Mercury's Compliance Management System: compliance risk assessment, enterprise policy governance, enterprise compliance training, and compliance reporting, along with oversight of compliance issues. This leader will mature these programs to meet the expectations of a regulated bank and lead them through regulatory examinations. Mercury has obtained a provisional national bank charter and is currently building towards final approval.

This role is well-suited for someone who knows what regulators expect from a CMS and can adapt established frameworks to how Mercury actually operates. The individual will lead a team of compliance professionals, be a key leader within Mercury's Compliance team, and operate in a highly collaborative environment. The role involves especially close coordination across the Compliance function, with partnership with Enterprise Risk, Legal, Internal Audit, executive leadership, and our banking* partners.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the Compliance Governance team: set priorities, hold a high bar, and develop your team’s capabilities.

• Own the compliance risk assessment, including methodology, execution, and alignment with Mercury's enterprise risk framework.

• Own enterprise policy governance: the policy lifecycle, standards, and ownership across Mercury.

• Own enterprise compliance training: a risk-based curriculum that measures whether training works, not just whether people completed it.

• Oversee compliance issues within Mercury's enterprise issues management program, partnering with Enterprise Risk Management on identification, remediation, and validation.

• Design and deliver compliance reporting to executive leadership and governance committees, with metrics that show whether programs are working.

• Support exam and audit readiness for the CMS.

• Provide credible challenge across the business and escalate when it's warranted.

• Use technology and automation to make governance programs scalable, measurable, and less manual.

• Partner across Compliance (Advisory, Oversight & Monitoring, Financial Crimes) and with Risk, Legal, and Internal Audit.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in compliance or risk management at a fintech, bank, or other regulated financial institution, including 3+ years leading teams

• Hands-on experience owning core CMS components, such as compliance risk assessment, policy governance, training, compliance reporting, or issues management

• Experience leading or playing a central role in regulatory examinations, including managing requests, engaging with examiners, and responding to findings

• Must have reliable, responsible, and dependable attendance

• Must be 21 years or older

• Must pass all required background checks including state-specific cannabis employment requirements

• Possess valid driver’s license or state ID

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the cannabis industry

• Prior cannabis experience not required

Additional Requirements

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday)

• Move about the dispensary to fulfill work assignments and assist patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications and email

• Prepare patient and/customer orders by moving and placing products

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas

Skills

• Consistent demonstration of excellent customer service skills

• Ability to listen well and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, with various audiences

• Previous experience with POS systems

• Employee must be able to follow instructions as directed and incorporate constructive criticism from managers

• Operate with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information and complying with HIPAA requirements.

Working Conditions

• Patient and/or customer-facing environment

• Ability to work outdoors in varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent

Our Mission: To promote well-being through the power of cannabis.

• We’re humble—We prefer quiet confidence and don’t shout about our success.

• We’re hardworking—We put our heads down and get the job done.

• We’re grateful—Working in our industry is a privilege and an act of service.

• We’re transparent—Honest and open communication keeps us healthy as an organization.

• We’re collaborative—And believe good ideas can come from anywhere.

• We have a growth mindset—One that’s grounded in well-being.

At GTI we believe that our corporate community should be a reflection of the communities we serve. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity across race, sex, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, religion, experience, and thought—not only because it is right, but because it makes us better. Our mission—the right to wellness—informs our commitment to champion economic opportunities in communities disproportionately affected by the war on drugs through employment and community involvement. We can't wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Analyst II
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Our marketing team combines creative, customer-focused strategy with data-driven precision to reach the right customers at the right time. We’re hiring a Growth Marketer to drive Base’s customer acquisition engine as we expand into new markets across the country.

You’ll own acquisition targets and the channel mix that hits them: planning, executing, and optimizing campaigns across offline and digital channels. You’ll bring strong creative instincts and analytical rigor to everything from audience segmentation to vendor management to testing frameworks, and help build the systems and playbooks that make Base the first truly beloved energy company.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own customer acquisition targets across growth channels, with clear accountability for cost-per-acquisition, response rates, and downstream conversion.

 - Build and manage acquisition campaigns across offline and digital channels, from creative development and audience targeting to vendor management and production.

 - Design and run rigorous tests (formats, messaging, offers, targeting) and use results to continuously improve performance across channels.

 - Collaborate closely with design to develop compelling campaign creative that stands out in every medium.

 - Translate performance data into decisions: prioritizing what to double down on, what to fix, and what to shut down.

 - Work cross-functionally with design, sales, and product to ensure direct mail and broader growth efforts align with market expansion plans.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Growth marketing experience, with hands-on ownership of acquisition campaigns across offline and/or digital channels in a consumer or consumer-adjacent business.

 - Strong understanding of campaign operations: production workflows, vendor management, list sourcing and segmentation, A/B testing at scale.

 - Creative instincts. You care about what the customer actually sees, not just the data behind it.

 - Data fluency, with the ability to connect campaign performance to on-site behavior and CRM outcomes.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with design, sales, and product, translating growth goals into clear execution.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team at Base is lean, high-ownership, and results-driven. We operate with clear accountability, tight feedback loops, and a strong bias towards action. Marketing works closely with design, sales, and product to build scalable systems that support the rapid buildout of America’s next-generation power company.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: GTM Operations Manager, Enablement
jobs.description:
Hiring Manager – Ryan Hinkley https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-hinkley-461a0964/, Director of Revenue Operations



About Scribe

Scribe https://scribe.com is where exceptional people come to do the best work of their careers. More than 94% of the Fortune 500 use Scribe to own their specialized intelligence: the unique way their teams work, decide, and get things done. Our Specialized Intelligence platform automatically captures how work happens and turns it into a living asset for people and AI agents.

We're growing fast. Since our founding in 2019, we've reached 7 million users across 600,000 businesses. Based in San Francisco, we're a LinkedIn Top Startup, valued at over $1B, and backed by leading investors. Join us in our mission to transform how people work.




About the role

You're joining Scribe as the first owner of how every AE, BDR, CSM, and SE actually does their job day-to-day. Right now that experience differs depending on who ramped you and which pod you landed in, and the gap gets absorbed by managers who are already stretched thin. You'll map the real workflow role-by-role, redesign it where it's broken, build the layer that lets managers inspect it, and run the onboarding that gets new hires into it fast.




What you'll do

 - Map the complete day-in-the-life workflow for every GTM role — AE, BDR, CSM, SE, and their managers — so reps know what to do without hunting for it

 - Design the task, queue, and report experience that makes that workflow real and consistent across every pod

 - Build the manager inspection layer so leaders can check adoption on a defined cadence instead of asking around

 - Run new-hire onboarding cohorts end to end, from logins and systems training to first workflows and ramp milestones

 - Own change adoption when pricing, packaging, process, or tooling shifts, making sure the field actually adopts it, not just hears about it

 - Re-architect broken workflows and specify the fix precisely enough for GTM Systems to build against

 - Run the front line of user support and the case queue, using Scribe Capture and Optimize to find where reps actually get stuck
   



What we're looking for

 - You've operated as a stakeholder or program owner through at least one CRM or systems implementation at a B2B SaaS company

 - You look at a broken workflow and call it wrong, then design and spec the fix instead of documenting the mess as-is

 - You understand Salesforce and adjacent GTM systems well enough to brief a systems team precisely, without needing to build the platform yourself

 - You've run onboarding or training cohorts end to end, pulling in contributors you don't manage into one coherent experience

 - You're comfortable running training sessions and office hours in front of large groups of field reps

 - You use AI-native tools daily, not just experimented with them, and treat dogfooding your own product as part of the job
   



Nice to have

 - Experience owning onboarding or enablement programs across both Sales and Customer Success

 - Familiarity with Salesforce administration, sales engagement platforms, or LMS/enablement tooling

 - Background in B2B SaaS, ideally PLG or hybrid GTM motion
   



This role is not for you if

 - You want to own product enablement — how Scribe works, demo skills, competitive positioning — that lives with Product Marketing

 - You have not worked with stakeholders across an entire GTM team

 - You want to own sales-skill coaching like pitch, cold calling, or objection handling — that's the CRO's enablement hire

 - You need well-defined process handed to you — this role is building the process from scratch
   
   
   

Why you'll love working here

 - The reach of a unicorn, the headcount of a startup. We went from $1M to $100M ARR in under four years, with fewer than 200 people. That means more pie than people: scope grows with your impact. Customers like T-Mobile, LinkedIn, HubSpot, New York Life and Northern Trust run on Scribe, so what you own reaches some of the biggest names in business.

 - Hard problems, real impact. Capturing how work actually gets done, at scale, is the foundation AI needs, and it's hard to get right. You'll build the layer other products and agents run on, in a category we're still defining.

 - Smart is the floor. Kind is the bar. Low ego, high standards. We compete as a collective and love to see each other win, and One Team, One Dream is one of the most shouted-out values in #values.
   
    


Compensation & location

Remote US or hybrid based out of our San Francisco HQ. We work from our SOMA office 3 days per week.

 

All full-time employees receive equity in Scribe. Final offers depend on experience and scope.



Benefits

 - Healthcare Coverage – Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including two $0/month medical plan options for employees

 - Equity – Ownership in what we're building

 - 401(k) Plan – through Vestwell

 - Flex Benefit – $500/year for home office equipment, productivity tools, learning & development or fitness/wellness

 - Commuter Benefits – $100/month for SF based employees

 - PTO – Flexible paid time off and company holidays

 - Parental Leave – Paid leave to support growing families

 - Wellness & Family Support – Free Talkspace membership, One Medical access (location-dependent), and Kindbody discounts for family planning

 

At Scribe, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. Scribe is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator I - RN - Port Arthur & Beaumont, TX - Temp/ PRN Role
jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.

We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.

A Clinical Research Coordinator I – RN at Iterative Health is an essential member of the site research team, supporting, facilitating, and coordinating the daily execution of clinical trials across our network. This role is at the heart of every study — managing patient interactions, ensuring protocol compliance, maintaining data integrity, and keeping the operational machinery of clinical research running smoothly.

The ideal candidate brings clinical research experience, a patient-first mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, protocol-driven environment. This role provides a strong foundation for success while offering a clear path for professional growth within Iterative Health's expanding site network.

Temp RN from now until end of year to support Port Arthur and Beaumont sites. Flexible in office requirements willing to work 2-3 days/week in office remainder remote. Open to FT or PT hours but FT is desired.

Where You’ll Drive Impact

• Administratively and clinically manage industry-sponsored clinical trials, including problem-solving, communication, and protocol management.

• Schedule all patient research visits and procedures in accordance with protocol requirements.

• Ensure relevant study and subject-specific information is entered into the CTMS on a regular basis.

• Complete and maintain study documentation including consent forms, source documentation, progress notes, case report forms, and investigational accountability forms.

• Complete and maintain case report forms per FDA guidelines, reviewing them against patient medical records for completeness and accuracy.

• Schedule and prepare for monitor visits.

• Maintain inventory of study equipment and supplies onsite at all times.

• Lead patient recruitment activities including chart reviews, protocol discussions with patients, and verification of informed consent documentation.

• Conduct patient visits as outlined within each study protocol.

• Act as the primary point of contact for study participants throughout the course of the study.

• Dispense study medication, collect vital signs, and perform ECGs per protocol.

• Perform blood draws; process and ship specimens per study protocol and IATA regulations.

• As assigned: place IVs, administer IV medications and fluids, give intramuscular and subcutaneous injections, monitor patients during infusion, and discharge patients in accordance with protocol and site policies.

• Adhere to Research SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, and study protocols at all times.

• Assist with routine data verification and quality control, ensuring data integrity and consistency with prescribed study protocols.

• Ensure all safety data is reviewed by the PI in a timely manner.

• Cooperate with site compliance and monitoring efforts regarding the access, use, and disclosure of PHI; report instances of noncompliance to the appropriate compliance office.

• Assist the study team in protecting the rights and welfare of all human research participants in accordance with federal regulations.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.



About the role

We're looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to support our CEO and leadership team and help keep Infisical running smoothly as we grow.

In this role, you'll be the go-to person for making sure our leaders spend their time on what matters most. You'll own scheduling, inbox management, travel, offsite planning, office management, business operations, and the countless details that keep a fast-moving startup on track.

You'll work closely with our CEO and leadership team to:

 - Own core administrative tasks, including scheduling, inbox triage, and calendar management, coordinating internal and external meetings, preventing conflicts, and helping leadership use their time effectively.

 - Prioritize and triage what matters, draft responses, protect focus time, and ensure nothing urgent falls through the cracks, including evenings and weekends when needed.

 - Coordinate travel and handle ad hoc tasks quickly, proactively, and with minimal oversight.

 - Use AI tools thoughtfully in your daily work to make processes faster and more efficient.

 - Manage our SF office, dedicating roughly 5 hours per week.

Nice to have

 - Experience supporting a founder or executive at an early-stage startup.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Job Overview

Jensen Hughes is seeking experienced Sprinkler Design Consultants with a strong background in water-based fire suppression systems. This role will support a fast-paced project through consulting, design, review, and field oversight activities at a large semiconductor facility in North Phoenix.  The position requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the ability to interface effectively with clients.

The successful candidate will contribute to the planning, design, review, and implementation of automatic sprinkler systems, fire pumps, and related suppression systems, while ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.

Design, Consulting, and Technical Oversight

Quality, Compliance, and Leadership

jobs.title: Country Manager - Burundi
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities

1) Shape and deliver Kahawatu’s vision for Burundi

• Work with the Burundi and international teams of Kahawatu and SUCAFINA to develop an ambitious roadmap for the next decade.
• Translate that vision into practical, scalable programs that strengthen coffee production, farmer incomes and household resilience.
• Identify new opportunities based on field realities, evidence and the evolving needs of coffee-growing communities.

2) Lead programs that deliver lasting impact

• Oversee the design and execution of high-quality field programs centered on coffee productivity, quality and regenerative agriculture.
• Integrate climate adaptation, income diversification, gender, youth and household resilience where these strengthen the future of coffee-growing communities.
• Maintain a strong field presence and ensure solutions are practical, locally relevant and capable of being adopted at scale.

3) Build evidence and demonstrate results

• Define meaningful indicators covering coffee production, farmer income, resilience and the adoption of improved practices.
• Use data and learning to improve programs, guide decisions and demonstrate credible impact over multiple seasons.
• Turn results and field insights into compelling evidence for partners, funders and the wider coffee sector.

4) Mobilise partnerships, visibility and funding

• Build relationships with government, donors, development organisations and actors across the international coffee industry.
• Help design and secure funding for programs that can contribute to sector-wide change.
• Lead/support communication, partnership and fundraising campaigns that mobilise international support for Burundi’s coffee future.
• Represent Kahawatu Burundi credibly in national and international forums.

5) Lead and develop a nimble local team

• Provide clear direction to agronomy, field, monitoring and evaluation, and administrative colleagues.
• Build a collaborative, motivated and accountable culture in which people can grow and take initiative.
• Strengthen coordination between field delivery, learning, communications and reporting.

6) Ensure sound and responsible operations

• Oversee budgets, reporting, compliance and the effective use of resources.
• Ensure Kahawatu meets local legal and regulatory requirements and maintains high standards of transparency and integrity.
• Establish proportionate systems that support effective delivery without losing the agility of a small foundation.

You may be ready for this managerial role if you have built strong experience in agriculture, coffee or rural development and are now looking for the opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibility. You will need to be comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on delivery: working with farming communities and technical teams, building relationships with senior partners, and representing an ambitious organisation.

We are interested not only in what you have already done, but also in the scale of responsibility you are ready to take on next.

Must-haves

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in agriculture, coffee, rural development or a related field
• Experience designing and delivering agriculture-based programs and achieving measurable results
• A practical understanding of agricultural production and the realities facing smallholder farming communities
• Proven experience in leading multi-cultural teams, projects or significant areas of responsibility, together with the potential and ambition to step into broader organisational leadership
• The ability to build trusted relationships across communities, government, funders and private-sector partners
• Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ideas and evidence into persuasive proposals, presentations and partnerships
• Sound judgement, resilience, cultural sensitivity and a willingness to work hands-on in a complex operating environment
• Fluency in French and a basic command of English; speaking Kirundi or Swahili is a plus
• A commitment to living in Burundi and travelling regularly to coffee-growing communities

Nice to have

We do not expect one candidate to bring everything on this list. Any combination of the following would be an advantage:

• Experience in coffee and regenerative agriculture or perennial crops
• Experience in Burundi, the Great Lakes region or another comparable operating environment
• Experience developing donor-funded programs or public-private partnerships
• Exposure to fundraising, proposal development, campaigning or strategic communications
• Experience using monitoring, evaluation and field data to improve programs and demonstrate impact
• An existing network among coffee-sector actors, NGOs, public authorities or development partners
• Knowledge of Kirundi

What success looks like

Success will mean combining an ambitious long-term vision with credible, practical progress on the ground.

Over the first 12–18 months, we would expect the Country Manager to:

• Build the confidence of Kahawatu’s team, farming communities and key national and international partners
• Strengthen the quality, coordination and measurable impact of existing programs
• Establish a clear and compelling roadmap for Kahawatu’s next decade in Burundi
• Create an environment in which a small, capable local team can perform, develop and take initiative

Over time, success will be reflected in:

• Sustained improvements in coffee productivity, quality, farmer income and household resilience
• Wider adoption of regenerative and climate-resilient agricultural practices
• Meaningful economic and social opportunities for women and young people in coffee-growing communities
• Programs and partnerships capable of contributing to national-scale change, supported by credible evidence and able to mobilise international support.
• Strong evidence demonstrating Kahawatu’s impact over multiple seasons
• Kahawatu being recognised as an innovative, trusted and effective partner in the future of Burundi’s coffee sector

Why join Kahawatu Foundation?

• Lead programs that directly impact thousands of coffee-farming households
• Operate at the core of Burundi’s most strategic agricultural sector
• Work across public and private actors to drive systemic change
• Contribute to the long-term transformation of the coffee sector through practical, field-driven impact

If you recognize yourself in this role and believe you have the experience, leadership, and drive to contribute to the future of Burundi’s coffee sector, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Product Support Engineer
jobs.location: La Jolla Ranch, CA, United States
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Product Support Engineer with advanced expertise in Altium solutions, PCB design workflows, and enterprise engineering environments. This role serves as a senior technical leader within Customer Support, providing expert support for complex customer-reported issues involving Altium Designer, Altium 365, Enterprise Server technologies, library and data management, and integrations with PLM and other enterprise systems.

The successful candidate will investigate and resolve challenging technical issues that occur within customer environments, perform deep root cause analysis across multiple technologies, collaborate closely with R&D and cross-functional teams, and mentor fellow support engineers. Success in this role requires deep hands-on experience with PCB design, electronic product development workflows, and Altium products. Working knowledge of enterprise systems, PLM integrations, authentication technologies, and related infrastructure is also highly valued.

This position is focused on supporting and troubleshooting Altium products within complex customer ecosystems rather than providing consulting services or designing customer enterprise architectures. The ability to understand how our products interact with PLM, enterprise data management platforms, identity management systems, and other connected technologies is critical to effectively diagnosing and resolving customer issues.

Key Responsibilities include but not limited to:

• Take ownership and support a prioritized customer base and accounts defined by management
• Serve as an escalation resource and document technical findings for broader consumption across Product Support Engineering and other stakeholders.
• Support the entire customer base through a variety of channels, with a focus on FAQs, Knowledge Base articles, Online Help, and Community Forum participation.
• Document all customer issues, case activities, and escalations in accordance with support processes.
• Drive root cause analysis efforts for high-impact customer escalations and coordinate with R&D, Product Management, and Engineering teams.
• Create technical content such as online help, user guides, video tutorials, knowledge base articles, quick start guides, and similar materials.
• Provide live coaching and assistance to team members.
• Act as a senior technical escalation resource, independently driving resolution of highly complex customer issues and providing technical leadership across multiple product and workflow domains.
• Test pre-release products and features while helping prepare technical teams for upcoming releases.
• Maintain a high level of knowledge and professionalism

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent
• A solid understanding of electronic design software, verification and automation
• Advanced experience supporting PCB design workflows is required. Experience with Altium products and platform solutions is strongly preferred.
• 6+ years of experience in PCB design, electronic product development, EDA software support, or closely related engineering environments.
• Previous Experience in Technical Support role preferred
• Fluent in English
• Fluency in additional languages is a plus
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Deep knowledge in PCB Design is required, along with expertise in one or more of the following: High-Speed Design, RF Design, Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, Data/Library Management, PCB Manufacturing, PLM Workflows, Enterprise Data Management, Enterprise Integrations, or Enterprise Server Technologies.
• Experience supporting customer environments that include PLM, enterprise data management, authentication systems (e.g., SAML, OAuth, Active Directory), server technologies, or other enterprise engineering platforms is highly desired.
• Experience with Complex PCB Simulation/Signal Integrity/Analysis is a plus
• Experience in technical demonstrations and presenting training materials
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues spanning desktop applications, cloud services, enterprise integrations, authentication systems, and related customer environments.
• Must possess excellent group and interpersonal communication and presentation skills, written skills, and the desire to work in a fast-paced environment with passion and enthusiasm for Altium Corporate Goals, Visions, Products, and Solutions
• Be driven, self-managed, and motivated

Working conditions  This job may require occasional travel.  When not traveling, time will be spent in the office fielding escalations from the technical team, and proactively assisting with the team casework.

The expected annual pay range for this position is $90,000 - $120,000. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Renesas offers a full range of elective benefits including medical, health savings account (with applicable medical plan), dental, vision, health and/or dependent care flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, life insurance, AD&D, and pet insurance. Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. jobs.title: Platform & Sustainability Expert - US
jobs.description:
Sweep is hiring a Platform & Sustainability Expert to help customers implement our platform, track their carbon and ESG metrics, and drive impactful sustainability initiatives.

As a Platform & Sustainability Expert (P&SE) within the Delivery Team, you will help customers turn their sustainability goals into practical outcomes through the implementation and adoption of Sweep.

You will lead customer onboarding and implementation projects, translating customer requirements into effective platform configurations, data models, workflows, reporting logic, and integrations. You are comfortable working close to the technical layer of a product — reading data structures, troubleshooting configurations, and helping customers understand how the platform works under the hood. You will work with customers, consulting and reseller partners, Customer Success, Growth, Product, Engineering, and the wider Sweep ecosystem.

You will manage stakeholders and delivery challenges with limited guidance, support complex implementations when needed, and contribute reusable delivery practices across the team. The role is based in  Denver.

Ok, sounds promising. What will I be doing?

As a Platform & Sustainability Expert, your responsibilities will span across these key areas:

• Customer & Partner Implementation 🔧

• Own or support customer onboarding and implementation projects from planning through handover.
• Configure Sweep for sustainability, carbon accounting, reporting, data management, surveys, workflows, and historical data.
• Translate customer needs into practical platform solutions and operating processes.
• Lead customer meetings, workshops, and implementation discussions.
• Coordinate customers, partners, and internal teams while managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
• Diagnose and troubleshoot configuration issues, data quality problems, and workflow errors directly in the platform.
• Work with data: understand customer data structures, map source data to Sweep's data model, and guide customers through data ingestion, transformation, and validation.
• Identify where platform limitations require workarounds or escalation to Engineering, and communicate these clearly.
• Support consulting and reseller partners in using Sweep effectively.
• Ensure clear handovers to Customer Success, including objectives, configuration, decisions, risks, open items, and next steps.
• Share delivery patterns, lessons learned, and reusable approaches across the Delivery team.

2. Platform Expertise & Enablement 📚

• Demonstrate strong knowledge of Sweep’s platform and how its modules support customer use cases.
• Deliver tailored training, demonstrations, presentations, and enablement sessions
• Guide customers and partners on implementation, reporting, data management, governance, and adoption.
• Develop familiarity with Sweep's API, data connectors, and integration patterns to support customers with more complex technical setups.
• Help customers become confident and autonomous users.
• Turn recurring questions and delivery challenges into practical guidance, templates, playbooks, and other enablement materials.
• Use Sweep’s AI features responsibly, explaining their benefits and limitations and reinforcing human review, data-quality checks, and professional judgment.
• Support colleagues with platform questions and escalate specialist topics when appropriate.

3. Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management 🤝

• Manage multiple customer and partner engagements, prioritising according to customer needs, commitments, and business goals.
• Own project plans, timelines, actions, dependencies, documentation, and delivery systems.
• Communicate clearly and proactively about progress, responsibilities, risks, decisions, and next steps.
• Identify conflicts or delivery risks early, recommend solutions, and escalate when needed.
• Maintain accurate information, strong follow-through, and consistent delivery standards.

4. Sustainability Advisory & Product Feedback 🌱

• Apply advanced knowledge of carbon accounting and sustainability topics to customer engagements.
• Connect Sweep to customers’ reporting requirements, sustainability objectives, and carbon accounting goals.
• Explain relevant assumptions, limitations, methodologies, regulations, and disclosure requirements clearly.
• Identify methodology, compliance, data-quality, and scoping issues early.
• Explain the opportunities and limitations of AI in sustainability data management, carbon accounting, and disclosure.
• Gather customer and partner feedback and turn it into actionable insights for Product and Engineering.
• Share sustainability knowledge and identify opportunities to improve delivery, guidance, and the product.

5. Customer Success 💚

• Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear, responsive communication.
• Understand customer objectives, expectations, success measures, and operating context.
• Manage expectations around scope, timelines, responsibilities, dependencies, and decisions.
• Navigate difficult conversations constructively.
• Identify adoption, satisfaction, and delivery risks early.
• Keep implementation focused on time-to-value and meaningful customer outcomes.
• Help customers become autonomous users and share relevant insights with Customer Success, Growth, Product, and other internal teams.

At Sweep, artificial intelligence is part of how we work, learn, and build. Every team member uses AI tools daily to speed up operations, improve decision making, and unlock creativity. We don’t expect you to be an expert on day one, but we do expect curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the desire to use AI as a true partner in your work.

Whether it’s analyzing information, drafting content, improving workflows, designing better employee experiences, or supporting distributed teams, you’ll use AI to work faster and smarter. We provide guidance, tools, and best practices so you can get the most out of it.

We’re looking for candidates who already have hands-on experience with AI tools in a professional setting. You should be comfortable using AI to support your daily work, enhance productivity, and create new solutions. If you naturally reach for AI to amplify what you do, you’ll feel right at home here.

That sounds just right for me. What do I need to bring?

Glad you asked. This is who we’re looking for:

Qualifications 🏆

• Experience in customer delivery, consulting, project management, sustainability, carbon accounting, SaaS implementation, or a related field.
• Experience owning customer-facing projects, workstreams, or relationships independently.
• Strong knowledge of carbon accounting, sustainability reporting, climate frameworks, and practical sustainability challenges.
• Experience applying sustainability knowledge in customer, business, or operational contexts.
• Hands-on experience working with SaaS platforms at a configuration or implementation depth — not just as an end user, but understanding how data flows, how modules connect, and how to troubleshoot.
• Familiarity with structured data, spreadsheets, or basic data manipulation (SQL, Excel/Sheets at an advanced level, or similar) is a strong plus.
• Exposure to APIs, integrations, or technical implementations in a customer-facing context is a plus.
• Curiosity about how software products work and a desire to develop deeper technical skills over time.
• Experience facilitating workshops, delivering training, presenting, and recommending practical solutions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Experience working across functions or with external partners.
• Professional fluency in English, including customer meetings, workshops, training, written communication, and difficult conversations.
• Professional fluency in Spanish is a plus.
• A relevant degree is a plus, but equivalent practical experience is equally valued.

Qualities 🧠

• You take ownership, raise risks early, and bring practical solutions.
• You are structured, reliable, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to manage difficult conversations constructively.
• You build trust through sound judgment and follow-through, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are open to feedback.
• You are naturally curious about how things work — not just what a platform does, but why, and how you'd fix it when it doesn't.
• You enjoy learning new technical concepts and applying them practically in a customer context.
• You are motivated by sustainability, understand the link between delivery quality, time-to-value, customer health, renewals, and expansion, and use AI-assisted tools with appropriate judgment and human oversight.
• You act in line with Sweep’s values and contribute positively to the Delivery team.

You will own customer relationships and implementation work from planning through handover and adoption, with autonomy to manage delivery and adapt to customer needs. You will work across platform capabilities, sustainability requirements, customer processes, and stakeholder priorities, with support from experienced colleagues when needed.

You will also help improve delivery practices, enablement materials, processes, and knowledge sharing across the Delivery team, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Growth, and external partners.

The role offers a path toward becoming a Senior Platform & Sustainability Expert, with opportunities to lead strategic engagements, coach colleagues, influence delivery standards, and contribute to broader customer and business outcomes. Or, for the right candidate, toward a Customer Engineering function — working at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer delivery on more complex technical implementations, integrations, and platform challenges.

Copy that. And what’s in it for me?

You will be joining an exciting young business that has the humble ambition to change the world. With a proven track record in starting companies, we’re planning to hit the ground running and have an impact fast. Joining this journey right at the beginning allows you to really help shape our path.

Our hybrid work model, with hiring focussed around our head offices in Paris, London and Montpellier, allows us to balance our personal and professional lives while staying connected and engaged with colleagues and clients.

We’re big believers in creating successful businesses that are good for everyone, including society and the planet. That’s why we have a B Corporation status.

We think this will be the ride of our lives. And maybe yours, too.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to impact development and validation of our groundbreaking battery technology. As a key member of the Technical Program Management team, you will drive the delivery of our multi-day battery by integrating and managing workstreams across systems architecture, firmware, software, and electrical engineering. You will partner with and influence technical leaders and cross-functional teams to ensure our product meets its requirements and is successfully launched. This is a unique opportunity to apply your technical breadth and program leadership skills to a mission-driven company with world-changing technology.



What You'll Do:

 - Own the entire product delivery and validation cycle, driving the program from initial concept through to successful launch and commercialization.

 - Define, manage, and execute highly technical workstreams across systems architecture, electrical engineering, firmware, and software, ensuring seamless integration and alignment.

 - Develop and enforce the Product Development Process (PDP), establishing best practices for product validation and documentation across the organization.

 - Proactively identify and strategically mitigate program risks and dependencies, anticipating challenges and defining solutions that impact both technical and business outcomes.

 - Facilitate key technical and strategic decisions, bringing together engineering and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and maintain program momentum.

 - Serve as a key technical resource and mentor for other program managers and engineers, sharing best practices and elevating the entire team's capabilities.



What You'll Bring:

 - 8+ years of experience in a technical program management role with a focus on hardware product development.

 - Extensive experience managing complex programs with a combination of systems architecture, electrical engineering, and firmware/software components.

 - Deep expertise in the Product Development Process (PDP), with a proven track record of successful product validation and delivery.

 - A systems-level generalist mindset and the ability to quickly establish credibility and influence with technical leaders across different disciplines.

 - Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to articulate complex technical information and strategic recommendations to all levels of the organization.

 - Proven ability to lead autonomously in an ambiguous environment, defining a clear path forward and driving results without direct supervision.
   
   

#LI-Onsite

#LI-TR1





Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Producer, MS NOW Digital
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
MS NOW Digital is looking for a Video Producer/Editor. This producer/editor will conceive, write, produce, and edit fast, smart, and compelling video for social and digital platforms. This role will have a heavy focus on politics and the 2028 election cycle, while also contributing to the daily news cycle, primetime show content, original franchises, breaking news coverage, and major MS NOW initiatives.

The ideal candidate is an expert editor and strong writer with deep political instincts. You can identify the most compelling element of a candidate event, hearing, interview, breaking news development, or show segment and frame it into accurate, visually distinctive video that stands out in a crowded news environment.

PLEASE NOTE: position hours are Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday 2pm–10pm and Saturday 11am–7pm.

This position is represented by the Writers Guild of America East.

Responsibilities

• Conceive, write, produce, and edit vertical videos daily for social platforms.
• Produce original social and digital video with a strong emphasis on politics, elections, campaigns and the 2028 race.
• Partner with the DC political unit, campaign teams, reporters, field producers, editors, and show teams to strengthen story framing, scripts, headlines, and visual execution.
• Transform compelling linear segments, interviews, live moments, and reporting into high-performing digital video.
• React quickly to breaking news with accurate, distinctive, competitive videos that help lead the conversation.
• Distill complex political and policy stories into concise, engaging, and accessible storytelling for broad digital audiences.
• Generate daily and longer-term pitches for original video, social franchises, and 2028-focused formats.
• Edit longer-form video for YouTube, OTT, livestreams, and other digital platforms as assigned.
• Write sharp scripts, headlines, captions, descriptions, and social copy.
• Work with anchors, contributors, and reporters on original videos and digital-first storytelling.
• Ensure all work meets MS NOW editorial, legal, Standards and Practices, and accuracy requirements.

• Minimum 5 years of digital, social, or video producing, editing, and writing experience.
• Deep knowledge of politics, campaigns, elections, and the issues shaping the 2028 cycle.
• Expert Adobe Premiere skills, with the ability to edit efficiently and creatively under tight deadlines.
• Demonstrated experience producing and editing original digital video for social audiences.
• Strong scriptwriting, headline-writing, copy-editing, and storytelling skills.
• Excellent editorial judgment, including the ability to identify the most compelling and newsworthy elements of a story.
• Strong attention to accuracy, fairness, context, nuance, and detail.
• Ability to manage multiple assignments and original projects in a fast-paced news environment.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and take editorial direction.
• Familiarity with YouTube livestream technology and digital production workflows.
• Experience covering politics and elections.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience working with reporters, field teams, anchors, or show production teams on video stories.
• Strong instinct for emerging political stories and the audience conversation around them.
• Experience producing both vertical social video and longer-form YouTube or OTT video.
• Familiarity with camera equipment, audio gathering, lighting, and basic field production.
• Ability to develop story ideas, research, and plan segments independently.

Additional Requirements

• Must be willing to work in New York, NY.
• Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
• Must be willing and able to work flexible hours under tight deadline pressure, including breaking news, election events, debates, weekends, and special projects.
• This position has been designated as hybrid, with in-office work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday weekly.
• Must comply with the Standards and Practices of MS NOW.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Title: Production Associate
Pay Rate: $  17.00 per hour
Location:  Hammonton, NJ
Job Type: Full Time, Non-Exempt
Shift: Monday to Friday, 6AM to 2:30PM

Who You Are:

You’re a hands-on production pro who thrives in a fast-paced, quality-driven environment. With an eye for detail and a steady focus on consistency, you take pride in packaging and labeling premium cannabis products—from dried flower and pre-rolls to vape cartridges, pens, and infused items. You enjoy working with clear procedures, following safety and compliance standards, and collaborating with teammates to keep operations running smoothly. Your reliability and commitment to accuracy ensure every finished product meets Curaleaf’s high standards before it reaches our customers.

What You’ll Do:

As a Production Technician at Curaleaf, you’ll play a key role in delivering high-quality cannabis products by supporting every stage of the packaging process. In this fast-paced, hands-on role, you will:

• Stage products and packaging materials across production lines while performing quality assurance checks to meet daily schedules and Curaleaf’s high standards

• Boost operational efficiency and minimize waste by taking ownership, collaborating with the team, and communicating effectively

• Conduct in-process and final quality checks, including testing, visual inspections, and precise weighing, while maintaining 100% compliance in data recording, product tracking, and secure packaging

• Work quickly and efficiently to boost productivity while keeping the extraction room organized, clean, and inspection-ready

• Operate efficiently while following OSHA standards, Curaleaf SOPs, and all required procedures, ensuring every product is accurately labeled and fully compliant with state regulations

What You’ll Bring:

• You are eager to learn and can be trained on various production equipment and SOPs while consistently meeting performance expectations set by leadership

• You bring strong attention to detail and effective communication skills, thriving in a fast-paced, team-based production environment

• You can comfortably perform repetitive tasks with focus and consistency over extended periods

• You have a strong work ethic, are punctual and reliable, and help maintain a positive, professional team environment

• You have a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Even Better If:

• You have at least one year of manufacturing or packaging experience focused on product safety, consumer satisfaction, and delivering high-quality results

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time (8-10 hours per shift)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds regularly and occasional lifting of heavier items with assistance

• Frequent and repetitive use of hands and wrists for extended periods of time

• Repetitive bending, squatting, and reaching

• Ability to climb ladders or step stools to access plants or equipment

• Ability to use required PPE when required, such as masks, hair nets, beard covers, respirators, boot covers, scrubs, non-slip shoes, and Tyvek suits as necessary

Environmental Conditions

• Exposure to environments with high humidity, varying temperatures, and strong odors (such as cannabis)

• Exposure to soil, water, fertilizer, dust, pollen and plant pathogens

• Exposure to cleaning solvents, such as high volumes of isopropyl alcohol

• Exposure to loud noises, including but not limited to air compressors, packaging equipment, and alarms

• Exposure to CO2 manufacturing procedures at OSHA approved CO2 levels

Curaleaf Pay Transparency

$17—$17 USD

What We Offer:

• Career Growth Opportunities

• Competitive Pay and Benefits

• Generous PTO and Parental Leave

• 401(K) Retirement Plan

• Life/ Disability Insurance

• Community Involvement

• Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.

Instagram: @curaleaf.usa
Twitter: @Curaleaf_Inc
LinkedIn: Curaleaf LinkedIn

Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. As a high-growth cannabis company known for quality, expertise and reliability, the Company, and its brands, including Curaleaf, Select, Grassroots, Find, and Anthem provide industry-leading service, product selection and accessibility across the medical and adult-use markets. Its unique distribution network throughout Europe, Canada and Australasia brings together pioneering science and research with cutting-edge cultivation, extraction and production. Home | Curaleaf | Cannabis with Confidence
