jobs.title: American Girl Seasonal Housekeeper: First Shift
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

American Girl is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Seasonal Housekeeper to support our peak business season from October through December at our DeForest Distribution Center. This position is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and professional environment throughout the facility, including office spaces, common areas, restrooms, breakrooms, and warehouse work areas.

This is a temporary seasonal position expected to begin in November and conclude in late December based on business needs. The schedule is Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; however, hours may extend beyond the regular shift, and occasional weekend work may be required to support operational demands during the peak season.

Responsibilities

• Perform daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and annual cleaning assignments.
• Maintain all types of flooring and stairways through sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, dusting, and other floor care activities.
• Clean and sanitize restrooms, including sinks, toilets, mirrors, fixtures, and dispensers.
• Clean and maintain common areas, office spaces, warehouse work areas, and other facility locations as assigned.
• Clean and maintain breakrooms and kitchenettes, including refrigerators, microwaves, countertops, tables, and other shared amenities.
• Remove and properly dispose of trash, recycling, and debris throughout the facility.
• Perform carpet cleaning and spot-cleaning as needed.
• Complete routine facility maintenance tasks as assigned.
• Maintain the cleanliness and organization of custodial closets, storage areas, and housekeeping supplies.
• Inspect and maintain cleaning equipment to ensure proper working condition.
• Assist with grounds maintenance activities as needed.
• Adjust cleaning routes and priorities based on operational needs and seasonal demands.
• Follow all company policies and safety procedures to maintain a safe work environment for employees and visitors.

La Oportunidad:

American Girl está buscando un Empleado de Limpieza Temporal, confiable, responsable y orientado a los detalles para apoyar nuestra temporada de mayor actividad de octubre a diciembre en nuestro Centro de Distribución de DeForest. Esta posición es responsable de mantener un ambiente limpio, seguro y profesional en toda la instalación, incluyendo oficinas, áreas comunes, baños, salas de descanso y áreas de trabajo del almacén.

Esta es una posición temporal de temporada que se espera comience en Octubre y concluya a finales de diciembre, de acuerdo con las necesidades del negocio. El horario es de lunes a viernes, de 7:00 a. m. a 3:30 p. m.; sin embargo, puede ser necesario trabajar horas adicionales después del turno regular y ocasionalmente fines de semana para apoyar las operaciones durante la temporada de mayor demanda.

Responsabilidades

• Realizar tareas de limpieza diarias, semanales, quincenales, mensuales y anuales.
• Mantener todo tipo de pisos y escaleras mediante barrido, trapeado, aspirado, desempolvado y otras actividades de cuidado de pisos.
• Limpiar y desinfectar los baños, incluyendo lavabos, inodoros, espejos, accesorios y dispensadores.
• Limpiar y mantener áreas comunes, oficinas, áreas de trabajo del almacén y otras ubicaciones de la instalación según se asignen.
• Limpiar y mantener salas de descanso y áreas de cocina, incluyendo refrigeradores, microondas, encimeras, mesas y otras áreas compartidas.
• Retirar y desechar adecuadamente la basura, materiales reciclables y desechos en toda la instalación.
• Realizar limpieza de alfombras y eliminación de manchas cuando sea necesario.
• Completar tareas de mantenimiento rutinario de las instalaciones según se asignen.
• Mantener la limpieza y organización de los armarios de suministros, áreas de almacenamiento y materiales de limpieza.
• Inspeccionar y cuidar el equipo de limpieza para garantizar que funcione correctamente.
• Apoyar en actividades de mantenimiento de exteriores cuando sea necesario.
• Ajustar las rutas y prioridades de limpieza según las necesidades operativas y las demandas de la temporada.
• Cumplir con todas las políticas de la empresa y los procedimientos de seguridad para mantener un entorno de trabajo seguro para empleados y visitantes.

What We Are Looking For:

Required Qualifications

• Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 35 pounds.
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform physical tasks throughout the workday.
• Ability to work independently and effectively as part of a team.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high standards of cleanliness.
• Ability to make sound decisions and prioritize work with minimal supervision.
• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment and following established safety practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous housekeeping, custodial, janitorial, or facility maintenance experience preferred.
• Bilingual skills are a plus but are not required.

Lo Que Buscamos

Requisitos Obligatorios

• Capacidad para levantar, cargar, empujar y jalar hasta 35 libras (aproximadamente 16 kg).
• Capacidad para permanecer de pie, caminar, agacharse, estirarse y realizar tareas físicas durante toda la jornada laboral.
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera independiente y también como parte de un equipo.
• Gran atención a los detalles y compromiso con el mantenimiento de altos estándares de limpieza.
• Capacidad para tomar decisiones acertadas y priorizar tareas con supervisión mínima.
• Capacidad para seguir instrucciones verbales y escritas.
• Habilidades efectivas de comunicación e interacción con otras personas.
• Compromiso con el mantenimiento de un entorno de trabajo seguro y con el cumplimiento de las prácticas de seguridad establecidas.

Requisitos Preferidos

• Se prefiere experiencia previa en limpieza, conserjería, mantenimiento de instalaciones o puestos similares.
• Ser bilingüe es una ventaja, pero no es un requisito.

How We Work:

American Girl is subsidiary of Mattel, a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.

• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in more than 195 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies.

Mattel is recognized as a Great Place to Work™ and as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators in 2022.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, veterans, military spouses, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

Cómo Trabajamos

American Girl es una subsidiaria de Mattel, una empresa impulsada por un propósito: inspirar a las nuevas generaciones a descubrir la magia de la infancia y alcanzar su máximo potencial. Vivimos este propósito a través de los siguientes valores:

• Colaboramos: Ser parte de Mattel significa formar parte de un solo equipo con valores compartidos y objetivos en común. Cada persona cuenta, y sabemos que trabajar juntos nos permite lograr mejores resultados. La colaboración está en el centro de todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra capacidad de trabajar en equipo es una de nuestras mayores fortalezas.
• Innovamos: En Mattel siempre estamos buscando formas nuevas y mejores de crear productos y experiencias que inspiren. Sin importar tu puesto dentro de la organización, tienes la oportunidad de generar un impacto real. Valoramos las nuevas ideas y fomentamos iniciativas que desafíen la forma tradicional de pensar.
• Ejecutamos: Somos una empresa orientada a resultados. Nos esforzamos por alcanzar la excelencia y ofrecer resultados de la más alta calidad. Creemos en la responsabilidad, el compromiso y la autonomía, porque sabemos que las personas dan lo mejor de sí mismas cuando cuentan con las herramientas y la confianza necesarias para tener éxito.

Quiénes Somos

American Girl es una marca líder en productos para niñas y una subsidiaria de propiedad total de Mattel, Inc., una de las empresas de juguetes y entretenimiento familiar más importantes del mundo. A través de nuestras marcas más reconocidas, como Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA y Polly Pocket, conectamos con familias y seguidores alrededor del mundo mediante juguetes, contenido, productos para consumidores, experiencias digitales y eventos en vivo. Nuestros productos se comercializan en más de 195 países, en colaboración con algunas de las principales empresas minoristas y plataformas de comercio electrónico del mundo.

Mattel ha sido reconocida como un Great Place to Work™ y como uno de los Best Workplaces for Innovators de Fast Company.

Conoce más sobre nosotros en:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Observability
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Role

We are seeking Senior Software Engineers who specialize across the pillars of Observability to play a pivotal role in CoreWeave’s ability to bring the best performing systems to market. Whether you focus on metrics, logging and tracing, or telemetry pipelines and visualization, you’ll have an outsized opportunity to enable both CoreWeave and its customers to understand, troubleshoot, and optimize complex systems at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence.

What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and own core observability infrastructure, including highly scalable and reliable logging, metrics, and tracing platforms.

• Develop and operate high-throughput telemetry pipelines that ingest, transform, and expose observability data, ensuring reliability, security, and transparent data migrations for platform consumers.

• Tackle observability challenges at extreme scale, supporting clusters of thousands of GPUs, petabyte-scale telemetry, and high-cardinality workloads.

• Continuously improve performance, security, reliability, and scalability of observability services through software enhancements, automation, and new feature development.

• Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support critical production systems, focusing on root cause analysis and building durable solutions to prevent recurrence.

• Collaborate closely with internal engineering teams, applying a platform-as-a-product mindset to understand their needs and embed observability best practices and custom tooling into their systems.

• Contribute to the overall observability strategy, influencing the direction of our platform and the experience we provide to customers.

Who You Are

• 5+ years of experience in software or infrastructure engineering, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production.

• Proficient in Go (our primary language) or Python, with the ability to write clean, resilient, and testable production code.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, including containerization and microservices architectures, and familiarity with their observability challenges.

• Demonstrated experience designing, building, and delivering robust and scalable systems, with a commitment to operational excellence, high-quality code, effective testing, and progressive release strategies.

• Ability to analyze and decompose complex problems in elastic, distributed architectures into manageable, well-scoped work.

• Comfortable working with Helm and YAML-based configuration for deploying and managing services, including templating, automation, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

• A customer-obsessed, platform-minded engineer, eager to provide infrastructure as a service and apply a product lens when evaluating platform scale problems.

• Experience participating in an on-call rotation for critical production systems.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct, hands-on experience designing, operating, or scaling logging, tracing, and/or metrics platforms (e.g., Loki, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Thanos).

• Familiarity with data streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Kafka Connect) for observability pipelines.

• Experience automating and provisioning infrastructure as part of the software development lifecycle, using tools like Terraform.

• Experience with OpenTelemetry for unified telemetry collection and instrumentation.

• Experience with modern AI platforms and workloads (e.g., large-scale training and inference, GPU-based infrastructure, MLOps tooling) is a plus.

The base salary range for this role is $182,000 to $242,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Operations Associate | Nox Metals | Detroit, MI



About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.



The role. We're hiring an Operations Associate to be our General Manager's right hand. This is not a 40-hour job. You'll work across the factory floor and the office, learn how the whole operation runs, and keep it moving. You'll get handed problems nobody has solved yet. Take them as far as you can, and when you get stuck, come back with what you tried and what you think we should do next.

As Nox opens new plants and our GM spends time getting them running, you're the person who keeps Detroit running without missing a beat. You report to the General Manager.

You don't need a manufacturing background. Some of the people who've grown fastest here came from finance, engineering, and supply chain. What they had in common: they wanted to work hard, took whatever job needed doing, and figured it out.



Shift hours:

Monday through Friday, 6:30 AM to 4:00 PM on paper. In reality, expect 60 to 80 hours a week for the foreseeable future, including early mornings, late nights, and weekends.



You will:

· Learn the factory inside and out: how an order moves from quote to cut to ship, and where it gets stuck

· Keep our GM organized: track priorities, follow up on open items, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

· Own projects end to end, from figuring out the problem to getting it fixed

· Dig into the numbers behind the operation, like capacity, labor hours, cost per unit, and on-time shipping, and use them to make the case for what we do next

· Work with shift leads, quality, receiving, and shipping to hit our daily order targets

· Step in wherever the operation needs you, on the floor or in the office

· Follow every SOP, and tell us when one is broken so we can fix it



You are:

· Thorough: you finish the job and check your own work

· High agency: you don't wait for permission or perfect directions

· Smart, and quick to learn things you've never done before

· Ready to work 60 to 80 hour weeks while we build this, and still sharp at the end of them

· Someone who has built something: a business, a side hustle, a club, a team, even if it didn't work out

· Comfortable on a factory floor and with the people who work there

· A clear, direct communicator who can tell a manager what's wrong and how to fix it

· Strong with spreadsheets and comfortable with numbers

· Never says "that's not my job"



Nice to have:

· Manufacturing, operations, or supply chain experience

· Experience leading people, in any setting

· Experience at a startup or fast-growing company

· Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter



Pay and benefits:

· $70,000 to $80,000 salary, based on experience

· Equity in Nox Metals

· Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance



This role is full time, in person in Detroit.



Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (US)
jobs.description:
Let's fix hospitality, for good.

Running restaurants in the US is brutal - margins are razor thin, waste is high, and teams are stretched to the limit. But it doesn’t have to be this hard. That’s why we built Nory.

Our CEO, Conor, knows the pain first-hand. After founding and scaling Mad Egg in Ireland, he got tired of juggling “market-leading” systems, clunky spreadsheets, and endless printouts. So he built the tool he wished he’d had from day one.

Nory is the all-knowing restaurant management system. It blends real-time data with AI predictive analytics, giving operators control of their margins. From food prep to forecasting, it’s operational intelligence that helps restaurants run with consistency, certainty, and profit. The result? Thriving restaurants, better jobs, less waste, stronger margins.

And we’re just getting started. Fresh off a Series B led by Kinnevik https://www.nory.ai/blog/nory-series-b-funding-to-revolutionise-restaurant-operations and Accel, we’ve grown to 120+ people across Ireland, the UK, and Spain - and now we’re bringing Nory to the US.

We're hiring one of our first US Business Development Representatives (BDR), based in New York City. You'll be on the ground floor of our US expansion: opening doors with restaurant groups, shaping how we go to market, and growing with the team as it scales. If you want to build something rather than join something already built, this is it!




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

You’ll be working very closely with Abbi https://www.linkedin.com/in/abbisimms/ (Snr. BDR), and our US Sales team to learn and develop your craft whilst building out relationships (and pipeline) with some of the coolest brands within hospitality. Here’s some more detail:

 - Open doors - Generate high-quality pipeline through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and in-person outreach to US restaurant groups.

 - Learn the US market - Research accounts, find decision-makers, and build a sharp understanding of what operators here care about.

 - Book the meetings that matter - Set up qualified first conversations for our Account Executives and help them hit revenue targets.

 - Test and iterate - Try new messaging, channels and sequences, and double down on what works.

 - Be a voice from the field - Share what you hear from prospects with Sales, Marketing and Product to sharpen our US go-to-market.

 - Help build the playbook - As one of our first US BDRs, your learnings will shape how the team grows.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Hospitality experience with a real interest in moving into sales and/or Early-career experience (around 1–2 years) in a target-driven, people-facing role – e.g. sales, recruitment, or similar.

 - A genuine passion for hospitality, restaurants, or the people who run them.

 - Resilience and drive – you're comfortable hearing "no", pick yourself up quickly, and own your numbers.

 - Curiosity – you ask good questions, research properly, and don't rely on stale templates.

 - Strong written and verbal communication; you build rapport quickly, on the phone and in person.

 - Coachability and ambition – whether you're aiming for AE, team lead or beyond, we'll back your growth.

 - A startup mindset – you move fast, take initiative, and are comfortable with ambiguity in a team that's still being built.

If you're excited by what we're building, we'd love to hear from you – even if you don't tick every box.




WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:

💵 $55–70K base, $55-65k commission (110-135k OTE)

📈 Meaningful equity with standard 4-year vesting and 1-year cliff - at Nory everyone is an owner!

🏥 Private health, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employee cover and 50% dependent cover

📈 401k with company match up to 4%

🌴 35 days paid time off, including public holidays

🍼 16 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parent, and 4 weeks of paid leave for non-birthing parent

📚 $1,000 annual personal development budget + quarterly book budget

🖥️ $250 home office workspace budget

✈️ Frequent travel to London and Dublin and regular offsites & socials

👏 And much more




HOW WE WORK:

Our vision is to build a better future for the restaurant industry.

One where operators are in control, margins are stronger, and frontline teams can build careers they're proud of. To get there, we move fast, stay focused, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Our values guide how we work, grow, and win – together.

We serve up impact with a side of profit: We prioritize work that delivers real financial results for our restaurant partners.

We prioritize speed of service: We move fast, unblock quickly, and deliver with urgency.

We act like owners: We own problems, raise the bar, and build better every day.

We win as a crew: We grow stronger through feedback, collaboration, and shared wins.




WE HIRE HUMANS.

At Nory, we believe that diverse teams build better products. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and walks of life. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, family status, age, disability, or race. What matters to us is how you think, how you work, and what you bring to the table. Please let us know if you require any adjustments so you can bring your best self to the interview process.

jobs.title: Traffic Monitoring Operator I - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a productive, flexible, and highly talented Traffic Management Center Operator for immediate employment in Indianapolis, IN.  This is part-time variable  position, typically three eight hour shifts per week.  The applicant can establish a career in  operations and customer service, specific to a fast paced, technology driven work environment.

The TMC Operator assists INDOT operations.  The operator disseminates information verbally and electronically regarding active incidents, such as stranded motorist, crashes, etc., to INDOT’s Hoosier Helper Freeway Service Patrol.  Work within a Traffic Management Center also includes, but not limited to, monitoring CCTV traffic cameras, radio communications with INDOT personnel and other emergency responding agencies using 10 codes, incident  identification and response call-out, customer service representative, and implementing required traffic control and other associated warning devices to advise the public of incidents and events impacting traffic flow.

Operators are responsible for the quality, accuracy and timeliness of all information  disseminated. Operators maintain contact with Indiana State Police (ISP) Dispatch and other emergency responders, communicate and coordinate incident and road blocking information with INDOT maintenance and district staff as needed,  provides other appropriate response agencies of scene details, provides information to motorists by displaying traveler information messages on Dynamic Message Boards (DMS), and provides overall information to verify and update  information regarding ongoing incidents, associated backup/traffic delays and estimated  clearance times.

Operators assist the general public by correctly inputting data into INDOT’s Roadway Events Manager (REM) and CARS database for incidents, construction, and maintenance activities  impacting traffic flow to generate events in web applications.  Review all events, signs, and traveler information for accuracy. Operators assess large volumes of data (both static and real-time) from a wide variety of sources to detect possible roadway incidents. They monitor road sensor data and confirm the data using CCTV video. Effective communication is an important part of this process as operators maintain telephone and/or radio communications with incident responders, DOT field personnel and other public and private agencies. Once assessment is complete, operators determine the facts and severity of traffic incidents and prepares the information for dissemination to the motoring public.

Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalent is required
• Documentation skills, data entry skills, telephone skills, good communication skills
• Ability to synthesize information from multiple inputs, including automated road sensor data, 2-way radios, CCTV traffic cameras, and computer databases
• Knowledge of or ability to learn Indiana roadways
• Ability to work calmly and accurately under intense pressure
• Able to multitask under intense pressure
• Able to communicate across various levels of management
• Knowledge of personal computers and software
• Ability and Flexibility to work a variety of shifts

• Previous experience as a transportation Traffic Management Center Operator/Dispatcher a plus, but not a requirement

• Knowledge of personal computers and software.
• Knowledge of or ability to learn Indiana roadways.
• Ability to work calmly and accurately under intense pressure
• Able to multitask under intense pressure
• Able to communicate across various levels of management

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile App
jobs.description:
Organization Overview:

The Florida Panthers are in their 33rd season in 2026-27 as one of the National Hockey League's premier franchises. As back-to-back Stanley Cup Champions in 2024 and 2025, the Panthers have won 11 of their past 12 postseason series and captured four Eastern Conference Championships. The organization is led by President of Hockey Operations & General Manager Bill Zito, entering his seventh season, and President of Business Operations Michael White, beginning his first full season.

Anchored by a championship culture on the ice, the Panthers are equally committed to building a world-class sports and entertainment platform off of it. The organization focuses on delivering an elite guest experience across all venues, deepening the connection between the team and the South Florida community and continuing to grow the sport for the next generation. The Panthers operate four facilities in Broward County: Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise which is home of Panthers home games, concerts and events, Panthers IceDen in Coral Springs, the state-of-the-art Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale and renovated War Memorial Auditorium which hosts concerts and events year-round.

The Panthers are owned by Vincent J. Viola, a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and a veteran of the U.S. Army. That foundation of selfless service shapes the organization's identity at every level. The Panthers' pillar program, "Heroes Among Us," honors a U.S. military veteran at every home game, and the Florida Panthers Foundation directs its efforts across four core pillars: veterans' affairs, children's health and education, raising awareness for the endangered Florida Panther and growing youth hockey throughout the region. The organization remains deeply committed to empowering and strengthening the diverse communities of South Florida and the tri-county area.

Senior Product Manager, Mobile App

• Organization: Florida Panthers Hockey Club

• Department: Digital & Fan Experience

• Reports To: Director, Experience & Commercial Innovation

• FLSA Status: Exempt (Salaried)

• Employment Type: Full-Time

• Location: Amerant Bank Arena, Sunrise, FL — On-Site

About the Role

The Florida Panthers are two-time Stanley Cup Champions — and we're just getting started. Fueled by back-to-back championships and a fanbase growing faster than nearly any franchise in professional hockey, the Panthers are entering a new chapter defined by ambition, innovation, and a deliberate commitment to doing things differently. We are building a world-class sports and entertainment enterprise that sets the standard for how professional sports franchises operate, grow, and connect with their communities for 365-day entertainment experiences.

The Panthers GameDay App is the centerpiece of our digital fan experience — covering ticket access, rewards, game day features, and more. You'll own the day-to-day product execution of the app and work directly with our Director of Experience & Commercial Innovation to bring the next chapter of that roadmap to life.

Responsibilities

Product Requirements & Execution

• Own the product requirements process end-to-end: lead discovery sessions with cross-functional stakeholders, write clear and detailed PRDs, and get sign-off from relevant teams before work begins

• Translate the Director's strategic roadmap into quarterly plans, sprint-level priorities, and a well-maintained, globally visible backlog

• Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for strategic counterparts, providing clear direction and fielding clarifying questions so engineers can execute without interruption

Agile Process & Delivery Cadence

• Refine and drive discipline around the agile product development rhythm: sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews/demos, and monthly roadmap check-ins

• Enable delivery predictability and visibility so internal stakeholders always know what's shipping, when, and why

• Run formal design reviews and ensure that experience flows are mutually agreed upon and documented before engineering begins

Cross-Functional Alignment & Launch

• Partner with internal teams across ticketing, premium experiences, food & beverage, and operations to align on feature requirements and ensure operational readiness for new capabilities

• Coordinate go-to-market for new features: work with Marketing, PR, and Guest Services to develop rollout plans, staff enablement materials, and launch playbooks

• Own the communications layer between product and the broader Panthers organization — roadmap updates, release notes, and stakeholder demos

Qualifications

• 5–7 years of product management experience, with at least some time in a startup or small-team environment where you were building or improving processes

• Strong consumer mobile app product experience; you've shipped features and understand what good looks like in terms of UX, retention, and engagement

• Grounding in personalization engines, context-aware UX, and content management systems — how they work and how they come together to create a cohesive digital experience

• Understanding of agentic AI and where autonomous, intelligent automation creates value across the customer-facing and operational layers of a product

• Command of agile product development: sprint ceremonies, backlog management, estimation, and dependency tracking

• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to distill complex requirements into clear, accessible documentation that engineers can execute on and non-technical stakeholders can confidently sign off on

• Comfortable operating without a playbook; able to identify the right next step in ambiguous situations and create structure where none exists

• A true team player who builds trust across all levels — senior stakeholders, external partners, and operational teams — and rallies people around a shared plan

Position Type / Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time exempt (salaried) position based on-site at Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise, FL.  Must be able to work flexible hours including nights and weekends as needed.

At the Florida Panthers Hockey Club, Arena Operating Company, Panthers IceDen, Sanza Food Service, War Memorial Benefit Corporation, and FLA Team Shop, we strive to make every employee feel valued and respected for who they are and the unique contributions they make. jobs.description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that’s both fun and meaningful.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

About the role...

This is a high-impact L4 TPM role based in New York City, starting in one of Duolingo's fastest-moving pillars: Growth. You'll partner closely with engineering and product leadership to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams and require someone who can bring structure, alignment, and momentum. Beyond Growth, Duolingo has a growing engineering and product presence in New York, and this role puts you at the center of it, building relationships with senior leaders on the ground and taking on high-ROI initiatives across the org as they come.

This is a role for someone who operates at the strategic level: identifying opportunities, shaping programs, and driving outcomes that matter to the business. If you thrive in ambiguity, build trust quickly across engineering and product, and want to have real impact at a company whose product is used by hundreds of millions of people, this role is for you.

🧠  You will...

• Define and drive the roadmap for high-impact, cross-functional initiatives in the Growth pillar and beyond, aligning engineering and product leadership around a shared vision, sequencing the work, and holding teams accountable to outcomes.

• Lead organizational change management as engineering teams adopt new ways of working — building alignment, communicating progress to executives and ICs alike, and helping teams internalize new processes and tooling.

• Lead the delivery of strategic, high-impact cross-functional initiatives from conceptualization to launch, operating with significant autonomy across multiple workstreams.

• Partner with engineering, product, data science, QA, and executive leadership to ensure communication and alignment; serve as the connective tissue between Duolingo strategy and day-to-day execution.

• Leverage deep technical expertise to develop detailed plans with key milestones and goals, identify and mitigate risks, resolve dependencies, remove blockers, and ensure timely and smooth launches.

• Drive decisions when difficult tradeoffs must be made, including those with cross-organizational or company-level impact; model how to navigate hard problems with analytical rigor and a calm, decisive presence.

• Identify systemic issues impacting delivery efficiency company-wide and take swift, collaborative action to resolve them.

• Guide and develop other TPMs and engineering leads, scaling best practices across teams and continuously improving how the organization operates.

✅  You have...

• Proven experience as a TPM, Engineering Lead, or Engineering Manager.

• B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent degree or experience.

• Demonstrated experience leading large-scale technical transformation programs with measurable organizational impact - you've shifted how engineering organizations think and work, not just shipped projects.

• Strong executive presence and influence in a matrix environment - able to build conviction among skeptics, align competing priorities across senior leadership, and drive decisions without direct authority.

• Deep technical credibility - enough to challenge architectural assumptions, spot delivery risks early, and earn the trust of strong engineers.

• Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans that account for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity - and to re-plan quickly when things change, without losing team confidence or momentum.

• A track record of standing up new programs or practices from scratch in ambiguous, high-visibility environments.

• Ability to relocate to NYC.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

• Strong knowledge of software engineering, systems engineering, or similar hands-on technical experience, in addition to program management experience.

• Strong conceptual fluency in LLM-based products and AI infrastructure - enough to ask the right questions, challenge technical assumptions, and identify delivery risks.

• Experience running programs that include machine learning, large datasets, or AI/ML infrastructure.

• Experience working with AWS at scale.

jobs.description:
Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex.
Overview

The incumbent is responsible for entering, analyzing and processing payroll, running reports, and other payroll-related tasks. Assists with the calculation and preparation of corporate payroll tax filings, ensuring the timely remittance of taxes due, with guidance from Corporate Payroll Tax Analyst and Corporate Payroll Tax Supervisor This is a high volume, deadline driven position that requires accuracy and a customer-service focus.

Responsibilities

• Enters, researches, and analyzes employee payroll and tax related data including garnishment, absence management or new hire necessary to process and meet weekly and bi-weekly payroll processing. jobs.title: Unified Communications (UC) Administrator (Intermediate-Level)
jobs.description:
Link Solutions is seeking a Unified Communications (UC) Administrator (Intermediate-Level)to join our team at Fort Stewart, GA.

• • U.S. Citizen • Active DoD Secret Clearance required • DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification or higher required • Non-remote (relocation incentive available)

The Unified Communications (UC) Administrator (Intermediate-Level) will support the South East Region Cyberspace Support Center (RCSC). In this role, you will support critical voice, video, and data communications systems that enable mission success across Army networks. Working alongside network engineers, systems administrators, cybersecurity professionals, and operational stakeholders, you will help maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise Unified Communications and network infrastructure supporting day-to-day mission operations.

Your expertise will directly contribute to secure, reliable, and resilient communications capabilities that enhance operational readiness, improve collaboration across geographically dispersed organizations, and ensure Army personnel remain connected to the information and resources needed to execute their missions effectively.

Job Responsibilities:

• Provide technical leadership, guidance, and daily direction to Network Support personnel.
• Mentor and train team members to enhance technical knowledge, operational effectiveness, and service delivery capabilities.
• Manage, coordinate, and track activities across network operations and support teams.
• Troubleshoot network connectivity, performance, and availability issues, ensuring timely identification and resolution of operational problems.
• Provide operations and maintenance support for Cisco Call Manager and Unified Communications systems.
• Install, configure, administer, support, and maintain Call Managers, Gatekeepers, Gateways, VoIP systems, analog telephony equipment, and related communications infrastructure.
• Install, administer, support, and maintain server hardware, software, operating systems, and associated peripherals.
• Utilize Cisco, Juniper, and Aruba technologies to manage, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.
• Collect, analyze, and review network utilization and performance data to support capacity planning and optimization efforts.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and configuration records.
• Support training initiatives and knowledge transfer activities to improve user and staff understanding of network and communications resources.
• Collaborate with network, systems, and cybersecurity teams to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient service delivery.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Compensation Range:

• $80,000 - $90,000 annually
• Full-Time (Monday-Friday)

Several factors influence final compensation, including relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, and education.

• U.S. Citizen.
• Active DoD Secret Clearance.
• IAT Level II Certification equivalent or higher per DoD 8570/DoD 8140 (CompTIA Security+ CE, CCNA Security, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP, etc.).
• Four (4+) years of experience supporting enterprise IT, help desk, service desk, networking, or communications environments.
• Experience supporting Cisco, Juniper, and Aruba networking technologies.
• Experience administering and supporting VoIP and Unified Communications systems.
• Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
• Experience supporting enterprise voice, video, and data communications environments.
• Knowledge of network infrastructure, routing, switching, and communications technologies.
• Ability to analyze network performance data and support capacity planning efforts
• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer service skills.
• Baseline certification required within six (6) months of hire if not already obtained.

Preferred:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
• Microsoft certification supporting Windows 10, Windows 11, Microsoft 365, or Endpoint Management technologies.
• Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) environments.
• Experience supporting mission-critical systems and high-profile customers.
• Experience providing support to VIP end users and leadership personnel.
• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
• Self-motivated professional with a strong commitment to customer service and mission success.

Link Solutions Inc. offers a competitive compensation and benefits package to include paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, company-paid long and short-term disability, life insurance, referral bonuses, relocation incentive program, certification reimbursement program, retirement, and more.

jobs.title: Creative Resource Manager, Business Marketing
jobs.description:
About the Team

Business Marketing helps organizations understand and put OpenAI’s products to work. Our creative team brings that story to life across campaigns, launches, and everyday marketing experiences. We work closely with marketing partners to make ambitious, thoughtful creative work that connects with business audiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Resource Lead to ensure our most important creative work has the right talent, skills, and capacity behind it. Working directly with the Head of Creative, Business, you will lead resource planning and allocation across our internal creative team, contractors, and agency partners—balancing ongoing campaigns with rapidly emerging launches and requests.

You’ll develop a deep understanding of our creative talent and capabilities, translate business priorities into thoughtful staffing plans, and help teams navigate competing demands without sacrificing craft or quality. This requires both strong judgment and resourcefulness: knowing when to shift capacity, bring in specialist expertise, adjust scope, sequence work differently, or recommend a different delivery model.

AI will be an important part of how you work. You’ll partner with creatives, producers, and Strategy & Operations to build better visibility into demand and capacity, improve resource planning, and reduce repetitive coordination. Your success will show up in how effectively talent is deployed, how clearly staffing decisions are made, and whether the team can deliver excellent work at a sustainable pace.

This role is based in San Francisco.  We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

You’ll be responsible for:

 - Own creative resource planning and allocation across internal teams, contractors, and agencies, matching each project with the appropriate skills, experience, and capacity.

 - Maintain a clear, current view of team availability, capabilities, assignments, and upcoming demand across design, copy, motion, video, and web.

 - Build capacity forecasts and staffing scenarios that help creative leadership anticipate gaps, make informed tradeoffs, and plan for both sustained programs and fast-moving launches.

 - Partner with Strategy & Operations, creative leads, and producers to assess incoming work, understand its resource needs, and develop clear staffing recommendations.

 - Develop a deep understanding of each team member’s strengths, development goals, and workload, using that context to make thoughtful assignments and identify opportunities for growth.

 - Recommend the right resource model for each need—internal talent, contractors, agencies, specialists, or self-service—based on priorities, complexity, timing, cost, and creative ambition.

 - Build and maintain a strong network of contractors, freelancers, and agency partners so the team can quickly access specialized skills or additional capacity.

 - Manage contractor and agency assignments in partnership with creative leadership and producers, ensuring clarity on scope, timing, cost, and expected outcomes.

 - Manage the creative resourcing budget within agreed funding, forecasting commitments, surfacing risks, and recommending adjustments to the talent mix in partnership with Business Operations.

jobs.title: American Girl Seasonal Forklift Driver: 1st Shift
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The American Girl Distribution Center in DeForest, Wisconsin is seeking Seasonal Forklift Drivers to support operations during our peak business season from September through December. This is a temporary seasonal position established to provide additional staffing support during the holiday fulfillment period. Employment in this role is expected to continue through the seasonal assignment and is not intended to be a regular or permanent position.

Seasonal Forklift Drivers are responsible for the safe and efficient movement of inventory throughout the distribution center, ensuring products are received, stored, replenished, and distributed accurately to support customer demand. Working in a fast-paced, automated warehouse environment, this role requires the ability to safely operate material handling equipment, perform inventory transactions, and support warehouse operations while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and productivity.

The ideal candidate is dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Successful candidates demonstrate sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively to meet operational goals.

The regular schedule for this position is 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; however, work hours are subject to change based on business needs, and occasional weekend shifts may be required during the seasonal assignment. Candidates must be available to work a flexible schedule throughout the duration of the peak season.

Key Responsibilities

• Safely operate forklifts and other material handling equipment in accordance with company policies and safety standards.
• Work collaboratively with Material Handlers and warehouse team members to unload inbound trailers and support the timely flow of product throughout the distribution center.
• Transport and place inventory in reserve, active, breakout, customer program, and dock locations using appropriate lift equipment.
• Unload inbound trailers and move product efficiently while maintaining inventory accuracy.
• Support the movement and replenishment of inventory to ensure operational demands are met.
• Utilize Windows-based warehouse management systems to initiate replenishments, perform inventory moves, cancel tasks, and complete other inventory transactions.
• Use RF scanning equipment to accurately process receipts, inspection releases, transfers, inventory movements, and other warehouse transactions.
• Complete daily pre-operational inspections of assigned equipment, including forklifts and safety harnesses, and promptly report equipment concerns or malfunctions to leadership.
• Maintain a safe and organized work environment by collecting and relocating empty pallets, reusable slip sheets, and empty bin boxes.
• Assist with additional warehouse functions, including unloading containers, unboxing finished products, loading customer shipments, and supporting special projects as assigned.
• Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.

La Oportunidad

El Centro de Distribución de American Girl en DeForest, Wisconsin, está contratando Operadores de Montacargas Temporales para apoyar nuestras operaciones durante la temporada alta, de septiembre a diciembre.

Esta es una posición temporal de temporada, creada para fortalecer nuestro equipo durante el periodo de mayor demanda por las fiestas de fin de año. Se espera que el empleo continúe durante toda la temporada, pero no está diseñado para convertirse en un puesto regular o permanente.

Como Operador de Montacargas, serás responsable de mover mercancía de manera segura y eficiente dentro del centro de distribución, asegurando que los productos se reciban, almacenen, reabastezcan y distribuyan correctamente para satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Trabajarás en un almacén moderno y automatizado, donde la seguridad, la calidad y la productividad son prioridades fundamentales.

Buscamos personas responsables, organizadas y orientadas al detalle, que puedan adaptarse a un entorno dinámico y de ritmo rápido. Los candidatos exitosos son capaces de administrar varias tareas al mismo tiempo, tomar buenas decisiones y colaborar eficazmente con otros miembros del equipo para alcanzar los objetivos operativos.

El horario habitual para esta posición es de 7:00 a. m. a 3:30 p. m. Sin embargo, los horarios pueden variar según las necesidades del negocio y ocasionalmente pueden requerirse turnos durante los fines de semana. Los candidatos deben tener disponibilidad para trabajar con horarios flexibles durante toda la temporada alta.

Responsabilidades Principales

• Operar montacargas y otros equipos de manejo de materiales de manera segura, siguiendo las políticas de la empresa y las normas de seguridad establecidas.
• Colaborar con los Manipuladores de Materiales y otros miembros del equipo para descargar remolques entrantes y mantener el flujo oportuno de mercancía dentro del centro de distribución.
• Transportar y ubicar inventario en diferentes áreas del almacén, incluyendo ubicaciones de reserva, áreas activas, zonas de preparación, programas para clientes y muelles de carga.
• Descargar remolques y mover productos de manera eficiente, manteniendo la precisión del inventario.
• Apoyar el movimiento y reabastecimiento de mercancía para garantizar el cumplimiento de las necesidades operativas.
• Utilizar sistemas de gestión de almacén en computadora para realizar movimientos de inventario, generar reabastecimientos, cancelar tareas y completar otras transacciones relacionadas.
• Utilizar escáneres de radiofrecuencia (RF) para procesar con precisión recibos, transferencias, liberaciones de inspección y movimientos de inventario.
• Realizar inspecciones diarias antes de operar el equipo asignado, incluyendo montacargas y arneses de seguridad, e informar cualquier problema o falla de inmediato.
• Mantener un área de trabajo limpia, segura y organizada, retirando y reubicando tarimas vacías, láminas deslizantes reutilizables y cajas vacías.
• Apoyar otras funciones de almacén según sea necesario, incluyendo descarga de contenedores, desempaque de productos terminados, carga de pedidos para clientes y participación en proyectos especiales.
• Cumplir con todas las políticas, procedimientos y normas de seguridad de la empresa.

Qualifications

• Valid driver's license required.
• Must be available to work the full seasonal assignment period, approximately September through December, including schedule changes and occasional weekend shifts as business needs require.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to successfully complete company-provided forklift training and certification and safely operate material handling equipment.
• Ability to quickly adapt to changing priorities, assignments, and operational requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a team environment.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks with accuracy and efficiency.
• Strong math, reading, and comprehension skills.
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to maintaining inventory accuracy.
• Previous warehouse, inventory control, or material handling experience required.
• Experience using Windows-based software applications and warehouse systems, or the ability to quickly learn new technologies.
• Commitment to workplace safety, quality standards, and reliable attendance.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, and pull materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform repetitive motions throughout the workday.
• Ability to safely operate powered industrial equipment for extended periods of time.
• Ability to work in a warehouse environment and wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) as assigned.

Requisitos

• Se requiere contar con una licencia de conducir válida.
• Debe tener disponibilidad para trabajar durante toda la temporada, aproximadamente de septiembre a diciembre, incluyendo posibles cambios de horario y turnos ocasionales los fines de semana según las necesidades del negocio.
• Capacidad para levantar hasta 50 libras (23 kg).
• Capacidad para completar exitosamente la capacitación y certificación de montacargas proporcionada por la empresa y operar equipos de manejo de materiales de manera segura.
• Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a cambios en prioridades, asignaciones y necesidades operativas.
• Habilidad para trabajar de manera independiente y, al mismo tiempo, colaborar eficazmente como parte de un equipo.
• Excelentes habilidades organizativas y capacidad para manejar múltiples tareas con precisión y eficiencia.
• Buenas habilidades matemáticas, de lectura y comprensión.
• Gran atención al detalle y compromiso con la exactitud del inventario.
• Se requiere experiencia previa en almacén, control de inventario o manejo de materiales.
• Experiencia utilizando aplicaciones de software basadas en Windows y sistemas de almacén, o capacidad para aprender nuevas tecnologías rápidamente.
• Compromiso con la seguridad en el lugar de trabajo, los estándares de calidad y la asistencia confiable.

Requisitos Físicos

• Capacidad para levantar, cargar, empujar y jalar materiales de hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de manera frecuente.
• Capacidad para permanecer de pie, caminar, agacharse, estirarse y realizar movimientos repetitivos durante la jornada laboral.
• Capacidad para operar equipos industriales motorizados de manera segura durante períodos prolongados.
• Capacidad para trabajar en un entorno de almacén y utilizar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido según sea asignado.

How We Work:

American Girl is subsidiary of Mattel, a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.

• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.

• We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

American Girl is a premium brand for girls and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mattel, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAT, www.mattel.com), a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in more than 195 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies.

Mattel is recognized as a Great Place to Work™ and as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators in 2022.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, veterans, military spouses, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

Cómo Trabajamos

American Girl es una subsidiaria de Mattel, una empresa impulsada por un propósito: inspirar a las nuevas generaciones a descubrir la magia de la infancia y alcanzar su máximo potencial. Vivimos este propósito a través de los siguientes valores:

• Colaboramos: Ser parte de Mattel significa formar parte de un solo equipo con valores compartidos y objetivos en común. Cada persona cuenta, y sabemos que trabajar juntos nos permite lograr mejores resultados. La colaboración está en el centro de todo lo que hacemos, y nuestra capacidad de trabajar en equipo es una de nuestras mayores fortalezas.
• Innovamos: En Mattel siempre estamos buscando formas nuevas y mejores de crear productos y experiencias que inspiren. Sin importar tu puesto dentro de la organización, tienes la oportunidad de generar un impacto real. Valoramos las nuevas ideas y fomentamos iniciativas que desafíen la forma tradicional de pensar.
• Ejecutamos: Somos una empresa orientada a resultados. Nos esforzamos por alcanzar la excelencia y ofrecer resultados de la más alta calidad. Creemos en la responsabilidad, el compromiso y la autonomía, porque sabemos que las personas dan lo mejor de sí mismas cuando cuentan con las herramientas y la confianza necesarias para tener éxito.

Quiénes Somos

American Girl es una marca líder en productos para niñas y una subsidiaria de propiedad total de Mattel, Inc., una de las empresas de juguetes y entretenimiento familiar más importantes del mundo. A través de nuestras marcas más reconocidas, como Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA y Polly Pocket, conectamos con familias y seguidores alrededor del mundo mediante juguetes, contenido, productos para consumidores, experiencias digitales y eventos en vivo. Nuestros productos se comercializan en más de 195 países, en colaboración con algunas de las principales empresas minoristas y plataformas de comercio electrónico del mundo.

Mattel ha sido reconocida como un Great Place to Work™ y como uno de los Best Workplaces for Innovators de Fast Company.

Conoce más sobre nosotros en:

• https://jobs.mattel.com/
• https://www.instagram.com/MattelCareers

En Mattel creemos que cada persona aporta perspectivas y experiencias únicas. Por eso, estamos comprometidos con mantener un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso, donde todos puedan ser auténticamente ellos mismos.

Mattel es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Damos la bienvenida a todos los candidatos calificados, incluyendo mujeres, minorías, veteranos, cónyuges de militares, personas con discapacidades y personas de todas las orientaciones sexuales e identidades de género.

jobs.description:
Hourly Pay Rate: $25.00 - $31.00

Monday to Friday:  6:00am to 3:00pm

Guaranteed 40 hours +

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.
