jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

Mirantis is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our IT team in a hands-on role spanning two areas: the networking that underpins our internal AI labs, and the broader company network infrastructure. This is the second dedicated networking role on the team, working alongside our existing network engineer in Europe to scale a function that has grown well beyond what one person can carry. The role is based in Silicon Valley, with regular on-site presence expected at our local datacenter/colocation facilities.

As Mirantis invests in AI compute, the lab environments behind it have become critical infrastructure that IT operates as a shared platform — engineering groups across the company consume them as tenants. Our job is to make that possible: high-throughput fabric for GPU and compute-intensive workloads, clean segmentation between tenants, and reliable connectivity back to corporate and cloud environments. This is a hardware-, networking-, and architecture-focused mandate — building and running the underlying infrastructure, not the AI/ML work that runs on top of it. In parallel, our day-to-day company network — offices, datacenter/colo presence, cloud interconnects, and remote access — requires ongoing engineering ownership rather than best-effort maintenance.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate the network and physical infrastructure for the AI labs and evolve it as demand grows, while sharing responsibility for the corporate and datacenter network. You will work close to the hardware where it matters, partner with the IT, Security, and engineering teams who depend on these environments, and help establish the standards and documentation that let this function scale as a proper team.

Key Responsibilities

AI Labs Network Architecture & Operations: Design, build, and operate the network fabric for our internal AI labs — high-throughput switching for GPU and compute-intensive workloads, with the segmentation needed to run them as a shared platform for engineering groups across the company. Own capacity planning and expansion as demand grows.

Datacenter & Colocation Infrastructure: Own the physical and logical infrastructure at our Silicon Valley datacenter/colocation facility — network fabric, rack and cabling standards, cross-connects, power/port planning, and hands-on structured work, with regular on-site presence for buildout, changes, and troubleshooting. Operate the network at our other datacenter locations as well (including in Europe), where physical work is handled through contractors or remote hands rather than direct access.

Server & Hardware Support: Provide hands-on support for server and datacenter hardware — racking, cabling, provisioning, firmware/BMC (iDRAC/iLO) management, and physical troubleshooting. Perform this work directly on-site where practical, or coordinate it through third-party contractors and remote-hands services as needed.

Corporate & Campus Networking: Share ownership of the day-to-day company network — offices, LAN/WLAN, remote access, and connectivity between on-prem/colo, corporate, and cloud environments (site-to-site VPN, cloud interconnects such as AWS, and SD-WAN where appropriate) — alongside our existing network engineer in Europe. Bring these environments up to a consistent, well-engineered standard rather than best-effort maintenance, ensuring routing, redundancy, and performance meet the needs of both the AI labs and corporate users.

Network Security & Segmentation: Partner with Corporate/Product Security to operationalize network security baselines — firewall policy, ACLs, network access control, least-privilege segmentation, and secure management planes across all environments.

Monitoring, Observability & Capacity: Implement and maintain network and infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and traffic visibility across labs, datacenter, corporate, and cloud environments. Use it to catch issues early, plan capacity, and inform architecture decisions.

Standards, Documentation & Automation: Establish network and infrastructure standards, runbooks, and clear architecture documentation as this function scales into a proper team. Automate configuration and repetitive operations (IaC / network automation) to reduce manual work and drift.

Incident Response & On-Call: Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to network and infrastructure incidents across labs and corporate environments. Triage and resolve production issues, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence.

• 5+ years of experience in a Network Engineering role, with networking as the core of your background.
• Strong hands-on experience designing and operating switching and routing in datacenter and/or colocation environments — spine/leaf or top-of-rack fabrics, VLANs, VXLAN/EVPN, BGP/OSPF, and structured cabling.
• Solid experience with firewalls, ACLs, VPNs (site-to-site and remote access), and network segmentation. Vendor experience with the likes of Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Palo Alto, or Fortinet.
• Comfortable working physically on-site in a datacenter — racking, cabling, cross-connects, and troubleshooting at the hardware level — and coordinating remote-hands or contractor work at sites without direct access.
• Working knowledge of server hardware — provisioning, firmware/BMC management (iDRAC/iLO), and physical troubleshooting — with the willingness to own the compute layer alongside the network.
• Experience with cloud and hybrid connectivity (AWS interconnects, VPN, SD-WAN) and how on-prem, colo, and cloud environments fit together.
• Familiarity with network monitoring and observability (e.g., SNMP-based tooling, NetFlow, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar) and using it for capacity planning.
• Scripting/automation and network automation or Infrastructure as Code (Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) — hands-on experience is a strong plus; alternatively, a demonstrated ability and strong desire to pick these up quickly.
• Prior experience with on-call rotations and incident management.
• Good understanding of network and infrastructure security fundamentals — least-privilege access, secure management planes, and segmentation. High-throughput and GPU/AI cluster networking (RDMA/RoCE, InfiniBand, high-speed Ethernet) — existing experience is a strong plus; alternatively, a strong desire and ability to ramp up quickly in this area.
• Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks is a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to document standards, runbooks, and architectural decisions clearly.

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
• Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
• Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
• Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
• Professional development and training;
• Attend conferences and working groups;
• Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
• Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

jobs.description:

What you'll do

As the third person on the team, you'll shape how we handle day-to-day compliance operations and have real autonomy to drive impact.  - Review account activity and make informed decisions using AI-assisted analysis. You'll investigate payment approval requests, flag anomalies through pattern recognition tools, and make sound judgment calls on approval or escalation, combining human judgment with AI insights.

 - Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

jobs.title: Scheduler & Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The in-office Scheduler & Care Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting Otterbein's home health ministries by coordinating patient visits and clinician schedules to ensure timely, efficient, and high-quality care delivery. This position serves as the central point of communication for scheduling activities, balancing patient needs, clinician productivity, geographic efficiency, and regulatory requirements. The Scheduler works closely with clinical leadership, field staff, referral sources, and patients to maintain continuity of care while supporting organizational goals and exceptional customer service.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Scheduling & Care Coordination

• Coordinate and maintain daily schedules for RNs, LPNs, therapists, aides, and other field clinicians.

• Assign patient visits based on clinician availability, qualifications, geographic location, and productivity expectations.

• Optimize schedules to maximize efficiency and minimize travel time.

• Monitor visit frequencies to ensure compliance with physician orders and plans of care.

• Adjust schedules in real time due to admissions, discharges, call-offs, schedule changes, and urgent patient needs.

• Coordinate start-of-care visits and communicate scheduling information to patients and clinicians.

• Maintain staffing coverage and coordinate contingency plans when scheduling conflicts arise.

• Monitor McBee portal.

Communication & Customer Service

• Serve as the primary scheduling contact for patients, families, clinicians, and office personnel.

• Communicate schedule changes promptly and professionally.

• Maintain positive working relationships with patients, referral sources, and internal staff.

• Assist in resolving scheduling concerns while promoting a positive patient experience.

• Participate in team meetings and operational discussions regarding staffing and productivity.

Productivity & Reporting

• Monitor clinician schedules to support agency productivity standards and operational goals.

• Generate scheduling reports and track visit completion trends.

• Identify scheduling gaps, capacity concerns, and staffing needs.

• Assist leadership with workload balancing and resource allocation.

• Maintain accurate documentation and scheduling information within electronic systems.

Compliance & Documentation

• Ensure all scheduling activities align with agency policies, payer requirements, and regulatory standards.

• Maintain confidentiality of patient and employee information.

• Ensure data entered into scheduling systems is accurate and current.

• Support audits and quality improvement activities related to scheduling and patient care coordination.

This job description is not meant to be an exhaustive list of duties or responsibilities and may change over time based on the strategy and needs of the organization.

Experience & Qualifications

• Associate degree preferred; equivalent education and experience considered.

• Experience with Microsoft Office and electronic medical record and scheduling systems preferred, such as Careficient, MatrixCare, WellSky, or HCHB.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication and customer service skills.

• Ability to analyze scheduling needs and solve problems quickly.

BENEFITS*

Financial Security

Otterbein SeniorLife consists of lifestyle communities, revolutionary small house neighborhoods, home health, and hospice care in Ohio, Michigan and Indiana.  We offer different lifestyle options for seniors through independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehab, memory support, respite care, in-home care, and hospice services.

Follow your passion and apply today to begin a meaningful career as a Scheduler & Care Coordinator at Otterbein!

jobs.title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role

Search is changing fast. AI-generated answers now appear above many of the queries buyers use, search engines increasingly reward sites that are fast, well-structured, and clearly authoritative, and the path from search to click looks different than it did a few years ago. That makes a strong technical foundation more important than ever. It decides whether a site's most important pages get crawled, understood, ranked, and cited.

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist at Motive, you'll be a core stakeholder in the technical health and structure of our web presence. You'll lead our technical SEO program end to end, from site health and architecture to international SEO and new page launches. You'll also use AI-assisted workflows to find and prioritize the work that will have the most business impact.

You'll partner closely with Web, Web Engineering, Content, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing. You'll also work alongside teammates focused on content SEO and AI search, so that technical, content, and AI-search work reinforce each other.

What You'll Do

• Lead execution for Motive's technical SEO program, conducting recurring audits covering crawlability, indexation, rendering, redirects, canonical tags, internal link structures, structured data, and page quality.

• Use and help improve AI-assisted workflows that turn crawl and search performance data into a clear, prioritized list of fixes, with human judgment applied before anything ships.

• Identify and resolve content cannibalization and duplication, working with Content and Web to consolidate, redirect, or differentiate pages so each topic has one clear page that ranks.

• Partner with Web Engineering to improve site errors, warnings, and performance issues on key pages & templates, with recommendations tied to impact on traffic and conversion.

• Optimize high-intent product, solution, and industry pages so they rank and convert on non-brand searches.

• Improve information architecture, navigation, and internal linking so our pages connect cleanly and capture long-tail demand.

• Drive technical SEO across our international sites, including hreflang, regional sitemaps, canonical strategy, and localized templates. Partner with regional marketing teams and native-language reviewers so localized pages reflect how local buyers actually search.

• Define technical SEO requirements for new templates, page types, and CMS capabilities, and provide SEO QA for launches, migrations, and redesigns.

• Turn findings into clear, engineering-ready requirements that explain what's wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it.

• Act as the primary technical SEO partner for web and marketing stakeholders, and help non-technical partners understand trade-offs and impact.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of technical SEO experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex, multi-template environments.

• Bachelor's degree required.

• Deep expertise in crawling, indexation, JavaScript SEO, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, hreflang, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, performance, and mobile UX.

• Experience scaling information architecture across category, product, long-tail, international, and localized pages.

• Knowledge of schema.org/JSON-LD implementation and validation, plus diagnosing keyword cannibalization at scale.

• Proven partnership with web and engineering teams to deliver technical fixes and measure impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline.

• Experience applying AI or agentic workflows to automate SEO audits and recommendations with appropriate human oversight.

• Strong understanding of AEO, generative search, crawler access, structured data, page architecture, algorithm updates, AI search features, and evolving SEO measurement.

• Strong analytical skills with large crawl and search datasets; proficiency in Google Search Console, Semrush, Screaming Frog, log analyzers, and web analytics.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. Motive uses three geographic zones to determine pay range. For this role, the compensation ranges are:

San Francisco, California

$97,000—$121,000 USD

U.S. metropolitan areas: New York City Area and Seattle, WA

$93,000—$116,000 USD

Other locations in the United States

$84,000—$105,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.

Regarding US-based roles, depending on your role and primary work location, Motive Technologies, Inc. (“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.

Non-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
AppsFlyer is the global leader in mobile attribution and marketing analytics, empowering thousands of the world's leading apps and brands to make smarter growth decisions. For most of these brands, the website is just as important as the app: it's where many customers discover them, sign up and buy. Yet web measurement is still fragmented, built on last-click, cookies and siloed tools that don't connect to the rest of the customer journey. Our Web Attribution product brings AppsFlyer's trusted, independent measurement to the web.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead AppsFlyer's expansion from mobile to web. In this role, you will own Web Attribution end-to-end: how AppsFlyer measures the paid and owned channels that drive website conversions, from search and social to video, AI assistance, CTV and influencers, and how those results connect with app and other platforms into one view of the customer.

Join one of AppsFlyer's most strategic bets: bringing the market leader in mobile measurement to the web, in a small, fast-moving team with real visibility across R&D, data and customers.

Help leading global brands get independent, trusted web measurement, while shaping a brand-new product area from the ground up.

What you’ll do

• Own the Web Attribution product end-to-end, from discovery and strategy to execution, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.

• Define and drive the roadmap for web performance measurement: attribution of any channel to web conversions (clicks, views, CTV and more), multi-touch, web analytics and reporting, and ad network integrations and optimization postbacks.

• Lead in a privacy-first world: build durable measurement as cookies, identifiers and browser rules keep changing, through first-party data, probabilistic and modeled approaches, and partner integrations.

• Work closely with R&D (Backend, Frontend, Data Engineering, Data Science) to build scalable, high-performance measurement products.

• Work with ad networks and platform partners to build and expand web integrations, bringing mobile-grade measurement to the web: granular, independent attribution and conversion data sent back to partners to power campaign optimization.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions and Marketing on positioning, competitive strategy, pricing and adoption, in a market with well-established competitors.

• Engage directly with customers, from mobile-first brands to web-first ecommerce, fintech and subscription businesses, to validate direction and drive adoption.

• Drive prioritization in a high-demand environment with multiple stakeholders and competing initiatives.

What you have

• Passion to solve, build, and provide real value to your customers

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in data-heavy B2B SaaS environments.

• Proven experience building and scaling measurement, analytics, or performance marketing products.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to define KPIs, interpret data, and use data to guide product decisions.

• Experience working closely with engineering and data teams on complex, scalable systems.

• Ability to operate in ambiguity and bring structure to complex problem spaces.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working cross-functionally in large organizations.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus points

• Deep familiarity with the web measurement ecosystem: web analytics tools, tag managers, conversion APIs, and how the major ad platforms report web conversions.

• Familiarity with attribution models, view-through and multi-touch attribution, incrementality, and privacy-related measurement challenges (cookie loss, browser restrictions, consent).

• Experience with web-to-app, cross-device or cross-platform measurement.

• Technical background in web development, analytics, data science, or engineering.

• Recommended by an AppsFlyer employee

As a global company operating from 25 offices across 19 countries, we reflect the human mosaic of the diverse and multicultural world in which we live. We ensure equal opportunities for all of our employees and promote the recruitment of diverse talents to our global teams without consideration of race, gender, culture, or sexual orientation. jobs.title: Full-stack Engineer - Creative Agents
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team where engineers own complete problems across the full stack: frontend, backend, agent architecture and infrastructure. You should be equally comfortable building a user-facing feature, designing the services behind it, and deploying and operating the system in production. You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.

 - Developing agent capabilities and integrations, including model orchestration, creative tools and reliable asynchronous workflows for audio, image and video generation.

 - Building and operating the infrastructure behind these features, improving quality, performance, scalability and security through evaluations, monitoring and testing.

 - Owning a problem area from discovery and prototyping to deployment and ongoing operation, working closely with product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving a live product, with room to experiment and directly influence the product's direction.




REQUIREMENTS

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

 - Strong engineering skills across both frontend and backend, with a track record of independently building complete production applications.

 - Confidence designing user interfaces, backend services, APIs and data models, and understanding how these components work together as a system.

 - Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, asynchronous processing, testing and observability, with the ability to debug and resolve problems across the full stack.

 - Evidence of end-to-end ownership, strong product judgement and clear communication, taking ambiguous problems from technical design through to shipping and ongoing operation.

You should be excited about creative agents and comfortable learning quickly as models, tools and user needs evolve.

Hands-on experience building production agents, evaluations, MCP integrations, creative editors or multimodal products would be particularly valuable, as would experience building in a small, fast-moving team.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Service Manager-Cortland Hickory Hollow
jobs.description:
At Cortland, we operate with a forward-thinking approach that challenges conventional norms and actively seeks insights beyond traditional industry boundaries. As a recognized leader in the multifamily sector, our focus on performance, innovation, and disciplined execution continues to drive strong growth and market leadership. We are committed to building a best-in-class organization by empowering top talent with the resources, autonomy, and support needed to deliver results and advance their careers in a high-performance environment.

Role Overview

As the Service Manager, you are responsible for leading the maintenance team and ensuring the physical integrity, safety, and overall functionality of a multimillion‑dollar multifamily community. You oversee all maintenance operations, guide preventative programs, manage workflow and staffing, and ensure timely, high‑quality service that supports resident satisfaction and asset preservation. This role combines strong technical expertise with leadership, organization, and exceptional customer service.

Maintenance Leadership & Technical Expertise

• Diagnose and resolve complex maintenance issues across electrical, plumbing, HVAC, appliance, structural, lighting, and security systems.

• Ensure the community operates efficiently by proactively identifying areas needing repair or improvement.

• Guide the team in anticipating and preventing resident issues through consistent upkeep and early problem detection.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for creating a safe, reliable, and worry‑free living environment.

Team Management & Performance Oversight

• Support a team of maintenance technicians, ensuring timely, high‑quality completion of routine maintenance and repairs.

• Provide training, guidance, and mentorship, encouraging adherence to safety protocols and company standards.

• Assign and prioritize daily tasks, inspect completed work, and step into complete hands‑on repairs when necessary.

• Promote a strong safety culture with continuous attention to hazards, preventative actions, and compliance.

• Help manage the on-call rotation and provide support during emergency situations.

Organization, Budget & Vendor Coordination

• Oversee service request management, preventive maintenance schedules, and maintenance records.

• Track, manage, and allocate the maintenance budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.

• Maintain supply and parts inventory to support timely completion of work orders.

• Coordinate with outside vendors, ensuring timely, quality service and adherence to scope and budget.

The Team Leader

• Fearlessly lead a team of technicians as they perform routine preventive maintenance and make timely, high-quality repairs

• Share your wisdom and insights with the team, prioritize their tasks, make sure they follow protocol, and motivate them to go above and beyond the call of duty

• Oversee and inspect your team’s work, and sometimes perform the tasks yourself

• Make sure your team is constantly on the lookout for areas of concern, using our “safety first” motto

The Organizer

• Keep track of a crazy number of details without feeling like your head might explode

• Act as the gatekeeper of maintenance information — tracking and assigning everything from resident service requests to preventive maintenance records

• Manage to keep the service vendors, maintenance budget, and supplies inventory on track

Qualifications

• 3-5+ years of experience in maintenance, including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC; Multifamily experience preferred.

• Universal EPA and CPO certifications are required.

• Valid Class E driver’s license.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations including EPA, OSHA, ADA, and Fair Housing.

• Ability to read and interpret maintenance instructions, technical manuals, and equipment documentation.

• Strong customer‑service and communication skills.

• Ability to work evenings, weekends, and participate in on‑call rotations as needed.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Associate
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



The Accounts Receivable (AR) Associate role will be central to our finance team, supporting our Accounting Manager in delivering accurate and reliable financial statements and reports.



WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN

The role will be heavily involved in the month-end close process for multiple entities. We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable (AR) Associate to join our finance team. The AR Associate will be responsible for managing incoming payments, maintaining accurate financial records, and ensuring the timely collection of outstanding invoices. 
This role is critical to maintaining healthy cash flow and fostering strong client relationships.


As we are still a small team, you can expect to get involved in many aspects of the finance function; however, your key responsibilities will include:

 - Process and post customer payments and refunds accurately and promptly

 - Follow up with company stakeholders regarding outstanding invoices and resolve payment discrepancies

 - Reconcile accounts receivable ledger to ensure all payments are accounted for and properly posted

 - Generate and distribute regular aging reports and statements

 - Investigate and resolve billing issues or disputes in collaboration with sales and customer service teams

 - Prepare bank deposits and assist with month-end closing procedures

 - Assist in maintaining accurate records of accounts and financial statements transactions

 - Support audits and provide documentation as needed



WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first or fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow.

However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

 - A solid accounting background, with experience in journals, accruals, prepayments, and balance sheet reconciliations

 - A good understanding of accounting principles is required to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting

 - Comfortable with tight month-end close deadlines and the ability to deliver against deadlines

 - Experience in dealing with external auditors

 - NetSuite and Ramp experience is ideal

 - Advanced proficiency with Excel for financial analysis

 - Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

 - Strong written and verbal skills to present financial insights clearly, with the ability to work cross-functionally to support business decisions




AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.

Tier 2 — For this role, you're expected to be AI-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G&A roles)

One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.



 


A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.





HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU:


We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent Team.

 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above).

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!



WHAT WE OFFER


We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. Here’s what you can 
expect from us:

 - Salary range of $60,000 - $70,000

 - 401k

 - Healthcare, Vision, and Dental

 - All the equipment needed for you to do your role effectively

 - Personal Development budgets

 - 18 days PTO plus public holidays

 - 10 paid sick days

 - Inclusive policies designed by our team, for our team




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Provisioning Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE

Cognism is the leading provider of European B2B data and sales intelligence. Ambitious businesses of every size use our platform to discover, connect, and engage with qualified decision-makers faster and close more deals. Headquartered in London with global offices, Cognism’s contact data and contextual signals are trusted by thousands of revenue teams to eliminate the guesswork from prospecting.

OUR WORK MODEL

Hybrid: This is a hybrid role, requiring you to work from our local office 2–3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely on other days.

YOUR ROLE

As a Provisioning Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our customers and internal teams have the right access to Cognism’s products and services. You’ll manage account provisioning and user access, support trials, investigate account-related issues, and work closely with teams across the business to resolve requests efficiently and accurately.

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple systems and processes in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

YOUR CHALLENGES & OPPORTUNITIES

• Manage customer and internal account provisioning through our internal systems, ensuring accurate and efficient account setup, access, and lifecycle management.

• Create and update user accounts with the appropriate access levels, supporting a smooth onboarding experience.

• Verify user and account information to maintain accurate records and support security and compliance requirements.

• Partner with Sales and other customer-facing teams to provision trial and customer accounts accurately and on time, supporting a smooth customer journey.

• Handle internal account setup and provisioning requests across departments, helping teams work efficiently.

• Investigate and troubleshoot account and provisioning-related issues, identifying root causes and driving requests through to resolution.

• Collaborate with Support, Sales, Customer Success, and other internal teams to resolve provisioning requests, account issues, and more complex cases.

• Maintain a high level of accuracy across provisioning activities and follow established processes and usage policies.

• Contribute to global coverage by working in a rotating shift schedule, ensuring continuous support across time zones.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

• Adapt quickly to new technologies, tools, and processes, and feel comfortable working across multiple systems.

• Organize and multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment, managing competing priorities while maintaining accuracy.

• Approach problems analytically, investigating issues, identifying root causes, and finding effective solutions.

• Communicate clearly with both internal teams and customers, ensuring smooth collaboration and support.

• Be a detail-oriented, proactive self-starter who is intellectually curious, comfortable asking questions, and able to navigate ambiguity.

• Have familiarity with customer support and CRM tools such as Zendesk and Salesforce, or the ability to quickly learn similar platforms.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Battery Cell
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Coordinate battery cell engineering activities between Scout, Volkswagen Group, and battery cell suppliers

• Serve as the subject matter expert for lithium-ion battery cell technologies at Scout.

• Provide on site Scout support at cell supplier facilities at critical milestone events

• Develop battery cell technical requirements aligned to vehicle performance, durability, and safety requirements.

• Work with R&D and cell suppliers to develop advanced battery cells, optimizing for performance, energy density, and lifespan while considering manufacturability and cost-effectiveness

• Work closely with suppliers and research teams to evaluate and select appropriate materials for cathodes, anodes, electrolytes, and separators to improve cell performance and safety.

• Oversee the prototyping and testing of battery cells, including performance characterization, cycle life testing, and safety assessments.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including battery pack engineers, electrical engineers, and systems engineers to integrate battery cells into complete energy storage systems to support vehicle performance and durability.

• Support lithium-ion battery cell technical evaluations.

• Monitor cell supplier development activities and qualification processes

• Lead / Support technical discussions regarding cell design changes and problem resolution

• Support integration of cells into modules and battery packs

• Work with BMS, thermal, mechanical, safety, and vehicle integration teams

• Provide technical expertise for compliance testing and certification processes.

• Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation in battery cell technology.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Novi, Michigan.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).

• 12+ years of experience in lithium-ion battery cell design and development for automotive applications.

• Proven experience leading lithium-ion battery cell development programs from concept through production launch

• Knowledge of Volkswagen group battery cell development and release processes.

• Strong understanding of battery testing, validation methodologies, and performance characterization techniques

• Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes and quality control methods

• Knowledge of automotive battery regulations and standards, including FMVSS 305, UNECE R100, UN 38.3, IEC, and UL standards.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

• Ability to be self-sufficient with minimal direction to meet deliverables.

• Strong interpersonal skills to interface with colleagues and suppliers around the world

• Willingness to support frequent travel domestically and internationally to supplier and development locations including Germany and Korea. Valid passport & drivers license required.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range =  $160,000.00 - $192,500.00

Internal leveling code: IC7

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Finance & Compensation Professional
jobs.description:
Founded in 1999, Viking Global Investors (“Viking”) is a global investment firm with a long-term, fundamental, research-intensive approach to investing. Viking manages more than $56 billion of capital across public and private investments. Viking has offices in Stamford, New York, Hong Kong, London, and San Francisco, and is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. For more information, please visit vikingglobal.com.

JOB FUNCTION

Viking is looking for a Finance and Compensation Professional to join the compensation team, which sits within Finance and reports to the Chief Financial Officer. The role is instrumental in the design and execution of the Firm’s evolving compensation processes, and will report to the Director of Compensation and Financial Reporting.

The Finance and Compensation Professional will partner closely with their manager to design and operate strategic, cross-departmental workflows, propose and refine compensation frameworks, and develop a deep understanding of the market context for compensation firm-wide. The team is also responsible for making and checking complex, critical, and often time-sensitive calculations, and for partnering closely with Human Resources, Accounting and Tax, department managers, and service providers. This hands-on role offers a mix of data modeling and analysis, workflow and project ownership, and reporting and coordination for a variety of stakeholders and decision-makers. The compensation team handles extremely sensitive information, so it is critical that the new team member be able to display discretion and judgment.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Thoughtful planning and precise execution of compensation workflows

• Complex calculation management, including identifying and implementing efficiencies

• Supporting the administration of the Firm’s carry programs, including participant-level calculations, allocations, and reporting

• Preparation of high-quality analyses and materials for managers and key decision-makers

• Accurate and timely administration of multi-jurisdictional payroll, including liaising with service providers and Human Resources

• Producing and optimizing payroll and compensation-related reporting for departmental stakeholders, including Tax Compliance, Corporate Accounting, and Human Resources

• Playing a key role in administering the Firm’s 401(k) plan

• Partnering with Recruiting on offer processes, surveys, and other research and workflows

• Evaluating third-party advisors and compensation technology, and helping implement automation and process improvements

QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate will have:

• Bachelor’s degree

• 5 or more years of experience in accounting, finance, an analytical human resources role, management consulting (i.e., strategy and compensation), or a similar analytical role; one to three years of experience in a compensation role preferred

• Ability to design, run, and report on quantitative analyses

• Advanced Excel proficiency and a drive to obtain maximum leverage from systems

• Carry programs: experience with carry programs or other long-term incentive plans is a plus

• Compensation technology: experience with Anaplan or a comparable compensation planning and modeling platform is a plus

• Payroll systems: Workday Payroll expertise, including hands-on experience running multi-jurisdictional payroll cycles and building payroll reporting, is strongly preferred

• AI fluency: experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to accelerate analysis, modeling, or reporting workflows, paired with sound judgment about checking and verifying output, is a plus

• Ability to prioritize and work in an environment with competing demands

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

The ideal candidate possesses the following traits:

• Discretion and accountability: handles highly sensitive compensation information appropriately, and takes ownership of individual responsibilities and work product

• High bar for quality: exceptionally precise, with a low tolerance for error in critical and time-sensitive calculations

• Focus on efficiency: looks to improve how the work gets done rather than simply execute it

• Planning and organization: skilled at planning, organizing, and prioritizing a workload across competing demands and deadlines

• Customer service orientation: responsive, clear, and credible with stakeholders across the Firm and with external service providers

Viking is an equal opportunity employer.  Questions about your candidacy and requests for reasonable accommodation in the recruitment process should be directed to recruiting@vikingglobal.com.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Performance Engineering
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp!

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world.

What we’re looking for:

Nexamp is seeking a Senior Electrical Performance Engineer who will be a deep technical independent contributor responsible for improving the reliability, availability, and performance of Nexamp’s operating portfolio of distributed and utility-scale solar PV and BESS assets, currently exceeding 2 GW under management and in construction. In this role, you will apply advanced electrical engineering analysis to operating systems in the field, performing root-cause failure analysis, diagnosing complex and recurring issues across inverters, transformers, protection systems, controls, and balance-of-plant equipment. You'll identify systemic risks, validate corrective actions, and drive data-backed recommendations to reduce downtime, prevent repeat failures, and extend asset life. You'll also be responsible for optimizing control schemes and operating strategies, translating observed field behavior and performance data into improved settings, logic, and operational standards. Working closely with Operations, Asset Management, Controls, and OEMs, you will bridge the gap between design intent and real-world performance to ensure the fleet operates safely and reliably, while maximizing value throughout the project lifecycle.

This is a hybrid role out of our Lawrence, Boston, New York City, Chicago, or Washington, DC office, and will report to the Director, Performance Engineering.

What you’ll do:

• Own plant protection, controls, and compliance strategy by reviewing and coordinating protection settings across OCPDs, relays, inverters, and plant controllers; managing required setting changes with third-party vendors; and securing utility approvals to ensure safe, reliable operation.

• Engage directly with utilities on complex grid-interaction issues related to protection schemes, relay settings, and plant control behavior; diagnose misalignment between plant and utility protection philosophies; and negotiate technically sound solutions that optimize availability and interconnection compliance.

• Improve system reliability and energy performance by evaluating and optimizing protection schemes, breaker coordination, relay timing, circuit configurations, and inverter control functions (Volt/VAR, Volt/Watt, frequency-watt, ramp rates, ride-through).

• Partner with Engineering to improve design standards and fleet consistency, including relay database templates, equipment specifications, standard drawings, and protection philosophies, with a focus on maintainability, operability, and lifecycle cost.

• Lead data-driven reliability and loss reduction efforts by analyzing inverter logs, relay events, EMS dispatch data, and waveform captures; conducting root-cause and 8D investigations; quantifying production and financial impacts; and recommending corrective actions, upgrades, or repowering strategies.

• Own fleetwide monitoring and diagnostics strategy by refining alert thresholds, logic, and escalation workflows to reduce false positives, minimize alert fatigue, and accelerate incident response.

• Develop analytical models, diagnostic frameworks, and performance standards for Nexamp’s PV and BESS fleet, integrating power systems engineering with data analytics to identify constraints and improvement opportunities.

• Influence organizational capability and decision-making by representing Performance Engineering in cross-functional initiatives, providing actionable feedback to development and engineering teams on design and procurement decisions, and mentoring junior analysts through training and documented best practices.

What you’ll bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.

• 7+ years of electrical engineering experience.

• 2+ years of experience in solar and protection relays (breakers, reclosers, power logic controllers, etc.).

• Professional Engineer license is a plus.

• Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.

• Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.

• Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality.

• Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions.

• Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry.

• Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $130,000 - $150,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location.

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

OUR VALUES

Our institutional values are shaped and validated by our team members. They describe how we strive to operate and are the standards of behavior we look to embody.

ACT WITH INTEGRITY

We operate honestly and ethically in an industry-compliant fashion. We are fair and trustworthy in our interactions with all we serve. Our team members, at all levels, lead by example and strive to do the right thing for our students and for each other. We are disciplined professionals who strive to be straightforward and dependable.

CHAMPION STUDENT OUTCOMES

We live by a strong commitment to our students and are passionate about preparing them for meaningful careers. We are deeply dedicated to ensuring students’ educational and career success. We excel at building our students’ confidence and empowering them to reach their full potential.

COMMIT TO TEAM MEMBER SUCCESS

We are committed to our team members’ success and to each other’s success. We strive to create an environment that attracts and retains the best talent while offering continuous learning, professional development and career growth opportunities. We recognize and reward our team members for their contributions to the organization and to our students.

PURSUE RESULTS WITH PURPOSE

We pursue results with a sense of urgency and purpose. We take responsibility for achieving ambitious, measurable results and hold each other accountable. We think strategically and critically, greet new ideas and challenges openly, and look for innovative solutions to challenges.

HAVE FUN. BUILD ENERGY

Enjoying what we do is central to achieving our goals. Building energy, having fun, being optimistic and creating a positive working environment are all critical to our success and that of our students. We strive to be inspired and to inspire others. We consistently show appreciation and celebrate our successes, both large and small.

WORK AS ONE

We believe that diverse, inclusive teams produce breakthrough results. We strive to build and maintain positive relationships with colleagues from all types of backgrounds by showing respect and humility when interacting with each other and resolving conflicts in a constructive manner. By working together, we win together - as one - ensuring that the goals of the company are the focal point of our efforts.

jobs.title: Ultrasound Technologist
jobs.description:
As an Ultrasound Technologist, you’ll perform diagnostic sonography examinations and provide physicians with accurate imaging and clinical information to support patient assessment and treatment. You’ll use independent judgment throughout examinations to distinguish normal from pathological findings, adapt procedures based on patient history and diagnostic needs, and bring relevant emergency and trauma imaging experience to the role.

Employment Type: Full-time, fixed-term — up to 12 months

Assignment Details: This role requires relocation to Iraq for the duration of the assignment. Company-paid housing, meals, and project-related airfare are provided. Separate PRN opportunities are also available.

Responsibilities

• Perform clinical assessments and diagnostic sonography examinations as ordered by physicians, adapting procedures to anatomical, pathological, and diagnostic findings.
• Evaluate sonograms using independent clinical judgment to obtain appropriate diagnostic information and distinguish normal from pathological findings.
• Synthesize imaging findings with patient history and available clinical information, prepare preliminary reports, and communicate findings to physicians according to established procedures.
• Prepare and support patients throughout examinations while maintaining their safety, comfort, and well-being.
• Coordinate with physicians, imaging personnel, and other healthcare team members to support appropriate patient care and address issues as they arise.
• Support daily sonography operations, including scheduling coordination, patient logs, examination documentation, equipment reporting, and laboratory accreditation activities.

Requirements

• Graduate of a formal Diagnostic Medical Sonography Program or Cardiovascular Technology program.
• Minimum 2 years of recent practical ultrasound imaging experience in a hospital or clinic environment.
• Diagnostic ultrasound experience with emergency and trauma patients is required.
• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and current compliance with applicable Continuing Medical Education (CME) requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to operate sonographic equipment, evaluate diagnostic images, integrate imaging with patient history and medical records, and use independent judgment during examinations.
• U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident Card holder required; valid U.S. passport with at least 18 months remaining before expiration; ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government MRPT security clearance; ability to relocate to Iraq for the duration of the assignment.
• Ability to meet program physical readiness standards.

Preferred

• Diagnostic Medical Sonography or Cardiovascular Technology program accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP).
• Experience with digital image acquisition and transmission.
• Formal radiologic technology training from an AMA-approved school with ability to meet requirements for ARRT and/or CRT registry.
• Experience with, or interest in learning, general X-ray technician duties.

jobs.title: Co-op, mRNA-LNP Therapeutics
jobs.description:
Full-time Co-op (≥6 months) · In person · Boston, MA (Seaport)

About Kernal Biologics, Inc.

Kernal Bio is a venture-backed therapeutics company engineering cells inside the body using AI-designed, selective mRNA and targeted lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology. By developing in vivo CAR-T therapies, Kernal Bio is advancing precision treatments for autoimmune diseases and blood cancers. The company was founded by experts from MIT, Harvard, Merck, and BMS, and its leadership team brings a track record of three FDA-approved therapies and over 120 patents. With support from leading investors, including Hummingbird Ventures, Amgen Ventures, Y Combinator, and HBM, Kernal Bio is transforming the future of cell therapy design and delivery.

Job Summary

Kernal Bio is seeking a highly motivated Co-op to join our LNP team. The successful candidate will play an integral role in advancing next-generation mRNA-LNP therapeutics, contributing to routine production and analysis, LNP formulation, antibody conjugation, process development, and analytical characterization.

This position offers hands-on experience across multiple manufacturing functions and the opportunity to work alongside experienced scientists and engineers driving the future of selective, programmable mRNA medicines. The role also includes assisting with authoring and reviewing key documentation, such as protocols, batch records, and SOPs.

Key Responsibilities

• Support routine mRNA and LNP production, purification, and analytical testing

• Assist with LNP formulation and optimization, including process development and scale-up

• Contribute to antibody–LNP conjugation and associated analytical characterization workflows

• Participate in process development and analytical method development for mRNA-LNP products

• Draft, review, and maintain documentation (SOPs, protocols, batch records)

• Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless data sharing and process execution

• Maintain precise and organized lab records

• Maintain human and murine cell lines: sterile technique, passaging, cell counting and viability, cryopreservation

• Transfect IVT mRNAs and LNP-formulated mRNAs into mammalian cells and quantify expression by flow cytometry

Qualifications

• B.S. or M.S. student in Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or a related field

• Required: Familiarity with mRNA/LNP unit operations (e.g., in vitro transcription, chromatography, normal flow filtration, tangential flow filtration). Hands-on mammalian cell culture experience at the bench (sterile technique, passaging, transfection, viability assays), not coursework alone

• ≥6 months of previous laboratory experience strongly preferred

• Experience with molecular biology techniques (PCR, cloning, gel electrophoresis) and/or assays such as flow cytometry is a plus

• Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work full-time (35-40 hours/week) on site in Boston’s Seaport throughout the ≥6-month Co-op

• Eagerness to grow and develop as a scientist

Benefits

jobs.title: Supv, Materials Planning

The Materials & Scheduling Supervisor leads materials planning, production scheduling, inventory management, and capacity planning for Therma-Tru Retail operations. The Supervisor is accountable for ensuring material availability, production readiness, inventory health, and alignment of manufacturing capacity with customer demand. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the Supervisor to actively engage in day-to-day planning, analysis, and issue resolution while leading and developing the team.

The Supervisor partners closely with Plant Operations, Sourcing, Customer Service, Commercial, and other Supply Chain functions to deliver customer service, inventory, working capital, and operational objectives. This role also provides planning leadership for growth and customer initiatives, ensuring new requirements are effectively integrated into ongoing operations.

Location: This role is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, reporting to our site in Butler, IN.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and actively participate in materials planning and production scheduling for BPO retail operations, ensuring the right materials are available at the right time and executable production schedules are aligned with customer demand and manufacturing capacity.
• Manage inventory to achieve customer service and working capital objectives, including optimizing inventory levels and reducing slow-moving and obsolete (SLOB) materials.
• Develop and maintain capacity plans; proactively identify material, capacity, inventory, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to protect customer service.
• Partner closely with Plant Operations, Sourcing, Customer Service, Commercial, and other cross-functional teams to establish priorities, resolve issues, and improve overall supply chain performance.
• Support S&OP/S&OE processes by providing visibility to demand/capacity gaps, supply constraints, inventory risks, service performance, and recommended actions and trade-offs.
• Lead planning activities for growth, new product, and customer initiatives and serve as a key point of contact for special projects and urgent, unplanned customer requirements.
• Monitor and improve key performance indicators related to customer service/CSI, schedule attainment, material availability, inventory, working capital efficiency (WCE), and capacity; use data to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
• Maintain effective ERP-based planning processes, data accuracy, planning parameters, and process controls; identify and implement opportunities to improve systems, processes, efficiency, and visibility.
• Lead, coach, and develop the materials and scheduling team, establishing clear priorities and accountability while delegating effectively, building capability, and creating opportunities for associates to learn and grow.
• Foster a culture of high service, quality, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement through coaching, process improvement, and strong cross-functional partnership.

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field preferred; experience may be considered in lieu of degree
• 5+ years of relevant experience in materials management, production scheduling, manufacturing supply chain, or a related discipline.
