jobs.title: Social & Community Moderator Specialist - (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a sports-obsessed, internet-native Social & Community Specialist to help grow and deepen Fanatics Sports & Casino’s presence across the social community forums where sports fans spend their time.

This role will serve as a key member of the Organic Social team, with a focus on Discord, Reddit, X, Facebook Groups, and other emerging community platforms. You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day management, moderation, programming, and participation that turn audiences into active communities.

As Fanatics brings sportsbook, prediction markets, and casino together in one all-in-one experience, you’ll help develop a holistic community strategy that gives fans more reasons to engage with the brand beyond individual products or campaigns.

You’ll be equal parts community operator, social programmer, moderator, and sports fan — identifying conversations worth joining, creating programming that gets people talking, and bringing valuable insights back to the broader business.

What You’ll Do

• Own day-to-day community programming across Discord, Reddit, X, Facebook Groups, and other relevant community spaces.

• Develop and maintain an always-on community calendar spanning conversations, recurring programs, activations, AMAs, giveaways, cultural moments, and sports tentpoles.

• Be an active and authentic participant in online sports communities, joining conversations rather than simply broadcasting content.

• Moderate and manage Fanatics-owned communities, helping establish a welcoming, engaging, and distinctly Fanatics voice.

• Identify emerging conversations, trends, memes, fan behaviors, and community moments and turn them into timely programming and content opportunities.

• Develop community-first tactics to support major sports moments, campaigns, product launches, promotions, and tentpole events.

• Create recurring community franchises and experiences that give fans a reason to return and participate.

• Serve as a bridge between Fanatics and the sports community, surfacing fan sentiment, feedback, trends, and product opportunities to internal teams.

• Partner with the broader Organic Social team to translate community conversations and insights into content across social platforms.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Brand, Product, CRM, VIP, Responsible Gaming, and other teams to incorporate community perspectives into broader initiatives.

• Track community health, engagement, growth, and participation and use those insights to continuously improve programming.

• Help identify and test new platforms, communities, and emerging opportunities where Fanatics Sports & Casino can authentically participate.

What You Bring

• 3–5+ years of experience in social media, community management, social programming, or a related field, preferably within sports, sports betting, gaming, entertainment, or media.

• Hands-on experience managing or growing communities across platforms such as Discord, Reddit, X, Facebook Groups, or similar online communities.

• A deep understanding of sports culture, sports fans, betting culture, internet culture, and how communities behave online.

• A strong instinct for what makes people participate in a conversation — and the ability to turn that instinct into compelling community programming.

• Experience with social moderation, community guidelines, escalation processes, and managing conversations in fast-moving environments.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to adapt the brand voice to different platforms and communities.

• A proactive, highly collaborative approach and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple community programs, conversations, and initiatives simultaneously.

• A genuine passion for sports and a 24/7 curiosity about what fans are talking about online.

Additional Requirements

• Willingness to travel occasionally for events, activations, and team offsites.

• Must be comfortable working nights, weekends, and non-traditional hours as needed around major sporting events and tentpoles.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$80,000—$100,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

jobs.title: Director of Pricing - GovCon exp required - Services NOT Products (Job 1485)
jobs.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

The Director of Pricing is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape pricing strategy and directly influence DLH’s ability to compete and win across federal health and national security programs. Leading a small pricing team, this individual will serve as a key advisor to executive leadership and partner closely with Growth, Capture, Finance, Contracts, and Operations to develop competitive, compliant, and financially sound pricing strategies for complex U.S. Government opportunities.

This is a player-coach role, well suited to an experienced senior pricing manager or lead pricing professional who is ready to step into a director-level position and who enjoys both shaping strategy and staying close to the work. The Director will lead and develop a small pricing team while personally executing high-priority pursuits, complex pricing models, cost and profitability analyses, Price-to-Win strategies, and proposal development. The successful candidate will bring strong GovCon pricing expertise, sound business judgment, and confidence working directly with executives. DLH will invest in the right candidate’s development as a people leader and functional owner.

Responsibilities

• Lead DLH’s pricing function, including priorities, workload allocation, quality standards, processes, tools, and development of pricing team members.

• Develop and execute pricing strategies for major, complex, and high-value bids and proposals, serving as the senior pricing advisor and routinely leading cost volume activities directly, from RFP analysis through final submission.

• Provide strategic and hands-on guidance during RFP analysis, translating solicitation requirements, technical solutions, competitive intelligence, customer considerations, and business objectives into effective pricing approaches.

• Direct and actively participate in the development, review, and validation of detailed pricing models, cost estimates, rate structures, scenario analyses, and supporting cost narratives.

• Lead pricing reviews and present recommendations, trade-offs, risk considerations, and financial impacts to executive leadership to support informed bid/no-bid, pricing, and approval decisions.

• Direct Price-to-Win activities, incorporating competitive intelligence, market conditions, customer buying behavior, and affordability considerations into pricing strategies and final submissions.

• Ensure pricing proposals and supporting documentation comply with RFP requirements, corporate policies, FAR/DFARS requirements, and DFARS Estimating System criteria.

• Support DLH’s recompete-heavy pipeline and contract backlog with pricing approaches that protect margin while remaining competitive on incumbent-held work.

• Establish, maintain, and continuously improve pricing policies, procedures, templates, models, controls, and best practices.

• Build, coach, and develop pricing staff; set clear expectations, provide technical guidance, and cross-train for coverage across the pricing function.

• Partner with Finance, Contracts, Growth, Capture, Program, and Operations leaders to evaluate cost assumptions, profitability, contractual risk, staffing approaches, escalation factors, and operational feasibility.

• Manage multiple concurrent pricing efforts and competing deadlines, identifying resource constraints and proposal risks early.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Financial Crime Officer
jobs.description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Bitvavo is expanding its Financial Crime department, and we are looking for a Financial Crime Officer to join the team. The core goal of this role is to ensure Bitvavo's high quality standards are maintained in every investigation. You will help prevent Bitvavo from being used for criminal activity, money laundering or terrorist financing, using your investigative experience to help the business manage risk prudently, working in line with Bitvavo's quality standards and instructions.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

The main objective of this role is to ensure the business operates within the risk appetite set by the Management Board, through your integrity investigations. You assess and manage operational risks day to day.

 - Conduct robust transaction monitoring to identify, analyse and investigate complex AML and fraud patterns

 - Handle in depth Enhanced Due Diligence cases with a keen eye for detail and risk assessment

 - Identify, investigate and mitigate risks associated with high risk industries and client profiles

 - Analyse customer behaviour, recognise trends and turn them into actionable signal patterns

 - Continuously improve existing first line processes

 - Report and escalate suspicious activity to the relevant departments or authorities

 - Collaborate with the team to establish and maintain best practices, policies and procedures, and keep up with regulatory developments


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3 to 5 years of hands on experience in AML, CTF or KYC, ideally within financial services or fintech

 - Able to apply knowledge of external regulations to the organisation's goals while maintaining an independent position

 - Comfortable working in a fast paced, rapidly growing industry

 - Able to identify challenges, communicate them clearly, and turn them into opportunities

 - Entrepreneurial mindset with strong problem solving skills

 - Fluent in English, spoken and written


DESIRABLE

 - Experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs or Elliptic

 - General knowledge of and interest in the crypto space

 - Experience working in a dynamic scale up environment

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.


WHAT WE OFFER

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

Here, titles don’t define us—ideas do. You’ll thrive in a culture where everyone’s input shapes the future.

jobs.title: Sales Development Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

We’re Team Granola 👋 building tools that help humans think and work better.

What began as an AI notepad for back-to-back meetings has become a shared team workspace and second brain. Granola spreads organically inside companies, often starting with a senior leader and quickly cascading across teams.

Today, Granola is used at many of the world’s top and fastest-growing companies like Vercel, Cursor, Lovable and Decagon.

Designed and built in London, Granola now serves a predominantly US customer base. To support that growth, we’ve opened a San Francisco office as the hub for our North American go-to-market efforts.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Granola is already loved by people inside the companies we want to work with. You’ll help turn that engagement into enterprise opportunities, while developing creative outbound strategies to reach new customers.

You’ll hire, coach, and lead our SDR team, working closely with Account Executives and sales leadership to shape our approach. This is a hands-on role: you’ll test ideas yourself, learn what works, and help the team turn those lessons into repeatable results.

We’re especially excited about someone who uses AI and automation thoughtfully to improve account research, prioritization, and outreach, while keeping customer conversations personal and relevant.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Hire, coach, and develop our SDR team, helping people succeed in their roles and grow their careers.

 - Own the team’s qualified pipeline targets, partnering with Account Executives and sales leadership on account priorities and execution.

 - Build outreach strategies that use product engagement and account signals to identify companies ready for a broader conversation about Granola.

 - Develop and test targeted outbound campaigns, reaching relevant champions and decision-makers across enterprise accounts.

 - Use AI and automation to improve research, personalization, and team productivity.

 - Establish clear processes for qualification, account ownership, and AE handoffs.

 - Build onboarding and coaching that help new hires become effective quickly.

 - Use data and feedback to improve outreach quality, conversion rates, and pipeline performance.

 - Help build the SF office and sales team culture, setting high standards while creating an environment where people enjoy doing their best work.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Background & Experience

 - 4+ years of experience in SaaS sales or sales development, including at least 1–2 years leading or managing SDRs.

 - A strong personal track record in prospecting and pipeline generation, with evidence you can help others succeed.

 - Experience building or improving a sales development motion in a growing technology company.

 - Experience prospecting into enterprise accounts and engaging multiple stakeholders.

 - Comfortable using CRM data, reporting, and outreach tools to understand and improve performance.

Skills & Traits

 - A strong coach who gives clear feedback, builds confidence, and holds people accountable.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools and automation in GTM workflows, with curiosity about what’s possible next.

 - Good judgment about which accounts to prioritize, who to engage, and how to make outreach relevant.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Highly autonomous and comfortable making progress without perfect information.

 - Excited to collaborate across functions and with teammates in SF and London.

Personal Characteristics

 - A builder who gets energized creating something from scratch.

 - Excited to work in-person in our SF office.

 - Creative, curious about customer behavior, and willing to experiment.

 - Values working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic.

 - Gets as much satisfaction from developing others as from hitting a target.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968, and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together, in London and SF.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape an important part of Granola’s growth and build a team whose impact grows with the company.




COMPENSATION

OTE $180K-240K, plus equity and benefits.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable compensation, and equity.




LOCATION

This role is based in our San Francisco office, working in person five days a week. We are happy to offer relocation assistance to candidates moving to SF to join us.

We think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what’s written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.
